Yabategeeza ekyo ye n'Abatume abalala kye baamanya olw'okwerabirako ku kuzuukira kwe, naye singa Omwoyo Omutukuvu yennyini teyatwala Ebyawandiikibwa Peetero bye yali akuŋŋaanyizza n'atwala obujulizi bwa Peetero n'abayigirizwa abalala, abantu 3,000 ku lunaku olwo tebandiraba Yesu nga bw'ali ne bamusembeza ne babatizibwa mu linnya lye. Omwoyo Omutukuvu yagatta obujulizi bwe ku bwa Peetero n'obw'Ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa. Omusajja Moody yayogeranga mu ngeri ye ennyimpi era ennyonnyofu nti Peetero bwe yagamba nti, “Kale ennyumba ya Isirayeri yonna bamanye ddala nti Katonda amufudde Mukama era Kristo, ye Yesu ono gwe mwakomerera” (Ebikolwa 2:36), Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'agamba nti, ‘Amiina’ abantu ne balaba ne bakkiriza.” Era kya kukakasa nti singa Omwoyo Omutukuvu teyajja ku lunaku olwo n'okuyita mu Peetero n'Abatume abalala n'awa obujulizi bwe obutereevu eri emitima gy'abaali bamuwuliriza, tewandibaddewo kwolesebwa kwa kulokola kwa Yesu eri abantu. Bw'oyagala abantu okufuna okulaba okutuufu okwa Yesu Kristo, okumulaba mu ngeri esobozesa okukkiriza n'okulokolebwa, tekimala okubawa Ebyawandiikibwa ebimwogerako; tekimala okubawa obujulizi bwo, oteekwa okubanoonyeza obujulizi bw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu era weeteeke mu nkolagana ne Katonda esobozesa Omwoyo Omutukuvu okuwa obujulizi bwe okuyita mu ggwe. Wadde obujulizi bwo, wadde obw'Ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa bwokka, tebiyinza kutuukiriza kino, newankubadde nga bwe bujulizi bwo, oba obw'Ekigambo, Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'akozesa. Naye obujulizi bwo n'obw'Ekigambo bwe butatwalibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'awa obujulizi, tebalikkiriza. Kino kinnyonnyola ekintu buli mukozi ow'obumanyirivu ky'ateekwa okuba nga yalaba. Tutuula ku lusegere lw'oyo abuuza ne tuggulawo Bayibuli zaffe ne tumuwa Ebyawandiikibwa ebyo ebibikkula Yesu ng'Omulokozi we atangirira ku musaalaba, Omulokozi eyaggya ku musango gw'ekibi, era ng'Omulokozi we eyazuukira, Omulokozi eyaggya ku maanyi g'ekibi. Ago ge mazima gennyini omusajja ge yeetaaga okulaba n'okukkiriza alyoke alokolebwe, naye tagalaba. Tuddamu Ebyawandiikibwa bino, ebiri gye tuli nga bwe bwakya, emirundi n'emirundi, naye oyo abuuza atudde awo mu kizikiza ekigazi; talaba kintu, takwata kintu. Oluusi tukalubira n'okulowooza obanga oyo abuuza musiru, nti tasobola kukiraba. Nedda, si musiru, okuggyako obuzibe bw'amaaso obwo obw'omwoyo obuli mu buli ndowooza etamulisiddwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu (1 Abakkolinso 2:14). Tuddamu okukiddamu, naye era takiraba. Tuddamu okukiddamu, n'amaaso ge ne gamasamasa n'aleekaana nti, “Nkiraba. Nkiraba,” era n'alaba Yesu n'akkiriza n'alokolebwa era n'amanya nti alokoddwa mu kaseera ako. Kiki ekibaddewo? Kino kyokka: Omwoyo Omutukuvu awadde obujulizi bwe, era ekyali ekizikiza ng'eky'ettumbi kati kimulisiddwa ng'emisana. Kino era kinnyonnyola ensonga lwaki oyo amaze ekiseera kiwanvu mu kizikiza ku Yesu Kristo atuuka mangu okulaba amazima bw'awaayo okwagala kwe eri Katonda n'anoonya omusana okuva gy'ali. Bw'awaayo okwagala kwe eri Katonda, aba yeeteese mu mbeera eyo eri Katonda Omwoyo Omutukuvu gy'asobolera okukola omulimu gwe (Ebikolwa 5:32). Yesu agamba mu Yokaana 7:17 nti, “Omuntu yenna bw'aba ayagala okukola Katonda by'ayagala, alimanya oba enjigiriza eva eri Katonda oba nti njogera ku buyinza bwange.” Omuntu bw'aba ayagala okukola Katonda by'ayagala, olwo embeera Omwoyo Omutukuvu z'akolerako zibaawo, era amulisa endowooza okulaba amazima ku Yesu n'okulaba nti enjigiriza ye ye Kigambo kya Katonda kyennyini. Yokaana awandiika mu Yokaana 20:31 nti, “naye bino byawandiikibwa mulyoke mukkirize nti Yesu ye Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda, era nga mukkiriza mube n'obulamu mu linnya lye.” Yokaana yawandiika Enjiri ye olw'ekigendererwa kino, abantu balyoke balabe Yesu nga Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda, okuyita mu ebyo bye yawandiika, era balyoke bakkirize nti ye Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda, era nga bwe batyo bakkiriza balyoke babe n'obulamu okuyita mu linnya lye. Ekitabo ekisinga obulungi mu nsi okuteeka mu mikono gy'oyo ayagala okumanya ku Yesu n'okulokolebwa ye Njiri ya Yokaana. Kyokka abantu bangi basomye Enjiri ya Yokaana emirundi n'emirundi ne batalaba wadde okukkiriza nti Yesu ye Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda. Naye omusajja oyo omu bw'awaayo okwagala kwe okumalirira eri Katonda n'asaba Katonda omusana ng'asoma Enjiri n'asuubiza Katonda nti anaanywerera ku buli kintu mu Njiri ky'anaamulaga okuba amazima, nga omusajja tannamaliriza Njiri anaalaba bulungi nti Yesu ye Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda, era anaakkiriza n'aba n'obulamu obutaggwaawo. Kubanga aba yeeteese mu kifo Omwoyo Omutukuvu gy'asobolera okutwala ebintu ebyawandiikibwa mu Njiri n'abitegeeza n'awa obujulizi bwe. Kino nkirabye nga kigezesebwa era nga kikakasibwa emirundi n'emirundi mu nsi yonna. Abantu bajja gye ndi ne baŋŋamba nti tebakkiriza nti Yesu ye Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda, era bangi baagenda n'okusingawo ne bagamba nti be batakkiriza era nti tebamanyi ne bwe waaliwo Katonda ow'obuntu. Ne mbagamba okusoma Enjiri ya Yokaana, eraga obukakafu nti Yesu yali Kristo era Omwana wa Katonda. Emirundi mingi baŋŋamba nti bagisomye emirundi n'emirundi, kyokka nga tebakakasiddwa nti Yesu yali Kristo, era Omwana wa Katonda. Ne mbagamba nti, “Temugisomye mu ngeri entuufu,” ne mbaleetera okuwaayo okwagala kwabwe eri Katonda (oba mu mbeera we baali tebakakasa nti waaliwo Katonda, ne mbaleetera okunywerera ku kimalirizo eky'okugoberera amazima buli we ganaabatwala). N'oluvannyuma ne mbakkiriza okusoma Enjiri ya Yokaana mpola era n'okulowooza, era buli lwe baali nga tebannasoma okutunula eri Katonda, singa waaliwo Katonda yenna, okubayamba okutegeera bye baali baakusoma n'okumusuubiza nti banaanywerera ku kyonna ky'anaabalaga okuba amazima, era banaakigoberera buli we ginaabatwala. Era mu buli mulundi nga tebannamaliriza Njiri, baali batuuse okulaba nti Yesu yali Kristo era Omwana wa Katonda, era baali bakkirizza ne balokolebwa. Baali beeteese mu kifo ekyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu gye yandiwadde obujulizi bwe ku Yesu Kristo, era yali akikoze, era okuyita mu bujulizi bwe, ne balaba ne bakkiriza. Bw'oyagala abantu okulaba amazima ku Kristo, teweesiga buyinza bwo obw'okwogera n'okusendasenda, wabula weekwate ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu obanoonyeze obujulizi bwe, era olabe nti beeteeka mu kifo Omwoyo Omutukuvu gy'asobolera okuwa obujulizi. Guno gwe muti gw'obutakkiriza n'obutamanya ku Kristo. Bw'oba tokakasibbwa ku mazima aga Yesu Kristo, weenoonyeze ggwe obujulizi bw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku Kristo. Soma Ebyawandiikibwa, naddala soma Enjiri ya Yokaana, naye teweesiga kusoma kwa Kigambo kwokka, wabula nga tonnaba kukisoma, weeteeke mu mbeera eyo eri Katonda ng'owaayo ddala okwagala kwo gy'ali, Omwoyo Omutukuvu alyoke awe obujulizi bwe mu mutima gwo ku Yesu Kristo. Ekisinga okwetaagibwa kwe kwolesebwa okulambulukufu era okujjuvu okwa Yesu Kristo, era kino kiyita mu bujulizi bw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Ekiro kimu, abayizi baffe abamu ne bakomawo okuva mu Pacific Garden Mission mu Chicago ne baŋŋamba nti, “Twabadde n'olukuŋŋaana olw'ekitalo ku mission leero ekiro. Waaliwo abatamiivu bangi n'abagobe mu maaso abaakkiriza Kristo.” Enkeera ne nsisinkana Omusajja Harry Monroe, omukulu wa mission, ku luguudo, ne ŋŋamba nti, “Harry, abalenzi bagamba nti wabadde n'olukuŋŋaana olw'ekitalo ku mission ekiro.” “Oyagala okumanya engeri gye kyatuukirira?” n'anziramu. “Yee.” “Kale,” n'agamba, “Nayimusa buyimusi Yesu Kristo era Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne kimusanyusa okumulisa amaaso ga Yesu Kristo, abantu ne balaba ne bakkiriza.” Yali ngeri ya njawulo ey'okukyogera, naye yali ngeri nnyonnyofu era ntuufu ku nsonga enkulu ez'omu nsonga eyo. Gwe mulimu gwaffe okuyimusa Yesu Kristo, ne tulyoka tutunula eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu okumulisa amaaso ge oba okutwala amazima agamwogerako n'agyoleka eri emitima gy'abatuwuliriza, era anaakikola, abantu ne balaba ne bakkiriza. Mazima, twetaaga okutambula bwe tutyo eri Katonda Omwoyo Omutukuvu alyoke atutwale ng'ebikozesebwa okuyita mu ffe by'anaawaamu obujulizi bwe.

fields.title: Omulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw'Okuzaalibwa Obuggya
fields.body_html:
Omutume Pawulo awandiika mu Tito 3:5 nti, “Si lwa bikolwa eby'obutuukirivu bye twakola ffe, wabula ng'okusaasira kwe bwe kuli, yatulokola, olw'okunaazibwa okw'okuzaalibwa obuggya n'okuzza obuggya okw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.” Olunyiriri luno luyigiriza nti obulokozi buva mu mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw'okuzza obuggya, si lwa bikolwa byaffe. Yesu addamu amazima gano mu Yokaana 3:5 nti, “Ddala ddala nkugamba nti, omuntu bw'atazaalibwa mu mazzi ne mu Mwoyo, tayinza kuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Okwogera kwe ne Nikodemo kukiraga bulungi nti okuzaalibwa obuggya okw'omwoyo okuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu kwe kwetaagibwa okuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda.

Okuzaalibwa obuggya kwe ki? Okuzaalibwa obuggya kwe kuwebwa obulamu, obulamu obw'omwoyo, eri abo abafudde mu mwoyo olw'ebisobyo n'ebibi byabwe (Abaefeso 2:1). Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye awa obulamu buno. Ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa mazima kye kikozesebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'akozesa mu kuzaalibwa obuggya. Tusoma mu 1 Peetero 1:23 nti, “Nga bwe mwazaalibwa obuggya, si lwa nsigo eyaggwaawo naye ey'olubeerera, olw'ekigambo kya Katonda ekiramu era ekituula ennaku zonna.” Tusoma mu Yakobo 1:18 nti, “Olw'okwagala kwe ye yatuzaala olw'ekigambo eky'amazima, tulyoke tube ng'ebibala ebibereberye eby'ebitonde bye.” Ebitundu bino biraga bulungi nti Ekigambo kye kikozesebwa mu kuzaalibwa obuggya, naye kiba kyekka Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'akozesa ekikozesebwa okuzaalibwa obuggya kwe kuvaamu. “Omwoyo ye awa obulamu.” (Yokaana 6:63).

Mu 2 Abakkolinso 3:6, tugambibwa nti “Kubanga ennukuta etta, naye Omwoyo awa obulamu.” Kino oluusi kitegeezebwa okutegeeza nti okunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa okw'obw'ennukuta, okunnyonnyola okubitwala mu makulu gaabyo ag'ennukuta gennyini ne kubifuula okutegeeza bye byogera, kutta; naye nti okunnyonnyola okumu okw'omwoyo, okunnyonnyola “okuwa omwoyo gw'ekitundu,” nga kufuula ekitundu okutegeeza ekimu ekitakyogera, kuwa obulamu; era abo abanywerera ku Byawandiikibwa okutegeeza byennyini bye byogera bayitibwa “ab'ennukuta abatta.”

Kuno kwe kukyusakyusa Ebyawandiikibwa okwagalibwa abo abatayagala kutwala Bayibuli ng'etegeeza byennyini by'eyogera era abeesanga nga basindiikirizibbwa mu nsonda ne banoonya ekkubo eryangu ery'okuwonawo. Omuntu bw'asoma ebigambo mu bwesigami bwabyo, anaalaba nti endowooza eno yali eyawukanira ddala ku ndowooza ya Pawulo. Ddala, oyo anaasoma n'obwegendereza ebbaluwa za Pawulo anaalaba nti yali wa ku b'ennukuta asinga ab'ennukuta bonna.

Obanga okutwala ebintu mu bw'ennukuta kutta, kale enjigiriza za Pawulo ziri ku ezisinga okutta ezaali zaawandiikibwa. Pawulo azimba endowooza ku nkyukakyuka y'ekigambo, ku muwendo oba ku kiseera ky'ekikolwa. Ekitundu kitegeeza ki? Enkola y'okuzuula ekitundu kyonna kye kitegeeza kwe kusoma ebigambo ebikozesebwa mu bwesigami bwabyo. Pawulo ayawula wakati w'Ekigambo kya Katonda ekiri ebweru waffe, ekyawandiikibwa n'obwino ku lupapula oba ekiwoolebwa ku bipande eby'amayinja, n'Ekigambo kya Katonda ekyawandiikibwa munda yaffe ku bipande ebiri emitima egy'ennyama olw'Omwoyo gwa Katonda omulamu (olunyiriri 3), era atugamba nti bwe tuba tulina Ekigambo kya Katonda ebweru waffe mu Kitabo oba ku lupapula oba ku bipande eby'amayinja kyokka, kinaatutta, kinaaleeta kwenkwana n'okufa kwokka, naye bwe tuba tulina Ekigambo kya Katonda ekifuuse ekintu ekiramu mu mitima gyaffe, ekyawandiikibwa ku mitima gyaffe olw'Omwoyo gwa Katonda omulamu, kinaatuleetera obulamu.

Tewali muwendo gwa Bayibuli ku meeza zaffe oba mu tterekero lyaffe ery'ebitabo oguyinza okutulokola, naye amazima ga Bayibuli agawandiikiddwa Omwoyo gwa Katonda omulamu mu mitima gyaffe ge ganaatulokola. Okwogera ku nsonga y'okuzaalibwa obuggya mu ngeri endala, okuzaalibwa obuggya kwe kuwebwa obuntu obuggya, obuntu bwa Katonda, eri oyo azaalibwa obuggya (2 Peetero 1:4).

Buli muntu azaalibwa mu nsi eno n'obuntu obwonoonese; endowooza ye yonna, enneewulira ye, n'obusobozi bwe obw'okusalawo byonna byonoonese ekibi. Ka olulyo lwaffe olw'obuntu lube nga lulungi lutya, tujja mu nsi eno n'endowooza ezibe amaaso eri amazima ga Katonda.

(“Omuntu ow'obuzaaliranwa tafaayo ku bintu bya Mwoyo gwa Katonda, kubanga gy'ali busiru, era tasobola kubitegeera kubanga bitegeerwa mu mwoyo.” 1 Abakkolinso 2:14.) N'enneewulira ezaawukana ku Katonda, nga twagala ebintu bye twandikyaye, nga tukyawa ebintu bye twandyagadde. (“Kaakano ebikolwa by'omubiri bilabika, bye bino: Obwenzi, obukaba, obutali bulongoofu, obwavu, okusinza bakatonda abalala, obulogo, obukyayi, ennyombo, obuggya, obusungu, entalo, enkaayana, enjawukana, ettima, obussi, obutamiivu, ebinyumu, n'ebifaanana ng'ebyo.”

Abaggalatiya 5:19-21) n'okwagala okwonoonese, okuteekeddwa ku kwesanyusa kwokka, mu kifo ky'okusanyusa Katonda.

(“Kubanga okulowooza kw'omubiri bulabe eri Katonda; kubanga tekugondera mateeka ga Katonda, era ddala tekuyinza.” Abaruumi 8:7) Mu kuzaalibwa obuggya, tuweebwa obuntu obuggya obw'endowooza, obw'enneewulira, n'obw'okusalawo. Tufuna endowooza eraba nga Katonda bw'alaba, elowooza ebirowoozo bya Katonda ng'agoberera (1 Abakkolinso 2:12-14); n'enneewulira ezikwatagana n'enneewulira za Katonda. (“Ekibala ky'Omwoyo kwe kwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, obukwatampola, obulungi, okukkiriza, obuwombeefu, okwefuga: awo tewali mateeka gakontana n'ebyo.” Abaggalatiya 5:22-23) n'okwagala okukwatagana n'okwagala kwa Katonda, okusanyukira okukola ebintu ebimusanyusa. (Nga Yesu, twogera nti, “Emmere yange kwe kukola ekyagalibwa oyo eyantuma n'okutuukiriza omulimu gwe.” Yokaana 4:34, Yokaana 6:38, Abaggalatiya 1:10. Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye atondamu munda yaffe obuntu buno obuggya, oba atuwa obuntu buno obuggya. Tewali kubuulira kungi, ka kubeere kutuufu kutya, tewali kusoma kwa Kigambo kwokka okuyinza okuzaala obuggya okuggyako Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'akola. Ye yekka afuula omuntu ekitonde ekiggya.

Okuzaalibwa obuggya mu Bayibuli kugeraageranyizibwa n'okukula okuva mu nsigo. Omutima gw'omuntu gwe ttaka, Ekigambo kya Katonda ye nsigo (Lukka 8:11; 1 Peetero 1:23; Yakobo 1:18; 1 Abakkolinso 4:15), buli mubuulizi oba omuyigiriza w'Ekigambo musizi, naye Omwoyo gwa Katonda ye Oyo azaamu obulamu ensigo esimbibwa bw'etyo, n'obuntu obw'ekyakatonda ne buvaayo. Waliwo ettaka lingi wonna omwo mw'okusimba ensigo, mu mitima gy'abantu abatwetoolodde ku buli ludda. Waliwo ensigo nnyingi ey'okusimba, omu ku ffe yenna asobola okugisanga mu terekero ery'Ekigambo kya Katonda; era leero waliwo abasizi bangi: naye wayinza okubaawo ettaka n'ensigo n'abasizi, naye bwe tusimba ensigo, Omwoyo gwa Katonda bw'atagizzaamu bulamu n'omutima gw'oyo awulira ne gutagikwatako olw'okukkiriza, tewaabeewo makungula. Buli musizi yeetaaga okulaba nti ategeera nti yeesiga Omwoyo Omutukuvu okuzza obulamu mu nsigo gy'asimba, era yeetaaga okulaba nti ali mu nkolagana ne Katonda esobozesa Omwoyo Omutukuvu okukola okuyita mu ye n'azza obulamu mu nsigo gy'asimba.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu azaalibwa abantu obuggya. Alina amaanyi okuzuukiza abafu. Alina amaanyi okuwa obulamu abo abafudde mu mpisa era abavunda. Alina amaanyi okuwa obuntu obuggya ddala abo abalina obuntu obwonoonese ennyo eri abantu ne bafaanana ng'abaggwaamu essuubi. Emirundi emeka gye nkirabye nga kikakasibwa! Emirundi emeka gye nnalabye abasajja n'abakazi ababuze ddala era abaayonoonebwa era ababi nga bajja ku nkuŋŋaana nga kumpi tebamanyi kye bajjidde, era nga batudde awo Ekigambo ne kyogerwa, Omwoyo gwa Katonda n'azza obulamu mu Kigambo ekyasimbibwa bwe kityo mu mitima gyabwe era mu kaseera omusajja oyo oba omukazi oyo, olw'amaanyi ag'ekitalo ag'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, afuuka ekitonde ekiggya.

Mmanyi omusajja eyafaanana ng'eyaleekeddwa ddala era ataliiko ssuubi ng'abantu bwe basobola okuba. Yali ng'ow'emyaka amakumi ana mu etaano. Yali agenze mu makubo amabi ng'akyali mulenzi muto. Yali adduse okuva eka, yali yeegasse ku magye g'oku nnyanja n'oluvannyuma ku magye g'oku lukalu, n'ayiga ebibi byonna eby'omu byombi. Yali agobeddwa mu magye mu buswavu olw'obutamiivu bwe obw'ekitalo n'obutali butegevu.

Yali afunye emikwano gye mu basembayo wansi mu bantu n'abasingira ddala obubi. Bwe yayitanga ku luguudo olw'ekibuga eky'ebugwanjuba ekiro, abasuubuzi bwe baawuliranga okuleekaana kwe, baaggalangawo enzigi zaabwe olw'okutya. Naye omusajja ono yagenda ekiro kimu mu lukuŋŋaana olw'okuzuukusa mu kkanisa ey'omu byalo olw'okwagala okumanya. Yasekereza olukuŋŋaana ekiro ekyo ne munne gwe yali atudde naye, naye yaddayo ekiro ekyaddirira, era Omwoyo gwa Katonda n'akwata omutima gwe. Yagenda mu maaso n'avuunama ku kyoto.

Yagolokoka ng'ekitonde ekiggya n'afuulibwa omu ku basajja abasinga ekitiibwa, abeesigwa, abalongoofu, abaterina bwerema, abakwatampola, era abafaanana Kristo be nnali mmanyiddeko. Oluusi mbuuzibwa nti, “Okkiriza okukyuka okw'amangu ago?”

Nzikiriza mu kintu ekisinga ennyo ekyewuunyo okusinga okukyuka okw'amangu n'okuzaalibwa obuggya okw'amangu. Okukyuka kintu kya kungulu kyokka, kwe kukyuka. Okuzaalibwa obuggya kuserengeta ku buziba obusinga obw'omwoyo ogw'omunda ennyo, ne kukyusa ebirowoozo, enneewulira, okwagala, n'omuntu ow'omunda yenna. Nzikiriza mu kuzaalibwa obuggya okw'amangu kubanga Bayibuli ekiyigiriza era kubanga nkirabye emirundi egitabalika. Nzikiriza mu kuzaalibwa obuggya okw'amangu kubanga nkiyiseemu. Oluusi tugambibwa nti “eddiini ey'omu maaso teerijjigiriza kukyuka kwa mangu kwa kyamagero.”

Eddiini ey'omu maaso bw'eteeyigiriza kukyuka kwa mangu kwa kyamagero, n'ekintu ekisinga ennyo amakulu, okuzaalibwa obuggya okw'amangu, okw'ekyamagero olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kale eddiini ey'omu maaso teerikkiriziganya na bituufu eby'obumanyirivu era bwe kityo teeribeera ya ssaayansi. Erisubwa amazima gamu ku agasinga obukakafu era agasinga ekitiibwa mu mazima gonna. Eddiini ezaakolebwa abantu mu biro eby'edda emirundi mingi zaasubwa amazima, era eddiini ezaakolebwa abantu mu biro eby'omu maaso awatali kubuusabuusa zirikola bwe kityo. Naye eddiini Katonda gy'abikkulidde mu Kigambo Kye era gy'akakasa mu bumanyirivu eyigiriza okuzaalibwa obuggya okw'amangu olw'amaanyi ag'ekitalo ag'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Singa saakkiriza kuzaalibwa obuggya olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, nnandivudde ku kubuulira.

Kyandigasizza ki okwolekera abantu abangi abaali baliko ebibinja by'abasajja n'abakazi abakakanyavu era abasiriiza, abatafaayo ku kintu kyonna okuggyako eby'ensi n'eby'omubiri, abatalina birowoozo bya waggulu era ebitukuvu, abatalaba wala okusukka ku ssente, ettutumu, obuyinza, n'amasanyu, singa tewaali maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ag'okuzaala obuggya? Naye n'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ag'okuzaala obuggya, waliwo omugaso mu buli ngeri; kubanga omubuulizi tayinza kumanya Omwoyo gwa Katonda w'anaakuba n'akola omulimu gwe ogw'amaanyi. Mu maaso go mutuddewo omusajja omuzannyi w'emikwano, oba omutamiivu, oba omukaba. Tekifaanana ng'ekiriko mugaso munene okumubuulira, naye toyinza kumanya nti ekiro ekyo kyennyini, Omwoyo gwa Katonda anaakwata omutima gw'omusajja oyo n'amufuula omu ku basajja abasinga obutukuvu era abasinga omugaso.

Kino kibaddewo emirundi mingi mu biro eby'edda era awatali kubuusabuusa kirijja emirundi mingi mu biro eby'omu maaso. Mu maaso go mutuddewo omukazi ali nga kaawaawa ka njogera z'enfaanana bwezinnye. Afaanana ng'atalina kirowoozo kisukka ku bantu, amasanyu, n'okusiimibwa. Lwaki omubuulira? Awatali maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ag'okuzaala obuggya, kyandibadde busiru era okufiirwa obudde; naye toyinza kumanya, oboolwa ekiro kino kyennyini Omwoyo gwa Katonda anaayakira mu mutima ogwo ogwaziba n'azibula amaaso g'omukazi oyo okulaba obulungi bwa Yesu Kristo era ayinza okumusembeza, era eyo mu kaseera ako obulamu bwa Katonda ne buweebwa olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu eri emmeeme eyo etafaayo.

Enjigiriza ey'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ag'okuzaala obuggya ya kitiibwa. Egyawo essuubi ery'obulimba. Ejjira oyo eyeesiga okuyigirizibwa n'obuwangwa n'egamba nti, “Okuyigirizibwa n'obuwangwa tebimala. Oteekwa okuzaalibwa obuggya.” Ejjira oyo eyeesiga empisa ez'okungulu zokka, n'egamba nti, “Empisa ez'okungulu tezimala, oteekwa okuzaalibwa obuggya.” Ejjira oyo eyeesiga eby'okungulu eby'eddiini, mu kugenda mu kkanisa, okusoma Bayibuli, okusaba, okunywezebwa, okubatizibwa, okulya eky'ekiro kya Mukama, n'egamba nti, “Eby'okungulu byokka eby'eddiini tebimala, oteekwa okuzaalibwa obuggya.” Ejjira oyo eyeesiga okukyusa empisa, mu kwekyusa okw'okungulu, mu kuleka obukyamu bwe; egamba nti, “Okwekyusa okw'okungulu, okuleka obukyamu bwo tekimala. Oteekwa okuzaalibwa obuggya.” Naye mu kifo ky'essuubi eritali lya nsonga era etaba mangu ly'egyawo, ereeta essuubi eriggya, essuubi eddungi, essuubi erya mukisa, essuubi ery'ekitiibwa. Egamba nti, “Oyinza okuzaalibwa obuggya.” Ejjira oyo atalina kwegomba kusinga kwegomba kwa bintu bya nsolo oba bwerema oba bya nsi n'egamba nti, “Oyinza okufuuka ow'omugabo mu buntu obw'ekyakatonda, n'oyagala ebintu Katonda by'ayagala n'okyawa ebintu Katonda by'akyawa. Oyinza okufuuka nga Yesu Kristo. Oyinza okuzaalibwa obuggya.”
fields.body_text: Omutume Pawulo awandiika mu Tito 3:5 nti, “Si lwa bikolwa eby'obutuukirivu bye twakola ffe, wabula ng'okusaasira kwe bwe kuli, yatulokola, olw'okunaazibwa okw'okuzaalibwa obuggya n'okuzza obuggya okw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.” Olunyiriri luno luyigiriza nti obulokozi buva mu mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw'okuzza obuggya, si lwa bikolwa byaffe. Yesu addamu amazima gano mu Yokaana 3:5 nti, “Ddala ddala nkugamba nti, omuntu bw'atazaalibwa mu mazzi ne mu Mwoyo, tayinza kuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Okwogera kwe ne Nikodemo kukiraga bulungi nti okuzaalibwa obuggya okw'omwoyo okuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu kwe kwetaagibwa okuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Okuzaalibwa obuggya kwe ki? Okuzaalibwa obuggya kwe kuwebwa obulamu, obulamu obw'omwoyo, eri abo abafudde mu mwoyo olw'ebisobyo n'ebibi byabwe (Abaefeso 2:1). Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye awa obulamu buno. Ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa mazima kye kikozesebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'akozesa mu kuzaalibwa obuggya. Tusoma mu 1 Peetero 1:23 nti, “Nga bwe mwazaalibwa obuggya, si lwa nsigo eyaggwaawo naye ey'olubeerera, olw'ekigambo kya Katonda ekiramu era ekituula ennaku zonna.” Tusoma mu Yakobo 1:18 nti, “Olw'okwagala kwe ye yatuzaala olw'ekigambo eky'amazima, tulyoke tube ng'ebibala ebibereberye eby'ebitonde bye.” Ebitundu bino biraga bulungi nti Ekigambo kye kikozesebwa mu kuzaalibwa obuggya, naye kiba kyekka Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'akozesa ekikozesebwa okuzaalibwa obuggya kwe kuvaamu. “Omwoyo ye awa obulamu.” (Yokaana 6:63). Mu 2 Abakkolinso 3:6, tugambibwa nti “Kubanga ennukuta etta, naye Omwoyo awa obulamu.” Kino oluusi kitegeezebwa okutegeeza nti okunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa okw'obw'ennukuta, okunnyonnyola okubitwala mu makulu gaabyo ag'ennukuta gennyini ne kubifuula okutegeeza bye byogera, kutta; naye nti okunnyonnyola okumu okw'omwoyo, okunnyonnyola “okuwa omwoyo gw'ekitundu,” nga kufuula ekitundu okutegeeza ekimu ekitakyogera, kuwa obulamu; era abo abanywerera ku Byawandiikibwa okutegeeza byennyini bye byogera bayitibwa “ab'ennukuta abatta.” Kuno kwe kukyusakyusa Ebyawandiikibwa okwagalibwa abo abatayagala kutwala Bayibuli ng'etegeeza byennyini by'eyogera era abeesanga nga basindiikirizibbwa mu nsonda ne banoonya ekkubo eryangu ery'okuwonawo. Omuntu bw'asoma ebigambo mu bwesigami bwabyo, anaalaba nti endowooza eno yali eyawukanira ddala ku ndowooza ya Pawulo. Ddala, oyo anaasoma n'obwegendereza ebbaluwa za Pawulo anaalaba nti yali wa ku b'ennukuta asinga ab'ennukuta bonna. Obanga okutwala ebintu mu bw'ennukuta kutta, kale enjigiriza za Pawulo ziri ku ezisinga okutta ezaali zaawandiikibwa. Pawulo azimba endowooza ku nkyukakyuka y'ekigambo, ku muwendo oba ku kiseera ky'ekikolwa. Ekitundu kitegeeza ki? Enkola y'okuzuula ekitundu kyonna kye kitegeeza kwe kusoma ebigambo ebikozesebwa mu bwesigami bwabyo. Pawulo ayawula wakati w'Ekigambo kya Katonda ekiri ebweru waffe, ekyawandiikibwa n'obwino ku lupapula oba ekiwoolebwa ku bipande eby'amayinja, n'Ekigambo kya Katonda ekyawandiikibwa munda yaffe ku bipande ebiri emitima egy'ennyama olw'Omwoyo gwa Katonda omulamu (olunyiriri 3), era atugamba nti bwe tuba tulina Ekigambo kya Katonda ebweru waffe mu Kitabo oba ku lupapula oba ku bipande eby'amayinja kyokka, kinaatutta, kinaaleeta kwenkwana n'okufa kwokka, naye bwe tuba tulina Ekigambo kya Katonda ekifuuse ekintu ekiramu mu mitima gyaffe, ekyawandiikibwa ku mitima gyaffe olw'Omwoyo gwa Katonda omulamu, kinaatuleetera obulamu. Tewali muwendo gwa Bayibuli ku meeza zaffe oba mu tterekero lyaffe ery'ebitabo oguyinza okutulokola, naye amazima ga Bayibuli agawandiikiddwa Omwoyo gwa Katonda omulamu mu mitima gyaffe ge ganaatulokola. Okwogera ku nsonga y'okuzaalibwa obuggya mu ngeri endala, okuzaalibwa obuggya kwe kuwebwa obuntu obuggya, obuntu bwa Katonda, eri oyo azaalibwa obuggya (2 Peetero 1:4). Buli muntu azaalibwa mu nsi eno n'obuntu obwonoonese; endowooza ye yonna, enneewulira ye, n'obusobozi bwe obw'okusalawo byonna byonoonese ekibi. Ka olulyo lwaffe olw'obuntu lube nga lulungi lutya, tujja mu nsi eno n'endowooza ezibe amaaso eri amazima ga Katonda. (“Omuntu ow'obuzaaliranwa tafaayo ku bintu bya Mwoyo gwa Katonda, kubanga gy'ali busiru, era tasobola kubitegeera kubanga bitegeerwa mu mwoyo.” 1 Abakkolinso 2:14.) N'enneewulira ezaawukana ku Katonda, nga twagala ebintu bye twandikyaye, nga tukyawa ebintu bye twandyagadde. (“Kaakano ebikolwa by'omubiri bilabika, bye bino: Obwenzi, obukaba, obutali bulongoofu, obwavu, okusinza bakatonda abalala, obulogo, obukyayi, ennyombo, obuggya, obusungu, entalo, enkaayana, enjawukana, ettima, obussi, obutamiivu, ebinyumu, n'ebifaanana ng'ebyo.” Abaggalatiya 5:19-21) n'okwagala okwonoonese, okuteekeddwa ku kwesanyusa kwokka, mu kifo ky'okusanyusa Katonda. (“Kubanga okulowooza kw'omubiri bulabe eri Katonda; kubanga tekugondera mateeka ga Katonda, era ddala tekuyinza.” Abaruumi 8:7) Mu kuzaalibwa obuggya, tuweebwa obuntu obuggya obw'endowooza, obw'enneewulira, n'obw'okusalawo. Tufuna endowooza eraba nga Katonda bw'alaba, elowooza ebirowoozo bya Katonda ng'agoberera (1 Abakkolinso 2:12-14); n'enneewulira ezikwatagana n'enneewulira za Katonda. (“Ekibala ky'Omwoyo kwe kwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, obukwatampola, obulungi, okukkiriza, obuwombeefu, okwefuga: awo tewali mateeka gakontana n'ebyo.” Abaggalatiya 5:22-23) n'okwagala okukwatagana n'okwagala kwa Katonda, okusanyukira okukola ebintu ebimusanyusa. (Nga Yesu, twogera nti, “Emmere yange kwe kukola ekyagalibwa oyo eyantuma n'okutuukiriza omulimu gwe.” Yokaana 4:34, Yokaana 6:38, Abaggalatiya 1:10. Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye atondamu munda yaffe obuntu buno obuggya, oba atuwa obuntu buno obuggya. Tewali kubuulira kungi, ka kubeere kutuufu kutya, tewali kusoma kwa Kigambo kwokka okuyinza okuzaala obuggya okuggyako Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'akola. Ye yekka afuula omuntu ekitonde ekiggya. Okuzaalibwa obuggya mu Bayibuli kugeraageranyizibwa n'okukula okuva mu nsigo. Omutima gw'omuntu gwe ttaka, Ekigambo kya Katonda ye nsigo (Lukka 8:11; 1 Peetero 1:23; Yakobo 1:18; 1 Abakkolinso 4:15), buli mubuulizi oba omuyigiriza w'Ekigambo musizi, naye Omwoyo gwa Katonda ye Oyo azaamu obulamu ensigo esimbibwa bw'etyo, n'obuntu obw'ekyakatonda ne buvaayo. Waliwo ettaka lingi wonna omwo mw'okusimba ensigo, mu mitima gy'abantu abatwetoolodde ku buli ludda. Waliwo ensigo nnyingi ey'okusimba, omu ku ffe yenna asobola okugisanga mu terekero ery'Ekigambo kya Katonda; era leero waliwo abasizi bangi: naye wayinza okubaawo ettaka n'ensigo n'abasizi, naye bwe tusimba ensigo, Omwoyo gwa Katonda bw'atagizzaamu bulamu n'omutima gw'oyo awulira ne gutagikwatako olw'okukkiriza, tewaabeewo makungula. Buli musizi yeetaaga okulaba nti ategeera nti yeesiga Omwoyo Omutukuvu okuzza obulamu mu nsigo gy'asimba, era yeetaaga okulaba nti ali mu nkolagana ne Katonda esobozesa Omwoyo Omutukuvu okukola okuyita mu ye n'azza obulamu mu nsigo gy'asimba. Omwoyo Omutukuvu azaalibwa abantu obuggya. Alina amaanyi okuzuukiza abafu. Alina amaanyi okuwa obulamu abo abafudde mu mpisa era abavunda. Alina amaanyi okuwa obuntu obuggya ddala abo abalina obuntu obwonoonese ennyo eri abantu ne bafaanana ng'abaggwaamu essuubi. Emirundi emeka gye nkirabye nga kikakasibwa! Emirundi emeka gye nnalabye abasajja n'abakazi ababuze ddala era abaayonoonebwa era ababi nga bajja ku nkuŋŋaana nga kumpi tebamanyi kye bajjidde, era nga batudde awo Ekigambo ne kyogerwa, Omwoyo gwa Katonda n'azza obulamu mu Kigambo ekyasimbibwa bwe kityo mu mitima gyabwe era mu kaseera omusajja oyo oba omukazi oyo, olw'amaanyi ag'ekitalo ag'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, afuuka ekitonde ekiggya. Mmanyi omusajja eyafaanana ng'eyaleekeddwa ddala era ataliiko ssuubi ng'abantu bwe basobola okuba. Yali ng'ow'emyaka amakumi ana mu etaano. Yali agenze mu makubo amabi ng'akyali mulenzi muto. Yali adduse okuva eka, yali yeegasse ku magye g'oku nnyanja n'oluvannyuma ku magye g'oku lukalu, n'ayiga ebibi byonna eby'omu byombi. Yali agobeddwa mu magye mu buswavu olw'obutamiivu bwe obw'ekitalo n'obutali butegevu. Yali afunye emikwano gye mu basembayo wansi mu bantu n'abasingira ddala obubi. Bwe yayitanga ku luguudo olw'ekibuga eky'ebugwanjuba ekiro, abasuubuzi bwe baawuliranga okuleekaana kwe, baaggalangawo enzigi zaabwe olw'okutya. Naye omusajja ono yagenda ekiro kimu mu lukuŋŋaana olw'okuzuukusa mu kkanisa ey'omu byalo olw'okwagala okumanya. Yasekereza olukuŋŋaana ekiro ekyo ne munne gwe yali atudde naye, naye yaddayo ekiro ekyaddirira, era Omwoyo gwa Katonda n'akwata omutima gwe. Yagenda mu maaso n'avuunama ku kyoto. Yagolokoka ng'ekitonde ekiggya n'afuulibwa omu ku basajja abasinga ekitiibwa, abeesigwa, abalongoofu, abaterina bwerema, abakwatampola, era abafaanana Kristo be nnali mmanyiddeko. Oluusi mbuuzibwa nti, “Okkiriza okukyuka okw'amangu ago?” Nzikiriza mu kintu ekisinga ennyo ekyewuunyo okusinga okukyuka okw'amangu n'okuzaalibwa obuggya okw'amangu. Okukyuka kintu kya kungulu kyokka, kwe kukyuka. Okuzaalibwa obuggya kuserengeta ku buziba obusinga obw'omwoyo ogw'omunda ennyo, ne kukyusa ebirowoozo, enneewulira, okwagala, n'omuntu ow'omunda yenna. Nzikiriza mu kuzaalibwa obuggya okw'amangu kubanga Bayibuli ekiyigiriza era kubanga nkirabye emirundi egitabalika. Nzikiriza mu kuzaalibwa obuggya okw'amangu kubanga nkiyiseemu. Oluusi tugambibwa nti “eddiini ey'omu maaso teerijjigiriza kukyuka kwa mangu kwa kyamagero.” Eddiini ey'omu maaso bw'eteeyigiriza kukyuka kwa mangu kwa kyamagero, n'ekintu ekisinga ennyo amakulu, okuzaalibwa obuggya okw'amangu, okw'ekyamagero olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kale eddiini ey'omu maaso teerikkiriziganya na bituufu eby'obumanyirivu era bwe kityo teeribeera ya ssaayansi. Eddiini ezaakolebwa abantu mu biro eby'edda emirundi mingi zaasubwa amazima, era eddiini ezaakolebwa abantu mu biro eby'omu maaso awatali kubuusabuusa zirikola bwe kityo. fields.title: Omwoyo Abeera mu Ffe Amalira Ddala era Emirembe Gyonna
fields.body_html:
Omwoyo Omutukuvu afuula ekifo eky'okubeeramu mu oyo azaaliddwa mu Mwoyo. Omutume Pawulo agamba abakkiriza ab'e Kolinso mu 1 Abakkolinso 3:16 nti, “Temumanyi nga mmwe[a] muli yeekaalu ya Katonda, era ng'Omwoyo wa Katonda abeera mu mmwe?” Ekyawandiikibwa kino tekyogera nnyo ku mukkiriza omu omu, wabula ku kibiina kyonna eky'abakkiriza, ye Kkanisa. Omwoyo wa Katonda abeera mu Kkanisa ng'omubiri gumu. Naye mu 1 Abakkolinso 6:19, tusoma nti, “Oba temumanyi nga omubiri gwammwe gwe yeekaalu y'Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu mmwe, gwe mwaweebwa okuva eri Katonda?” Mu kyawandiikibwa kino kirabika nti Pawulo tayogera ku kibiina ky'abakkiriza, ku Kkanisa yonna awamu, wabula ku mukkiriza omu omu.

Mu ngeri y'emu, Mukama Yesu yagamba abayigirizwa be ekiro ekyakulembera okukomererwa kwe nti, “Nange nnaasaba Kitaffe, naye anaabawa Omubeezi omulala, abeere nammwe emirembe gyonna, ye Mwoyo ow'amazima, ensi gw'eteyinza kufuna, kubanga temumulaba so temumumanyi. Mmwe mumumanyi, kubanga abeera nammwe, era anaabeera mu mmwe” (Yokaana 14:16-17). Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu buli muntu azaaliddwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Tusoma mu Abaruumi 8:9 nti, “Buli atalina Mwoyo wa Kristo (Omwoyo wa Kristo mu lunyiriri luno, nga bwe twalaba dda, tekitegeeza mwoyo ogufaananako Kristo kyokka, wabula lye linnya ery'Omwoyo Omutukuvu) tali wuwe.” Omuntu ayinza okuba omukkiriza atatuukiridde, naye bw'aba ng'akkiriza Yesu Kristo, ng'azaaliddwa omulundi ogwokubiri, Omwoyo wa Katonda abeera mu ye. Kirabika okuva mu Ebbaluwa eyasooka ey'Abakkolinso nti abakkiriza ab'e Kolinso baali tebatuukiridde nnyo; baali bajjudde obutali butuukirivu, era mwalimu ekibi ekinene.

Wabula, Pawulo abagamba nti bali yeekaalu z'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ne bw'aba abanenya ku by'obugwenyufu obw'ekivve.

(Laba 1 Abakkolinso 6:15-19.) Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu buli mwana wa Katonda. Naye mu bamu, abeera mu buziba obw'ennyini obw'omwoyo gwabwe, awatali kwetegereza. Takkirizibwa kutwala omuntu yenna nga bw'ayagala, omwoyo, emmeeme, n'omubiri. Noolwekyo, abamu tebeetegereza bulungi nti abeera mu bo, kyokka aba mu bo. Ndowooza nga ya kitiibwa, era nga ya ssanyu, nti mu nze mubeeramu Oyo ow'ekitiibwa, Omwoyo Omutukuvu! Bwe tuba abaana ba Katonda, tekitugwanira nnyo kusaba nti Omwoyo ajje abeere mu ffe, kubanga ekyo akikola dda, wabula kitugwanira okwetegereza obubeezi bwe, obubeera bwe obw'ekisa era obw'ekitiibwa, n'okumuwa okufuga kwonna okw'ennyumba mw'abeera dda, n'okufuba okubeera obutanakuwaza Oyo omutukuvu, Omugenyi ono ow'Obwakatonda.

Kyokka kituufu okusaba okujjuzibwa oba okubatizibwa n'Omwoyo. Ndowooza ki gy'etuwa ku bwatukuvu n'obutukuvu obw'omubiri, okulowooza nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera munda mu ffe! Nga kitugwanira okukuuma emibiri gino n'obwegendereza, era nga kitugwanira okwewala buli kintu ekigyonoona. Nga kitugwanira okutambulira mu byonna n'obwegendereza tuleme okunakuwaza Oyo abeera munda mu ffe.

Omwoyo ono abeera mu ffe ye nsulo ey'okumatira n'obulamu okujjuvu era obutaggwaawo. Yesu agamba mu Yokaana 4:14 nti, “buli anywa ku mazzi ge ndimuwa talirumwa nnyonta emirembe gyonna. Amazzi ge ndimuwa galifuuka mu ye ensulo ey'amazzi agabimbula okutuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.” Yesu yali ayogera n'omukazi Omusamaliya ku luzzi olw'e Sukali.

Yali amugambye nti, “Ggwe oli mukulu okusinga jjajjaffe Yakobo? Ye yatuwa oluzzi, n'anywa ku lwo yekka, n'abaana be n'ente ze.” Awo Yesu n'amugamba nti, “Buli anywa ku mazzi ge ndimuwa talirumwa nnyonta emirembe gyonna.” Nga kino kya mazima ku buli nsulo ey'oku nsi! Ka tunywe nnyo tutya, tulirumwa nnyonta nate. Tewali nsulo ya ku nsi ey'okumatira ematira ddala. Tuyinza okunywa ku nsulo ey'obugagga nga bwe tusobola, naye tekimatiza kumala bbanga. Tulirumwa nnyonta nate.

Tuyinza okunywa ku nsulo ey'ettutumu nga omuntu yenna bwe yali anywa, naye okumatira kwa saawa emu yokka. Tuyinza okunywa ku nsulo ey'amasanyu g'ensi, ku by'amagezi n'ennono z'abantu, n'okuyiga okw'oku nsi; tuyinza n'okunywa ku nsulo ey'okwagala kw'abantu, naye tewali kirimatiza kumala bbanga; tulirumwa nnyonta nate.

Naye awo Yesu n'agamba nti, “Naye buli anywa ku mazzi ge ndimuwa talirumwa nnyonta emirembe gyonna. Amazzi ge ndimuwa galifuuka mu ye ensulo ey'amazzi agabimbula okutuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.” Amazzi Yesu Kristo g'awa ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Yokaana 7:37-39 wagamba nti, “Ku lunaku olw'enkomerero olw'embaga, olunaku olukulu, Yesu n'ayimirira n'ayogera mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka nti, 'Omuntu yenna bw'aba alumwa ennyonta, ajje gye ndi anywe. Buli anzikiriza, ng'Ebyawandiikibwa bwe byagamba, mu mutima gwe mulikulukuta emigga gy'amazzi amalamu.' (Kino yakyogera ku Mwoyo, abo abaamukkiriza gwe baali ba kufuna.)”

Omwoyo Omutukuvu amatiza ddala era emirembe gyonna oyo amufuna. Afuuka mu ye oluzzi olw'amazzi agabimbula, agabimbula bulijjo, okutuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo. Kikulu nnyo okuba n'oluzzi lw'oyinza okutambula nalwo; okuba n'oluzzi olubeera munda mu ggwe; okuba n'ensibuko yo ey'okumatira, si mu bintu ebiri ebweru wo, wabula mu luzzi olubeera munda era olubeera munda bulijjo, era olubimbula bulijjo mu buggya ne mu maanyi; okuba n'oluzzi lwaffe olw'okumatira n'essanyu munda mu ffe.

Awo tuba tetweralize ku mbeera z'ebitwetoolodde. Tekikulu nnyo oba tulina obulamu oba obulwadde, obugaggawaze oba obwavu; ensibuko yaffe ey'essanyu eri munda era ebimbula bulijjo. Tekikulu nnyo n'okuba oba tuli ne mikwano gyaffe oba twawukanyiziddwa nabo, ka tube ne twawukanyiziddwa olw'okufa; ensulo eno eri munda ebimbula bulijjo, n'emmeeme zaffe ne zimatira. Oluusi ensulo eno ebimbula n'amaanyi mangi era n'obujjuvu ku nnaku ez'ennaku ezisingira ddala. Mu kiseera ekifaanana bwe kityo, okumatira kwonna okw'oku nsi kugwa. Kumatira ki okuliwo mu ssente, mu masanyu g'ensi, mu ttiyeeta, mu ennyimba, mu kuzina, mu ttutumu, mu buyinza, oba mu kuyiga kw'abantu, omwagalwa waffe bw'atwalibwa okuva gye tuli? Naye mu ssaawa abo be twayagalanga ennyo ku nsi lwe batwalibwa okuva gye tuli, kwe kuba nti ensulo ey'essanyu ey'Omwoyo wa Katonda abeera mu ffe ebimbula n'obujjuvu obungi ennyo, ennaku n'okusinda ne biddukira ewala, n'emyoyo gyaffe ne gijjuzibwa emirembe n'essanyu erisukkiridde.

Tulina obulungi mu kifo ky'evvu, amafuta ag'essanyu mu kifo ky'okukungubaga, n'ekyambalo eky'ettendo mu kifo ky'omwoyo ogunyoluwazibwa (Isaaya 61:3). Singa okumanyako kuno tekwabanga kutukuvu nnyo okukuwandiika, nnandibadde nnyinza okwogera ku kaseera akaali ak'ennaku ey'amangu era ey'okuzikiriza, we kyafaananira nga nnaabetentebwa, we nnaakaabira waggulu mu bulumi obwafaananira ng'obutayinzika kugumiikirizibwa, awo mu bwangu era mu kaseera ako ensulo eno ey'Omwoyo Omutukuvu munda n'ebimbula, ne mmanya okuwummula n'essanyu bye nnali sitegeeranga bulungi edda, era omubiri gwange gwonna ne gujjuzibwa amafuta ag'essanyu. Oyo alina Omwoyo wa Katonda ng'abeera munda mu ye ng'oluzzi olubimbula okutuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo teyeeralize ku masanyu g'ensi. Teyeetaaga kudduka ng'agenda mu ttiyeeta, mu ennyimba, mu kuzina, mu makaadi, ne mu masanyu amalala, agaawatali obulamu bulabika ng'obutagasa eri abo abatafunanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Ebintu bino abireka, si nnyo olw'okuba alowooza nti bibi, wabula olw'okuba alina ekintu ekisinga obulungi ennyo. Afiirwa okubyagala kwonna.

Omukyala omu yajja eri Mr. Moody n'amugamba nti, “Mr. Moody, sikwagala.” N'amubuuza nti, “Lwaki nedda?” N'agamba nti, “Kubanga oli mufunda nnyo.” “Mufunda! Sategedde nga ndi mufunda.” “Yee, oli mufunda nnyo. Tokkiriza ttiyeeta; tokkiriza makaadi; tokkiriza kuzina.” “Omanyi otya nti sikkiriza ttiyeeta?” n'abuuza. “Nedda,” n'agamba, “mmanyi nga tokkiriza.” Mr. Moody n'addamu nti, “Ndaga mu ttiyeeta buli lwe njagala.” “Ki?” omukazi n'aleekaana, “olaga mu ttiyeeta buli lw'oyagala?” “Yee, ndaga mu ttiyeeta buli lwe njagala.” “Owange,” n'agamba, “Mr. Moody, oli musajja mugazi okusinga bwe nnali nkulowoozeza. Nsanyuse nnyo okukuwulira ng'oyogera nti olaga mu ttiyeeta buli lwe oyagala.” “Yee, ndaga mu ttiyeeta buli lwe njagala. Naye sijja kwagala.”

Buli afunye Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw'abeera awatali kuziyizibwa mu mulimu gwe, tajja kubyagala. Lwaki Abakristaayo bangi bwe batyo bagoberera amasanyu g'ensi gano?

Olw'ensonga emu ku bbiri: oba kubanga tebaafunanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu mu bujjuvu, oba kubanga ensulo eziyizibbwa. Ensulo eyinza okuziyizibwa. Oluzzi olusinga obulungi mu kimu ku bibuga byaffe eby'omunda lwaziyizibwa era ne lukalira okumala emyezi mingi kubanga akaguoya k'ekiwempe akakadde kaali kakwecceddwa mu kituli amazzi we gaakulukutiranga. Akaguoya bwe kaggyibwamu, amazzi ne gaddamu okukulukuta, nga malongoofu era nga mannyogovu.

Bangi mu Kkanisa leero baamanya edda essanyu ery'Omwoyo Omutukuvu eritagerageranyizika, naye ekibi ekimu oba okwefaananyiriza ensi, ekikolwa ekimu eky'obujeemu, obujeemu obumanyiddwa oba obutamanyiddwa eri Katonda, kyayingira, n'ensulo n'eziyizibwa. Ka tuggyeewo obuguoya obukadde leero ensulo eno ey'ekyewuunyo eddemu okubimbula, ng'ebimbula buli lunaku na buli ssaawa okutuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.

fields.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu Anunula Omukkiriza okuva mu Maanyi g'Ekibi Ekibeera mu Ye
fields.body_html:
Mu Abaruumi 8:2, Omutume Pawulo awandiika nti, “Kubanga etteeka ery'Omwoyo ow'obulamu likufudde[a] wa ddembe mu Kristo Yesu okuva mu tteeka ery'ekibi n'okufa.” Etteeka ery'ekibi n'okufa kye kiki tukisoma mu ssuula eyakulembera, okuva ku lunyiriri olw'omwenda okutuuka ku olw'amakumi abiri mu luna. Pawulo atugamba nti waaliwo ekiseera mu bulamu bwe we yali “mulamu awatali tteeka” (olunyiriri 9). Naye ekiseera kyatuuka lwe yatuuzibwa amaaso n'amaaso n'etteeka lya Katonda; n'alaba nga etteeka lino litukuvu n'ekiragiro nga kitukuvu era nga kya bwenkanya era nga kirungi. N'amalirira mu mutima okukwata etteeka lino lya Katonda ettukuvu era ery'obwenkanya era erirungi. Naye amangu n'azuula nti okuliraana etteeka lino lya Katonda eriri ebweru we, eritukuvu era ery'obwenkanya era erirungi, waaliwo etteeka eddala munda mu ye erikontanira ddala n'etteeka lino lya Katonda eriri ebweru we.

Etteeka lya Katonda eriri ebweru bwe lyagamba nti, “Kino ekirungi” ne “kino ekirungi” ne “kino ekirungi” ne “kino ekirungi olikola,” etteeka eriri munda mu ye ne ligamba nti, “Toyinza kukola kino ekirungi ky'oyagala;” ne wabaawo olutalo olw'amaanyi wakati w'etteeka lino ettukuvu era ery'obwenkanya era erirungi eriri ebweru we, Pawulo yennyini lye yasiima mu muntu ow'omunda, n'etteeka lino eddala eriri mu bitundu by'omubiri gwe eryalwananga n'etteeka ery'omwoyo gwe, era eryagamba obutakoma nti, “Toyinza kukola kirungi ky'oyagala.” Naye etteeka lino eriri mu bitundu by'omubiri gwe (etteeka nti ekirungi kye yayagala okukola teyakikola, naye ekibi kye yatayagala kye yakolanga bulijjo, olun. 19) lye lyawangula.

Pawulo bwe yagezaako okukwata etteeka lya Katonda, yagwa ddala. Kya nkizo ky'omwana wa Katonda mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okuba n'obuwanguzi ku kibi buli lunaku, na buli ssaawa, na buli kaseera.

Buli lunaku lunaku lwa kuwangulwa, era bwe batunuulira obulamu bwabwe ku nkomerero y'olunaku, kibagwanira okukaaba nti, “Woowe, omuntu wa nnaku nze! Ani alimponya omubiri guno ogw'okufa?” Abamu batuuka n'okugamba nti buno bwe bulamu obwa bulijjo obw'Omukristaayo, naye Pawulo atugamba mu bujjuvu nti kino kyaliwo “ekiragiro bwe kyajja” (olun. 9), so si Omwoyo bwe yajja; nti kwe kumanyako okw'omu tteeka, so si mu Mwoyo. Akabonero “nze” kalabika emirundi amakumi abiri mu musanvu mu nnyiriri kkumi na ttaano zino, ne Omwoyo Omutukuvu talabikako n'omulundi gumu, ate mu ssuula eya munaana ey'Abaruumi, akabonero “nze” kalabika emirundi ebiri byokka mu ssuula yonna, ne Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'alabika obutakoma.

Nate, Pawulo atugamba mu lunyiriri olw'ekkumi n'olwokuna nti kuno kwali kumanyako kwe nga “wa mubiri, atundiddwa mu buddu bw'ekibi.”

Mazima ddala, ekyo tekinnyonnyola kumanyako kwa Mukristaayo okwa bulijjo. Ku luuyi olulala, mu Abaruumi 8:9, tuyigirizibwa engeri gye tutaba mu mubiri wabula mu Mwoyo. Mu ssuula eya munaana ey'Abaruumi, tulina ekifaananyi eky'obulamu obwa Mukristaayo obw'amazima, obulamu obusoboka eri buli omu ku ffe era Katonda bw'asuubira okuva eri buli omu ku ffe. Wano tulina obulamu ekiragiro we kitajja kyokka, naye n'Omwoyo we ajja, n'akolera okugonda ekiragiro, n'atuleetera obuwanguzi obujjuvu ku tteeka ery'ekibi n'okufa.

Tulina obulamu, si mu mubiri, naye mu Mwoyo, gye tutalaba obulungi bw'etteeka kyokka (Abaruumi 7:22) naye Omwoyo we atuwa amaanyi okulikwata (Abaruumi 8:4). Tukyalina omubiri naye tetuli mu mubiri era tetutambulira mu mubiri. “Olw'Omwoyo tutta ebikolwa by'omubiri” (olun. 13). Okwegomba kw'omubiri kukyaliwo, okwandituwadde etteeka ery'obulamu bwaffe, ne kutuleeta mu kibi, naye buli lunaku olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo tutta ebikolwa okwegomba kw'omubiri kwe kwandituleese. Tutambulira mu Mwoyo, noolwekyo tetutuukiriza kwegomba kwa mubiri (Abaggalatiya 5:16). Twakomeredde omubiri awamu n'okwegomba kwagwo n'okwegomba kwakwo (Abaggalatiya 5:24). Naye obuwanguzi buno tebuli mu ffe, so si mu maanyi gaffe gonna. Bwe tulekebwa ffekka, nga twabuliriddwa Omwoyo wa Katonda, twandibadde abanafu nga bulijjo. Kubanga mmanyi nga mu nze, kwe kugamba mu mubiri gwange, temubeeramu kirungi.

(Abaruumi 7:18). Kyonna kiri mu maanyi g'Omwoyo abeera mu ffe, naye amaanyi g'Omwoyo gayinza okuba mu bujjuvu obungi ennyo omuntu n'atatuula na kwetegereza kubaawo kw'omubiri. Kifaanana ng'omubiri gufudde era ne gugenda emirembe gyonna, naye gukuumibwa mu kifo ky'okufa amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu gokka. Singa akaseera akatono tuggya amaaso gaffe ku Yesu Kristo, singa tulagajjalira okusoma kw'ekigambo n'okusaba kwa buli lunaku, twandigudde. Obulamu bw'Omwoyo obubeera mu ffe bulina okukuumibwa okuyita mu kusoma kw'ekigambo ne mu kusaba. Ekimu ku bintu ebisaalizisa ennyo bye tutuuseeko kwe ngeri abantu abamu abayingidde mu bulamu obw'obuwanguzi olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo bwe bafuuka ab'okwesiga mwene ne balowooza nti obuwanguzi buli mu bo, era nga bayinza mirembe okulagajjalira okusoma kw'ekigambo n'okusaba. Obuziba abantu ng'abo mwe bagwa oluusi butiisa. Buli omu ku ffe yeetaaga okuteeka mu mutima gwe ebigambo by'Omutume ebyaluŋŋamizibwa nti, “Kale oyo alowooza nti ayimiridde yeekuume aleme okugwa.” (1 Abakkolinso 10:12).

Nnamanya omusajja omu eyafaananira ng'atambula mu bulamu obwa Kristo mu bwangu obw'ekitalo. Yafuuka omuyigiriza w'abalala era n'aweebwa omukisa mu bantu enkumi n'enkumi. Kyandabikira nga afuuka ow'okwesiga mwene, ne mmutiira. Ne mmuyita mu kisenge kyange ne twogera ekiseera ekiwanvu ffembi nga twogera ebiri mu mutima. Ne mmugamba mu bwesimbu nti kifaanana ng'agenda kumpi nnyo n'ekifo eky'akabi akasukkiridde. Ne ndaga nti ndaba nga kya bulabe okusinga ku nkomerero ya buli lunaku obutaba mwesigi nnyo nti tewabaddewo kugwa oba kuwangulwa ku lunaku olwo naye okugenda nga ndi wenkka ne Katonda ne mmusaba anoonye omutima gwange andage oba wabaddewo ekintu mu bulamu bwange obw'ebweru oba obw'omunda ekitamusanyusa, era ng'emirundi mingi okugwa kwaggibwako mu kitangaala kwe kugwanidde okwatulwa nga kibi. “Nedda,” n'addamu, “sseetaaga kukikola. Ne bwe nnaakola ekintu ekikyamu, nnaakiraba mangu.

Bwe tutaliira ku kigambo, tetutambulira mu Mwoyo, era tetujja kuba n'obuwanguzi ku mubiri ne ku kibi.

fields.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu Abumba Kristo Munda mu Ffe
fields.body_html:
Kye kusaba okw'ekyewuunyo era okw'amakulu amangi Pawulo kw'asaba mu Abaefeso 3:16-19 ku lw'abakkiriza ab'e Efeso ne ku lw'abakkiriza bonna abasoma Ebbaluwa. Pawulo awandiika nti, “Olw'ensonga eno mfukamiza amaviivi gange eri Kitaffe, gwe buli kika mu ggulu ne ku nsi kwe kituumibwa erinnya lyakwo, alyoke abawe, ng'obugagga bw'ekitiibwa kye bwe buli, okunywezebwa n'amaanyi olw'Omwoyo we mu muntu ow'omunda, Kristo alyoke abeere mu mitima gyammwe olw'okukkiriza, mmwe, ng'musimbiddwa emirandira era ng'muzimbiddwa ku kwagala, mulyoke musobole okutegeera awamu n'abatukuvu bonna obugazi n'obuwanvu n'obugulumivu n'obuziba, n'okumanya okwagala kwa Kristo okusukka okumanya, mulyoke mujjuzibwe okutuuka ku bujjuvu bwonna obwa Katonda.”

Wano tulina okweyongera mu birowoozo okusinga ku ekyo kye twakamala okusoma mu ssuula eyakulembera. Kwe kutuukiriza omulimu ogwakulembera. Wano, amaanyi g'Omwoyo galaga, si mu kutuwa buwanguzi ku kibi kyokka, wabula mu bintu bina: I. Mu Kristo okubeera mu mitima gyaffe. Ekigambo ekivvuunulwa nti “okubeera” mu kyawandiikibwa kino kya maanyi nnyo. Kitegeeza ddala nti “okubeera wansi,” “okuteeka amakanda,” “okubeera mu buziba.” Gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okubumba Kristo omulamu munda mu ffe, ng'abeera mu buziba obw'ennyini obw'obuntu bwaffe. Twalaba dda nti kino kyali kimu ku makulu g'erinnya oluusi erituumibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, “Omwoyo wa Kristo.” Mu Kristo ku musaalaba ogw'e Kalvari, eyafuulibwa ekiweebwayo eky'okutangirira ekibi, ng'atwala ekikolimo eky'etteeka eryamenyebwa mu kifo kyaffe, tulina Kristo ku lwaffe. Naye olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ge Kristo eyazuukira ge yatuwa, tulina Kristo mu ffe. Muno mwe muli ekyama eky'obulamu obufaanana Kristo.

Essuula 12. Omwoyo Omutukuvu Abumba Kristo Munda mu Ffe. Tuwulira nnyo mu nnaku zino ku kukola nga Yesu bwe yandikoze. Mazima ddala, ng'Abakristaayo, kitugwanira okubeera n'obulamu nga Kristo. “Oyo agamba nti abeera mu ye kimugwanira naye okutambula nga bw'atambula” (1 Yokaana 2:6). Naye okugezaako kwonna ku luuyi lwaffe okukoppa Kristo mu maanyi gaffe kunaavaamu kunakuwala n'okuggwaamu essuubi. Tewali kintu kitaliimu makulu ng'okugezaako okukoppa Kristo mu maanyi g'okwagala kwaffe. Bwe twerowoozako nti tuwangudde, kinaaba kubanga tulina okumanya Kristo okutatuukiridde. Gye tumusinga okusoma, ne gye tusinga okutegeera ebikolwa bye mu bujjuvu, gye tunaasinga okulaba obuwanvu bwe twesuddeko okukoppa Kristo. Naye Katonda tatusaba kya butayinzika; tatusaba kukoppa Kristo mu maanyi gaffe. Atuwa ekintu ekisinga obulungi ennyo obutayinzika kupimibwa. Atuwa okubumba Kristo mu ffe olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo we Omutukuvu.

Era Kristo bw'abumbibwa bw'atyo mu ffe olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kye tugwanira kukola kwe kuleka Kristo ono abeera mu ffe abeere n'obulamu bwe ye munda mu ffe, ne tulyoka tufaanana Kristo awatali kulwana na kufuba kwaffe. Omukazi eyalina okumanya kw'ekigambo okuwanvu n'okumanyako okutali kwa bulijjo ku bujjuvu obuli mu Kristo, yayimirira lumu ku makya mu maaso g'ekibiina ky'abaweereza nga bamubuuza ebibuuzo. “Ogamba nti, Mrs. H——,” omu ku baweereza n'abuuza, “nti oli mutukuvu?” Mangu naye n'obuwombeefu n'obukkakkamu, omukyala omulonde n'addamu nti, “Kristo ali mu nze ye mutukuvu.” Nedda, tetuli batukuvu. Okutuusa ku nkomerero, ffe mu ffe fekka tujjudde obunafu n'okugwa, naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayinza okubumba munda mu ffe Omutukuvu owa Katonda, Kristo abeera mu ffe, era anaabeera n'obulamu bwe okuyita mu ffe mu nkolagana ez'obwetoolo ezisembayo n'ezo ezitwalibwa ng'enkulu ennyo. Anaabeera n'obulamu bwe okuyita mu maama mu maka, okuyita mu mupakasi mu bunnya, okuyita mu musuubuzi mu ofiisi ye, buli wamu.

II. Mu ffe okusimbibwa emirandira era okuzimbibwa ku kwagala (olun. 17). Pawulo akozesa ebifaananyi bibiri wano; ekifaananyi ekisooka kiggibwa ku muti ogusimba emirandira gyagwo wansi mu ttaka ne gunywerera. Ekifaananyi ekyokubiri kiggibwa ku kizimbe ekinene, n'emisingi gyakyo egisimbiddwa mu buziba mu ttaka ku lwazi. Noolwekyo, Pawulo atugamba nti olw'okunywezebwa Omwoyo mu muntu ow'omunda, tusimba emirandira gy'obulamu bwaffe wansi mu ttaka ery'okwagala, era n'emisingi gy'ekizimbe eky'empisa zaffe gizimbibwa ku lwazi olw'okwagala. Okwagala kwe kutuukiriza kw'obutukuvu, okutuukiriza etteeka (Abaruumi 13:10); okwagala kwe kye twetaaga fenna ennyo mu nkolagana yaffe eri Katonda, eri Yesu Kristo, ne wakati waffe fekka; era gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okusimba n'okunyweza obulamu bwaffe mu kwagala.

Waliwo enkolagana ey'oku lusegere ennyo wakati wa Kristo okubumbibwa munda mu ffe, oba okufuulibwa okubeera mu ffe, ne ffe okusimbibwa emirandira n'okuzimbibwa mu kwagala, kubanga Yesu Kristo yennyini ye njjulwa entuukirivu ey'okwagala okw'obwakatonda.

III. Mu ffe okufuulibwa ab'amaanyi okutegeera awamu n'abatukuvu bonna obugazi, obuwanvu, obugulumivu, n'obuziba, n'okumanya okwagala kwa Kristo okusukka okumanya. Tekimala nti twagala; kitugwanira okumanya okwagala kwa Kristo, naye okwagala okwo kusukka okumanya. Kugazi, kuwanvu, kugulumivu, era kuziba nnyo nti tewali n'omu ayinza kukutegeera bujjuvu. Naye tuyinza “okukukwatako,” okukunyweza, n'okukufuula obwaffe; tuyinza okukukwata mu maaso gaffe ng'ekyo kye tulowoozaako, kye twewuunyaako, era kye tusanyukira. Naye kiba mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu gokka mwe tuyinza okukukwatako bwe tutyo. Amagezi tegayinza kukukwata mu maanyi gaago obuzaaliranwa. Omuntu atayigirizibwa era atanyweza Mwoyo wa Katonda ayinza okwogera ku kwagala kwa Kristo, n'akuwandiikako ennyimba, n'akwenyumiririzaamu, naye biba bigambo byokka. Tewali kutegeera kwa nnamaddala. Naye Omwoyo wa Katonda atufuula ab'amaanyi okukukwata mu bugazi bwakwo bwonna, obuwanvu, obuziba, n'obugulumivu.

IV. Mu ffe “okujjuzibwa okutuuka ku bujjuvu BWONNA obwa Katonda.” Waliwo enkyukakyuka enkulu nnyo wakati w'Enfuula ey'Edda n'Enfuula Empya. Enfuula ey'Edda esoma nti, “Okujjuzibwa obujjuvu bwonna obwa Katonda.”

Enfuula Empya esoma bulungi ennyo nti, “okujjuzibwa okutuuka ku bujjuvu bwonna obwa Katonda.” Tekyewuunyisa nti abavvuunuzi Essuula 12. Omwoyo Omutukuvu Abumba Kristo Munda mu Ffe. Enfuula ey'Edda beetiira ku ekyo Pawulo kye yagamba ne bagezaako okukendeeza ku maanyi g'ebigambo bye. Okujjuzibwa obujjuvu bwonna obwa Katonda tekyandibadde kya kyewuunyo nnyo, kubanga kyangu okujjuza ekikopo eky'obutundu obw'obujjuvu bwonna obw'ennyanja, okusuula omulundi gumu kikola ekyo. Naye kyandibadde kya butayinzika ddala okujjuza ekikopo eky'obutundu okutuuka ku bujjuvu bwonna obw'ennyanja, okutuusa obujjuvu bwonna obuli mu nnyanja lwe bubeera mu kikopo ekyo eky'obutundu.

Naye kifaanana ng'omulimu ogusinga obutayinzika Omwoyo Omutukuvu gw'agezaako okutukolera, okutujjuza “okutuuka ku bujjuvu bwonna” obwa Katonda atagera, okutujjuza okutuusa obujjuvu bwonna obw'amagezi n'obw'empisa obuli mu Katonda lwe bubeera mu ffe. Naye kuno kwe kufaana kw'omukkiriza, tuli “basika ba Katonda, era basika awamu ne Yesu Kristo” (Abaruumi 8:17), kwe kugamba, tuli basika ba Katonda okutuuka we Yesu Kristo w'ali omusika wa Katonda; kwe kugamba, tuli basika ba byonna Katonda by'ali era byonna Katonda by'alina. Gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okututeekako ekyo ekiri kyaffe dda mu Kristo. Gwe mulimu gwe okufuula obwaffe mu kumanyako byonna Katonda by'alina era byonna Katonda by'ali, okutuusa omulimu lwe gutuukirira mu ffe okujjuzibwa “okutuuka ku bujjuvu bwonna obwa Katonda.” Guno si mulimu gwa kaseera, wadde olunaku, wadde wiiki, wadde mwezi, wadde mwaka, naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu buli lunaku ateeka omukono gwe, ng'ekyokulabirako, mu bujjuvu obwa Katonda, n'atuleetera kye ggyeemu, n'akiteeka mu ffe, ate n'addamu okuteeka omukono gwe mu bujjuvu obuli mu Katonda, n'atuleetera kye ggyeemu, n'akiteeka mu ffe, era omulimu guno ogw'ekyewuunyo gweyongera buli lunaku, na buli wiiki, na buli mwezi, na buli mwaka, ne gutakoma okutuusa lwe tujjuzibwa “okutuuka ku bujjuvu bwonna obwa Katonda.”

fields.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu Aleeta mu Mukkiriza Empisa Enkulungirivu Ezifaanana Kristo
fields.body_html:
Waliwo obulungi obw'enjawulo omuntu bw'atayinza kunnyonnyola bulungi, mu bigambo bya Pawulo mu Abaggalatiya 5:22-23, “Ekibala ky'Omwoyo kwe kwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, ekisa, obulungi, obwesigwa, obuwombeefu, okwefuga; awatali tteeka eriwakanya ebintu ng'ebyo.” Nga kino kye kiwandiiko eky'engeri ez'empisa ennungi! Pawulo atugamba nti kye kibala ky'Omwoyo; kwe kugamba, Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'aweebwa okufuga obulamu bwaffe, kino kye kibala ky'anaabala. Obulungi bwonna obw'amazima obw'empisa, okufaanana Kristo kwonna okw'amazima mu ffe, gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu; kye kibala kye; ye akireeta; ye akibala, si ffe.

Kirungi okwetegereza nti empisa zino tezyogerwako ng'ebibala by'Omwoyo naye ng'ekibala, kwe kugamba, Omwoyo bw'aweebwa okufuga obulamu bwaffe, tajja kubala mu muntu omu emu ku zino ng'ekibala ne mu muntu omulala eyawukanako, naye kino kye kibala ekimu ekirimu okuwoomereza kungi ky'abala mu buli omu. Waliwo n'obumu obw'ensibuko obuli mu bulabika obw'engeri nnyingi. Bwe bulamu obulungi obunnyonnyolwa mu nnyiriri zino. Buli kigambo kisaanira okusomebwa n'obunyiikivu n'okulowoozebwako mu buziba. Lowooza ku bigambo bino kimu kimu: “essanyu,” “emirembe,” “obugumiikiriza,” “ekisa,” “obulungi,” oba “obwesigwa.” Okukkiriza kwe kuvvuunula okusinga obulungi bwe kutegeerwa bulungi. Ekigambo kya buziba okusinga obwesigwa.

Kwe kukkiriza okw'amazima okuvaamu obwesigwa. “Obuwombeefu,” “okwefuga” (oba obulamu obufugibwa bulungi olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu). Wano tulina ekifaananyi ekituukiridde eky'obulamu bwa Yesu Kristo yennyini. Buno si bwe bulamu fenna bwe twegomba, obulamu obufaanana Kristo? Naye obulamu buno tebwa buzaaliranwa gye tuli era tetuyinza kubutuukako olw'okufuba kwonna okw'ekyo kye tuli mu ffe.

Obulamu obwa buzaaliranwa gye tuli bunnyonnyolwa mu nnyiriri essatu ezikulembera: “Kaakano ebikolwa by'omubiri bya lwatu, bye bino: obwenzi, obutali bulongoofu, obukaba, okusinza bakatonda abalala, obulogo, obulabe, ennyombo, obuggya, obusungu, okuyawukana, ettima, obutamiivu, ebinyumu, n'ebifaanana ng'ebyo” (Abaggalatiya 5:21). Ebikolwa bino byonna eby'omubiri tebijja kweraga mu buli muntu; ebimu binaayolekera mu omu, ebirala mu balala, naye birina ensibuko emu, gwe mubiri, era bwe tubeera mu mubiri, buno bwe bulamu bwe tunaabeeranga.

Bwe bulamu obwa buzaaliranwa gye tuli, naye Omwoyo abeera mu ffe bw'aweebwa okufuga okujjuvu mu oyo mw'abeera, bwe tutuusibwa okutegeera obubi obw'ennyini obw'omubiri ne tuwaayo mu kuggwaamu essuubi okutuuka ku kintu kyonna mu maanyi gaagwo, kwe kugamba, bwe tutuuka ku nkomerero yaffe, ne tuwaayo omulimu gwonna ogw'okutufuula nga bwe tugwanidde okuba eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, awo empisa zino entukuvu, ezinnyonnyolwa mu Abaggalatiya 5:22-23, ze zibeera ekibala kye mu bulamu bwaffe. Oyagala empisa zino mu mpisa zo ne mu bulamu bwo? Kale weegaane ddala wekka n'okulwana kwo kwonna okunoonya obutukuvu, oleke ekirowoozo kyonna nti oyinza okutuuka ku kintu kyonna eky'empisa ennungi mu maanyi go, oleke Omwoyo Omutukuvu, abeera dda mu ggwe (bw'oba oli mwana wa Katonda), atwale okufuga okujjuvu, abale ekibala kye eky'ekitiibwa mu bulamu bwo obwa buli lunaku.

Tufuna ekirowoozo kye kimu okuva ku ludda olulala mu Abaggalatiya 2:20: “Nakomererwa awamu ne Kristo. Si nze nkyali omulamu, wabula Kristo abeera mu nze. N'obulamu bwe nkyalimu mu mubiri mbulamu lwa kukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda, eyanjagala ne yeewaayo ku lwange.” Tuwulira nnyo mu nnaku zino ku “Kulima Empisa,” ekitera okutegeeza okulima omubiri okutuusa lwe gubala ekibala ky'Omwoyo. Tekiyinzika; nga bwe kitayinzika amaggwa okuleeta ettiini n'ekisaka eky'amaggwa okuleeta ezzabbibu (Lukka 6:44, Matayo 12:33).

Tuwulira nnyo n'okwogera ku “kuzimba mpisa.” Ojjukira nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu y'alina okuzimba, era ne bwe kiba bwe kityo, si kuzimba nnyo wabula kubala bibala. (Kyokka laba 2 Peetero 1:5-7.) Tuwulira nnyo n'okwogera ku “kulima empisa ennungi,” naye kitugwanira okukuuma bulungi mu birowoozo nti engeri ey'okulima empisa ennungi ez'amazima kwe kwewaayo ffennyini ddala eri Omwoyo akole omulimu gwe abale ekibala kye. Kuno kwe “kutukuzibwa okw'Omwoyo” (1 Peetero 1:2, 1 Abasessaloniika 2:13).

Waliwo kyokka amakulu gye kituufu okulima empisa ennungi: tutunuulira Yesu Kristo tulabe ky'ali era ffe kye tugwanira okuba; awo tutunuulira Omwoyo Omutukuvu atufuule kino kye tugwanira okuba, era bwe tutyo, “Naye ffe fenna, nga twekweseeko amaaso agatali na kibikka, nga twakataba mu ndabirwamu ekitiibwa kya Mukama, tufuulibwa ekifaananyi kye kyekimu okuva mu kitiibwa okutuuka ku kitiibwa. Kubanga kino kiva eri Mukama, ye Mwoyo.” (2 Abakkolinso 3:18). Kyokka teekawo mu bujjuvu era emirembe gyonna nti omubiri teguyinza kubala kibala kino, nti toyinza kutuuka ku bintu bino olw'okufuba kwo, nti bye “bibala by'Omwoyo.”

Pawulo atugamba nti kye kibala ky'Omwoyo; kwe kugamba, Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'aweebwa okufuga obulamu bwaffe, kino kye kibala ky'anaabala. Obulungi bwonna obw'amazima obw'empisa, okufaanana Kristo kwonna okw'amazima mu ffe, gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu; kye kibala kye; ye akireeta; ye akibala, si ffe. Waliwo n'obumu obw'ensibuko obuli mu bulabika obw'engeri nnyingi. Bwe bulamu obulungi obunnyonnyolwa mu nnyiriri zino. Buli kigambo kisaanira okusomebwa n'obunyiikivu n'okulowoozebwako mu buziba. fields.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu Aluŋŋamya Omukkiriza mu Bulamu ng'Omwana
fields.body_html:
Omutume Pawulo awandiika mu Abaruumi 8:14 nti, “Kubanga bonna abaluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda, abo baana ba Katonda.”

Mu kyawandiikibwa kino, tulaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'atwala okuluŋŋamya obulamu bw'omukkiriza. Obulamu obwa Mukristaayo obw'amazima bulamu obuluŋŋamizibwa omuntu ku bubwe, obuluŋŋamizibwa buli we buli Omuntu ow'Obwakatonda. Kya nkizo ky'omukkiriza okuteebwa mu ddembe okuva mu kweraliikirira kwonna, obweezi, n'okweraliikirira ku bisalawo bye tuteekwa okusalawo mu buli kifo eky'obulamu.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu atwala obuvunaanyizibwa obwo bwonna ku lwaffe.

Obulamu obwa Mukristaayo obw'amazima si bufugibwa amateeka amangi agali ebweru waffe, wabula buluŋŋamizibwa Omuntu omulamu era abeerawo bulijjo munda mu ffe. Mu nsonga eno Pawulo agamba nti, “Kubanga temwafuna mwoyo gwa buddu okudda nate mu kutya.” Obulamu obufugibwa amateeka agali ebweru w'omuntu bulamu bwa buddu. Buli kiseera waliwo okutya nti tetukoze mateeka mangi bulungi, era buli kiseera waliwo okutya nti mu kaseera akatali ka kwegendereza, tuyinza okuba nga twamenya amateeka amu ge twekolera. Obulamu Abakristaayo bangi bwe babeeramu bwa buddu obw'entiisa; kubanga beetese omugugu omuzito okusinga ogw'etteeka lya Musa ery'edda, Peetero kwe yayogera eri Abayudaaya ab'omu kiseera kye nti wadde bo wadde bakadde baabwe tebaayinza kugugumiikiriza (Ebikolwa 15:10).

Abakristaayo bangi balina olukalala oluwanvu olw'amateeka ge beekolera, era bwe bagwa ne bamenya limu ku mateeka gano ge beekolera, oba ne beerabira okukwata limu ku go, amangu bajjuzibwa okutya okw'entiisa nti beereese obusungu bwa Katonda (era oluusi balowooza nti bakoze ekibi ekitasonyiyibwa). Kino si Bukristaayo; buno bwesigamye ku mateeka. “Tetwafuna mwoyo gwa buddu nate okutya,” twafuna Omwoyo atuwa ekifo ky'abaana (Abaruumi 8:15).

Obulamu bwaffe tebusaanira kufugibwa mateeka agali ebweru waffe, wabula Omwoyo ow'okufuulibwa abaana ow'okwagala abeera munda mu ffe. Kitugwanira okukkiriza okuyigiriza kw'ekigambo kya Katonda nti Omwoyo ow'Omwana wa Katonda abeera munda mu ffe, era kitugwanira okuwaayo okufuga okujjuvu okw'obulamu bwaffe eri ye, ne tumutunuulira atuluŋŋamye mu buli kifo eky'obulamu. Anaakikola bwe tunaamuwaayo yekka akikole ne tumwesiga akikole. Bwe tunaagenda ekkubo lyaffe mu kifo ky'erirye mu kaseera ak'obutafaayo, tetujja kujjuzibwa okuwulira okunene okw'okusalirwa omusango n'okutya Katonda anyiize, wabula tunaagenda eri Katonda nga Kitaffe, tunaayatula okukyama kwaffe, tunaakkiriza nti atusonyiwa ddala kubanga bw'akigamba (1 Yokaana 1:9), ne tugenda mu maaso nga tuli bangu era nga tulina emitima emisanyufu okumugondera n'okuluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo we.

Okuluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda tekitegeeza n'akamu nti tujja kukola ebintu ekigambo kya Katonda ekyawandiikibwa bye kitugamba obutakola. Omwoyo Omutukuvu taluŋŋamya bantu mu ngeri ekontana n'Ekitabo ky'ali Omuwandiisi waakyo. Bwe wabaawo omwoyo ogutuluŋŋamya okukola ekintu ekikontana n'okuyigiriza okw'olwatu okwa Yesu oba okw'Abatume, tuyinza okuba abakakafu nti omwoyo guno ogutuluŋŋamya si Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Ensonga eno yeetaaga okunyweza mu biseera byaffe, kubanga tebassi batono abeewaayo eri okuluŋŋamizibwa omwoyo ogumu, gwe bagamba nti gwe Mwoyo Omutukuvu, naye ogubaluŋŋamya okukola ebintu ebigaanibwa mu lwatu mu kigambo. Kitugwanira okujjukira bulijjo nti emyoyo mingi egy'obulimba n'obannabbi ab'obulimba bangi bafulumye mu nsi (1 Yokaana 4:1). Bangi bagenda beeraliikirira nnyo okuluŋŋamizibwa amaanyi agatalabika ne baba beetegefu okuwaayo okuluŋŋamya obulamu bwabwe eri buli mwoyo oba omuntu atalabika. Mu ngeri eno, baggulawo obulamu bwabwe eri okuluŋŋamya n'okuvvoola kw'emyoyo emibi okuzikiriza obulamu bwabwe.

Omusajja eyeewaana nnyo obutukuvu lumu yajja gye ndi n'aŋŋamba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu yali amuluŋŋamya ye ne “omukazi Omukristaayo omuwoomu,” gwe yali asisinkanye, okulowooza ku bufumbo. “Naye,” ne ŋŋamba, nga nneewuunya, “omaze okuba n'omukazi omu.” “Yee,” n'agamba, “naye omanyi nga tetumanyagana bulungi, era tetumalanga myaka mingi wamu.” “Yee,” ne nziramu, “mmanyi nga temumaze myaka mingi mu bufumbo, era netunuulidde ensonga, era nkkiriza nti omusango ogw'ekyo guli ku ggwe nnyo. Ate era, mukazi wo. Tolina nsonga kulowooza nti akukoledde obutali bwesigwa, era Yesu Kristo ayigiriza nti bw'owasa omulala ng'akyali mulamu oyenda” (Lukka 16:18). “Naye,” omusajja n'agamba, “Omwoyo wa Katonda atuluŋŋamya okwagalana n'okulaba nti tusaanidde okufumbiriganwa.” “Olimba, era ovvoola,” ne nziramu.

“Buli mwoyo ogukuluŋŋamya okujeemera okuyigiriza okw'olwatu okwa Yesu Kristo si Mwoyo wa Katonda wabula mwoyo gumu gwa musajja Setaani.”

Kino kiyinza okuba nga kyali kya nsonga ya njawulo nnyo, naye ensonga ez'engeri y'emu tezitalabika. Abakristaayo bangi abeeyita batyo bagezaako okwewolereza mu kukola ebintu ebigaanibwa mu kigambo nga bagamba nti baluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda. Nnaalumiriza abakulembeze mu kkuŋŋaaniro ery'Ekikristaayo omwo mu buli kukuŋŋaana bangi mwe baayogeleranga ennimi mu kumenya kw'olwatu okuyigiriza kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okuyita mu Mutume Pawulo mu 1 Abakkolinso 14:27-28 (Omuntu bw'ayogera olulimi, babeere babiri oba obungi basatu, era buli omu mu mpalo ye, era waabewo abivvuunula. Naye bwe wataba n'omu ayinza okuvvuunula, buli omu asirike mu kkanisa era ayogere yekka ne Katonda). Bye baawoza kwe kugamba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu yabaluŋŋamya okwogera bangi mu kiseera kimu era bangi mu kukuŋŋaana kumu, era nti kibagwanira okugondera Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era mu mbeera nga eno, tebaali ba kufugibwa kigambo.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu tewewakanya. Taluŋŋamya muntu omu okukola ekyo mu kigambo ekyawandiikibwa kye yatulagira fenna obutakola. Okuluŋŋamya kwonna okw'Omwoyo kusaanira okugezesebwa n'ekyo kye tumanyi ng'okuluŋŋamya kw'Omwoyo mu kigambo. Wadde nga twetaaga okwekuuma eri okuluŋŋamya kw'emyoyo egy'obulimba, kya nkizo kyaffe okuluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n'okubeera n'obulamu obutaliimu buddu bwa mateeka na kweraliikirira nti tetujja kukyama, obulamu ng'obw'abaana Kitaabwe be yatumira Omuluŋŋamya omutuufu okubaluŋŋamya ekkubo lyonna.

Abo abaluŋŋamizibwa bwe batyo Omwoyo wa Katonda be “baana ba Katonda,” kwe kugamba, si baana ba Katonda kyokka, abazaaliddwa mazima Kitaabwe, naye abakyali baana abato, wabula be baana abakuze, abaana ba Katonda abatuukiridde; tebakyali baana bato naye baana. Omutume Pawulo assaawo enjawulo mu Abaggalatiya 4:1-7 wakati w'omwana omuto ali wansi w'okuluŋŋamya kw'etteeka era atali wa njawulo n'omuweereza, n'omwana omukulu atakyali muweereza wabula mwana atambulira mu ddembe ery'essanyu. Oluusi kifaanana ng'abakristaayo batono nnyo leero abasuulidde eddala obuddu obw'etteeka, amateeka agali ebweru waabwe, ne bayingira mu ddembe ery'essanyu ery'abaana.

Ensonga eno yeetaaga okunyweza mu biseera byaffe, kubanga tebassi batono abeewaayo eri okuluŋŋamizibwa omwoyo ogumu, gwe bagamba nti gwe Mwoyo Omutukuvu, naye ogubaluŋŋamya okukola ebintu ebigaanibwa mu lwatu mu kigambo. Kitugwanira okujjukira bulijjo nti emyoyo mingi egy'obulimba n'obannabbi ab'obulimba bangi bafulumye mu nsi (1 Yokaana 4:1). Bangi bagenda beeraliikirira nnyo okuluŋŋamizibwa amaanyi agatalabika ne baba beetegefu okuwaayo okuluŋŋamya obulamu bwabwe eri buli mwoyo oba omuntu atalabika. Mu ngeri eno, baggulawo obulamu bwabwe eri okuluŋŋamya n'okuvvoola kw'emyoyo emibi okuzikiriza obulamu bwabwe. Omusajja eyeewaana nnyo obutukuvu lumu yajja gye ndi n'aŋŋamba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu yali amuluŋŋamya ye ne “omukazi Omukristaayo omuwoomu,” gwe yali asisinkanye, okulowooza ku bufumbo. “Naye,” ne ŋŋamba, nga nneewuunya, “omaze okuba n'omukazi omu.” “Yee,” n'agamba, “naye omanyi nga tetumanyagana bulungi, era tetumalanga myaka mingi wamu.” “Yee,” ne nziramu, “mmanyi nga temumaze myaka mingi mu bufumbo, era netunuulidde ensonga, era nkkiriza nti omusango ogw'ekyo guli ku ggwe nnyo. Ate era, mukazi wo. Tolina nsonga kulowooza nti akukoledde obutali bwesigwa, era Yesu Kristo ayigiriza nti bw'owasa omulala ng'akyali mulamu oyenda” (Lukka 16:18). “Naye,” omusajja n'agamba, “Omwoyo wa Katonda atuluŋŋamya okwagalana n'okulaba nti tusaanidde okufumbiriganwa.” “Olimba, era ovvoola,” ne nziramu. “Buli mwoyo ogukuluŋŋamya okujeemera okuyigiriza okw'olwatu okwa Yesu Kristo si Mwoyo wa Katonda wabula mwoyo gumu gwa musajja Setaani.” Kino kiyinza okuba nga kyali kya nsonga ya njawulo nnyo, naye ensonga ez'engeri y'emu tezitalabika. Abakristaayo bangi abeeyita batyo bagezaako okwewolereza mu kukola ebintu ebigaanibwa mu kigambo nga bagamba nti baluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda. Nnaalumiriza abakulembeze mu kkuŋŋaaniro ery'Ekikristaayo omwo mu buli kukuŋŋaana bangi mwe baayogeleranga ennimi mu kumenya kw'olwatu okuyigiriza kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okuyita mu Mutume Pawulo mu 1 Abakkolinso 14:27-28 (Omuntu bw'ayogera olulimi, babeere babiri oba obungi basatu, era buli omu mu mpalo ye, era waabewo abivvuunula. Naye bwe wataba n'omu ayinza okuvvuunula, buli omu asirike mu kkanisa era ayogere yekka ne Katonda). Bye baawoza kwe kugamba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu yabaluŋŋamya okwogera bangi mu kiseera kimu era bangi mu kukuŋŋaana kumu, era nti kibagwanira okugondera Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era mu mbeera nga eno, tebaali ba kufugibwa kigambo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu tewewakanya. Taluŋŋamya muntu omu okukola ekyo mu kigambo ekyawandiikibwa kye yatulagira fenna obutakola. Okuluŋŋamya kwonna okw'Omwoyo kusaanira okugezesebwa n'ekyo kye tumanyi ng'okuluŋŋamya kw'Omwoyo mu kigambo. Wadde nga twetaaga okwekuuma eri okuluŋŋamya kw'emyoyo egy'obulimba, kya nkizo kyaffe okuluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n'okubeera n'obulamu obutaliimu buddu bwa mateeka na kweraliikirira nti tetujja kukyama, obulamu ng'obw'abaana Kitaabwe be yatumira Omuluŋŋamya omutuufu okubaluŋŋamya ekkubo lyonna. Abo abaluŋŋamizibwa bwe batyo Omwoyo wa Katonda be “baana ba Katonda,” kwe kugamba, si baana ba Katonda kyokka, abazaaliddwa mazima Kitaabwe, naye abakyali baana abato, wabula be baana abakuze, abaana ba Katonda abatuukiridde; tebakyali baana bato naye baana. Omutume Pawulo assaawo enjawulo mu Abaggalatiya 4:1-7 wakati w'omwana omuto ali wansi w'okuluŋŋamya kw'etteeka era atali wa njawulo n'omuweereza, n'omwana omukulu atakyali muweereza wabula mwana atambulira mu ddembe ery'essanyu. Oluusi kifaanana ng'abakristaayo batono nnyo leero abasuulidde eddala obuddu obw'etteeka, amateeka agali ebweru waabwe, ne bayingira mu ddembe ery'essanyu ery'abaana.

fields.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu Akakasa nti Tuli Baana
fields.body_html:
Ekimu ku byawandiikibwa ebisinga omuwendo mu Bayibuli ku mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu kisangibwa mu Abaruumi 8:15-16: “Kubanga temwafuna mwoyo gwa buddu okudda nate mu kutya, wabula mwafuna Omwoyo ow'okufuulibwa abaana, gwe tukaabira nti, 'Aba, Kitaffe!' Omwoyo yennyini akakasa awamu n'omwoyo gwaffe nti tuli baana ba Katonda.” Waliwo abajulizi babiri ku kuba kwaffe abaana: ekisooka, omwoyo gwaffe, nga gukkiriza Katonda ku kigambo kye (“Bonna abaamusembeza, yabawa obuyinza okufuuka abaana ba Katonda,” Yokaana 1:12), gukakasa nti tuli baana.

Omwoyo gwaffe awatali kubuusabuusa gukakasa nti ekyo Katonda ky'agamba kya mazima, nti tuli baana ba Katonda kubanga Katonda bw'akigamba. Naye waliwo omujulizi omulala ku kuba kwaffe abaana, gwe Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Ye akakasa awamu n'omwoyo gwaffe. “Awamu n'” ge maanyi g'Oluyonaani olukozeseddwa mu kyawandiikibwa kino. Tekigamba nti akakasa eri omwoyo gwaffe, naye “awamu n'” gwo. Engeri gy'akikola ennyonnyolwa mu Abaggalatiya 4:6, “Era kubanga muli baana, Katonda yatuma Omwoyo ow'Omwana we mu mitima gyaffe, ng'akaabira nti, 'Aba, Kitaffe!'” Bwe tumaze okusembeza Yesu Kristo ng'Omulokozi waffe ne tukkiriza obujulizi bwa Katonda ku Kristo nti okuyita mu ye tufuuse abaana, Omwoyo ow'Omwana we ajja mu mitima gyaffe, ng'agijjuza okuwulira okusukkiridde nti tuli baana, ng'akaabira okuyita mu mitima gyaffe nti, “Aba, Kitaffe.”

Enneeyisa eya buzaaliranwa ey'emitima gyaffe eri Katonda si ya baana. Tuyinza okumuyita Kitaffe n'emimwa gyaffe, nga, ng'ekyokulabirako, bwe tuddiŋŋana mu ngeri ey'empisa okusaba Yesu kwe yatuyigiriza, “Kitaffe ali mu ggulu,” naye tewali kuwulira kwa mazima nti ye Kitaffe. Okumuyita bwe tutyo bigambo byokka. Tetumwesiga. Tetwagala kujja mu maaso ge; tetwagala kutunula mu maaso ge n'okuwulira essanyu ery'ekitalo n'obwesige kubanga twogera ne Kitaffe.

Tutya Katonda. Tujja gy'ali mu kusaba kubanga tulowooza nti kitugwanira, era oboolyawo tutya ekiyinza okubaawo singa tetukikola. Naye Omwoyo ow'Omwana we bw'akakasa awamu n'omwoyo gwaffe nti tuli baana, awo tujjuzibwa era ne tukwatibwa okuwulira nti tuli baana. Tumwesiga nga bwe tutayinzanga na kwesiga kitaffe ow'oku nsi. Waliwo n'okutya kutono okumutya okusinga bwe twatyanga kitaffe waffe ow'oku nsi.

Waliwo ekitiibwa, waliwo entiisa, naye owange! Okuwulira okw'ekitalo okw'obwesige ng'obw'omwana.

Weetegereze kiseera ki Omwoyo lw'akakasa awamu n'omwoyo gwaffe nti tuli baana ba Katonda. Tulina entegeka y'okumanyako mu ntegeka y'ennyiriri mu Abaruumi 8. Okusooka tulaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'atununula okuva mu tteeka ery'ekibi n'okufa, era olw'ekyo, obutuukirivu obw'etteeka bwe butuukirira mu ffe abatatambulira mu tteeka wabula mu Mwoyo (olun. 2-4); awo tulina omukkiriza atafaayo ku bya mubiri wabula ku bya Mwoyo (olun. 5); awo tulina omukkiriza buli lunaku ng'atta ebikolwa by'omubiri olw'Omwoyo (olun. 13); awo tulina omukkiriza ng'aluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda; awo, era olwo lwokka, tulina Omwoyo ng'akakasa nti tuli baana.

Waliwo bangi abanoonya obujulizi bw'Omwoyo ku kuba kwabwe abaana mu kifo ekikyamu. Mu butuufu basaba obujulizi bw'Omwoyo ku kuba kwabwe abaana nga tebannayatula na kusembeza kwabwe Kristo, era mazima ddala nga tebannawaayo bulamu bwabwe bwonna eri okufugibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda abeera mu bo. Nedda, ka tunoonye ebintu mu ntegeka yaabyo entuufu. Ka tusembeze Yesu Kristo ng'Omulokozi waffe, tuwaayo eri ye nga Mukama waffe era Mufuzi waffe, kubanga Katonda atulagira okukikola; ka tumwatule mu maaso g'ensi kubanga Katonda akiragira (Matayo 10:32-33; Abaruumi 10:9-10); ka twogere nti ebibi byaffe bisonyiyiddwa, tulina obulamu obutaggwaawo, tuli baana ba Katonda kubanga Katonda bw'agamba mu kigambo kye era tetwagala kufuula Katonda mulimba nga tumubuusabuusa (Ebikolwa 10:43; Ebikolwa 13:38-39; 1 Yokaana 5:10-13; Yokaana 5:24; Yokaana 1:12); ka tuwaayo obulamu bwaffe eri okufugibwa Omwoyo ow'Obulamu, nga tumutunuulira atununule okuva mu tteeka ery'ekibi n'okufa; ka tuteeke ebirowoozo byaffe, si ku bya mubiri wabula ku bya Mwoyo; ka tutte ebikolwa by'omubiri buli lunaku olw'Omwoyo; ka tuwaayo obulamu bwaffe okuluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda mu byonna; awo ka twesige butereevu Katonda atume Omwoyo ow'Omwana we mu mitima gyaffe ng'atujjuza okuwulira nti tuli baana, ng'akaabira nti, “Aba, Kitaffe,” era anaakikola.

Katonda, Kitaffe, ayaayaanira nti tumanye era tutegeere nti tuli baana be. Ayaayaanira okutuwulira nga tumuyita Kitaffe okuva mu mitima egitegeera bye gyogera, era egimwesiga awatali kutya wadde kweraliikirira. Ye Kitaffe. Ye yekka mu bwonna obw'ensi ategeera obujjuvu bw'amakulu agali mu kigambo ekyo eky'ekitalo “Kitaffe,” era kimuleetera essanyu okutulaba nga tutegeera nti ye Kitaffe n'okumuyita bwe tutyo. Emyaka egiyise, waaliwo kitaawe w'omwana mu ssaza ery'e Illinois eyalina omwana eyali kiggala era omuziba okuva mu kuzaalibwa. Lwali lunaku lwa nnaku mu maka ago bwe baategeera nti akaana ako kaali kaggala era tekaali kagenda kuwulira, era, nga bwe baalowooza, tekaali kagenda kwogera.

Kitaawe yawulira ku kitongole mu Jacksonville, Illinois, abaana abaggala gye baayigirizibwanga okwogera. Yatwala akaana kano ako mu kitongole n'akakwasa omukulu w'ekitongole. Akaana bwe kaamala ekiseera nga kaliyo, omukulu w'ekitongole yawandiikira kitaawe ng'amugamba nti kyandibadde kirungi ajje akyalire omwana we.

Olunaku lwateebwa, akaana ne kagambibwa nti kitaakwo ajja. Ekiseera bwe kyasembera, kaatuula ku ddirisa, nga kalindirira omulyango kitaako ayiteko. Amangu ddala nga ayingidde mu mulyango, kaamulaba, ne kaddukira wansi ku madaala, ne kadduka ku ttwale, ne kamusisinkana, ne katunula mu maaso ge, ne kayimusa emikono gyakwo, ne kagamba nti, “Papa.” Kitaawe bwe yawulira emimwa gy'omwana we omuziba nga gwogera omulundi ogusooka era nga gwatula ekigambo ekyo ekiwoomu “Papa,” okutuntuza okw'essanyu okwo ne kuyita mu mutima gwe, n'agwa wansi ku ttaka ne yeevulunga ku muddo mu ssanyu erisukkiridde. Naye waliwo Kitaffe ayagala nga tewali kitaawe w'oku nsi ayagala, ayaayaanira abaana be okutegeera nti baana be, era bwe tutunula mu maaso ge okuva mu mutima Omwoyo Omutukuvu gwe yajjuza okuwulira nti tuli baana, ne tumuyita “Aba” (papa), “Kitaffe,” tewali lulimi luyinza kunnyonnyola ssanyu lya Katonda.
