fields.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'Omuyigiriza
fields.body_html:
Mukama waffe Yesu mu kwogera kwe okwasembayo n'abayigirizwa be nga tannakomererwa, yagamba nti, “Naye Omubeezi, ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu, Kitange gw'aliweereza mu linnya lyange, oyo alibayigiriza byonna, era alibajjukiza byonna bye nnabagamba” (Yokaana 14:26). Wano tulaba omulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw'engeri bbiri, okuyigiriza n'okujjukiza ebintu Kristo bye yali amaze okuyigiriza. Tujja kubyetegereza nga tusooka ku ky'oluvannyuma.

I. Omwoyo Omutukuvu ajjukiza ebigambo bya Kristo.

Ekisuubizo kino kyasooka kuweebwa Batume era kye kakalu ak'obwesigwa bw'ebyo bye baawandiika ku ebyo Yesu bye yagamba; naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu akola omulimu gwe gumu mu buli mukkiriza amusuubira era amutunuulira okugukola. Omwoyo Omutukuvu atujjukiza okuyigiriza kwa Kristo n'Ekigambo mu kiseera kennyini we tubyetaaga, oba olw'ebyetaago by'obulamu bwaffe oba olw'obuweereza bwaffe. Bangi ku ffe tuyinza okwogera ku biseera bwe twali mu nnaku nnyingi ey'emmeeme oba mu kubuusabuusa okunene ku buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe oba mu kuzibuwalirwa okunene ku kye tuba twogera eri oyo gwe tuba tugezaako okukulembera eri Kristo oba okuyamba, era mu kaseera ako kennyini Ekyawandiikibwa kye twali twetaaga — ekitundu oboolyawo kye twali tetulowoozaako kumala biseera bingi era oboolyawo kye twali tetulowoozangaako mu nsonga eno — kyaleetebwa mu birowoozo byaffe. Ani eyakikola? Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye yakikola.

Ali mwetegefu okukikola emirundi mingi n'okusingawo, singa tumusuubira era ne tumutunuulira okukikola.

Kya nkizo gye tuli buli lwe tutuula okumpi n'omunoonya bino tumulage ekkubo ery'obulamu, okutunuulira Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne twogera nti, “Ncigambe ki omunoonya ono? Kyawandiikibwa ki kye nkozesa?” Waliwo amakulu ag'obuziba mu nsonga nti, mu lunyiriri olwo lwennyini oluddirira ekisuubizo kino eky'omuwendo, Yesu agamba nti, “Emirembe mbaleetera; emirembe gyange gye mbawa.” Olw'Omwoyo okujjukiza ebigambo bye n'okutuyigiriza amazima ga Katonda kwe tufuna era ne tubeera mu mirembe gino. Bwe tutunuulira busa Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutuleetera Ekyawandiikibwa mu kiseera kennyini we tukyetaaga, era Ekyawandiikibwa kyennyini kye twetaaga, mazima ddala tujja kubeera n'emirembe gya Kristo buli kaseera mu bulamu bwaffe.

Omuntu eyali yeeteekateeka olw'omulimu gwa Bukristaayo yajja gye ndi ng'ali mu nnaku nnyingi. Yagamba nti ateekwa okuleka okwetegeka kwe, kubanga yali tasobola kukwata Byawandiikibwa mu mutwe. “Nnina emyaka amakumi asatu mu ebiri,” bwe yagamba, “era nnaakamala emyaka mingi mu bizinensi. Naaleka empisa ey'okusoma, so sisobola kukwata kintu kyonna mu mutwe.” Omusajja yali ayaayaanira okubeera mu buweereza bwa Mukama we, era amaziga gaayimirira mu maaso ge bwe yali akyogera.

“Toggwaamu maanyi,” bwe namuddamu. “Kwata ekisuubizo kya Mukama wo nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu alijjukiza ebigambo bye, yiga ekitundu kimu eky'Ekyawandiikibwa, okinyweze mu birowoozo byo, n'oluvannyuma okwate ekirala, era tunuulira Omwoyo Omutukuvu akubijjukize bw'obibeetaaga.” Yeeyongera n'okwetegeka kwe. Yeesiga Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Oluvannyuma, yatandika omulimu mu kifo eky'obuzibu ennyo, ekifo obukyamu obwa buli ngeri gye bwali bujjudde. Baamukuŋŋaaniranga ku luguudo ng'enjuki, n'akwatanga Bayibuli ye n'eesiga Omwoyo Omutukuvu okumujjukiza ebitundu by'Ekyawandiikibwa bye yali yeetaaga, era yakikola. Abalabe be baajjuzibwa okutabukatabuka, kubanga yabasisinkananga ku buli nsonga n'Ekigambo kya Katonda ekituufu, era bangi ku abo abaali abakakanyavu ennyo bawambibwa eri Kristo.

II. Omwoyo Omutukuvu alituyigiriza byonna. Waliwo ekisuubizo ekyeyongera okuba eky'olwatu ku nsonga eno mu ssuula bbiri ez'oluvannyuma mu Yokaana 16:12-14. Wano Yesu agamba nti, “Nkyalina bingi eby'okubagamba, naye kaakati temuyinza kubigumira. Omwoyo ow'amazima bw'alijja, alibaluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna, kubanga taalyogere ku bwe yekka, naye byonna by'aliwulira by'aliyogera, era alibategeeza ebintu ebigenda okujja. Oyo alingulumiza, kubanga aliddira ebyange n'abibategeeza.” Ekisuubizo kino kyasooka kuweebwa Batume, naye Batume bo bennyini baakikozesa eri abakkiriza bonna (1 Yokaana 2:20-27). Kya nkizo eri buli mukkiriza mu Yesu Kristo, ne wabula asingayo obwetoowaze, okuba “ayigirizibwa Katonda.”

Nga tesigamye ku bayigiriza abantu, “Temwetaaga muntu yenna kubayigiriza” (1 Yokaana 2:27).

Kino, mazima, tekitegeeza nti tetuyinza kuyiga bingi okuva mu balala abayigirizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Singa Yokaana yali alowooza bw'atyo teyandiwandiise bbaluwa eno okuyigiriza abalala. Omuntu ayigirizibwa Katonda ennyo y'oyo asinga okuba omwetegefu okuwuliriza ebyo Katonda by'ayigirizza abalala. N'okusingawo tekitegeeza nti bwe tuyigirizibwa Omwoyo, tetwetaaga Kigambo kya Katonda ekyawandiikibwa; kubanga Ekigambo kye kifo Omwoyo, ye Mukozi w'Ekigambo, gy'atwala abayizi be era kye kikozesebwa mw'abayigiririza (Abaefeso 6:17; Yokaana 6:33; Abaefeso 5:18-19; Abakkolosaayi 3:16). Naye newaakubadde nga tuyinza okuyiga bingi okuva mu bantu, tetwesigama ku bo.

Tulina Omuyigiriza ow'Obwakatonda, Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Tetugenda kumanya mazima mu butuufu okutuusa lwe tuyigirizibwa butereevu Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Tewali kuyigiriza kw'obuntu, ne wabula ng'abayigiriza baffe be baani, okuliddayo okutuwa okutegeera amazima okutuufu, okwennyini, era okujjuvu. Ne bwe wandibaddewo okusoma Ekigambo n'obunyiikivu, oba mu Lungereza oba mu nnimi ensookerwako, tekwandituwadde kutegeera kwa mazima okwennyini. Tuteekwa okuyigirizibwa butereevu Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era tuyinza okuyigirizibwa bwe tutyo, buli omu ku ffe. Oyo ayigirizibwa alitegeera amazima ga Katonda obulungi, ne bw'aba tamanyi kigambo na kimu eky'Oluyonaani oba Oluceburaniya, okusinga oyo amanyi Oluyonaani n'Oluceburaniya mu bujjuvu n'ennimi zonna ezigatte, naye nga tayigirizibwa Mwoyo.

Omwoyo alimuluŋŋamya oyo gw'ayigiriza bw'atyo “mu mazima.” Ekitundu kyonna eky'amazima ga Katonda kya buli omu ku ffe, naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu talituluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna mu lunaku lumu, wadde mu wiiki, wadde mu mwaka, wabula omutendera ku mutendera. Waliwo enkola bbiri enjawulo ez'okuyigiriza kw'Omwoyo eziyogeddwako: (1) “Alibategeeza ebintu ebigenda okujja.” Bangi bagamba nti tetuyinza kumanya kintu kyonna ku bigenda okujja, nti ebirowoozo byaffe byonna ku nsonga eyo kya kubwatuka busa. Mazima, tetuyinza kumanya buli kintu ku biseera eby'omu maaso.

Waliwo ebintu ebimu Katonda by'asiimye okwekuumira yekka, ebintu eby'ekyama ebibye (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 29:29). Okugeza, tetuyinza “kumanya biro oba ebiseera” eby'okukomawo kwa Mukama waffe (Ebikolwa 1:7), naye waliwo ebintu bingi ku biseera eby'omu maaso Omwoyo Omutukuvu by'alitubikkulira.

(2) “Oyo alingulumiza, kubanga aliddira ebyange n'abibategeeza.” Guno gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw'enjawulo ogw'okuyigiriza n'omukkiriza, era n'atakkiriza, Yesu Kristo. Gwe mulimu gwe ogusinga byonna okubikkula Yesu Kristo n'okumugulumiza. Okuyigiriza kwe kwonna kwessimba ku Kristo. Ng'ava eno oba eri, bulijjo atuleeta eri Yesu Kristo. Abamu batya okussa essira ku mazima agakwata ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu, nga beeraliikirira nti Kristo yennyini ayinza okuduulirwa n'atebwa ennyuma, naye tewali n'omu agulumiza Kristo nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'akola. Tetugenda kutegeera Kristo, wadde okulaba ekitiibwa kye, okutuusa Omwoyo Omutukuvu lw'atuvvuunulira. Ne bwe twandiwulirizza okubuulira n'okuyigiriza, ne kuba nga kwa magezi katya, wadde okusoma Ekigambo kwokka, tekwandituwadde kulaba “ebintu bya Kristo”; Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye ateekwa okutulaga, era ayagala okukikola, era asobola okukikola. Ayaayaanira okukikola.

Okwegomba kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okusinga amaanyi kwe kubikkula Yesu Kristo eri abantu. Ku lunaku lwa Pentekooti, Peetero n'abalala abaali naye bwe baali “bajjuzibbwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu,” tebaayogera nnyo ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu; baayogera ku Kristo. Wetegereze okubuulira kwa Peetero ku lunaku olwo; Yesu Kristo ye yali omutwe gwe ogumu, era Yesu Kristo y'aliba omutwe gwaffe ogumu, bwe tuyigirizibwa Omwoyo; Yesu Kristo alijjula ekifo kyonna eky'okulaba kwaffe. Tuliba ne Kristo omuggya, Kristo ow'ekitiibwa. Kristo aliba wa kitiibwa gye tuli nnyo ne tuyaayaanira okugenda okubuulira buli omu ku Oyo ow'ekitiibwa gwe tuzudde. Yesu Kristo aba wa njawulo nnyo Omwoyo bw'amugulumiza ng'addira ebibye n'abitulaga.

III. Omwoyo Omutukuvu atubikkulira ebintu eby'obuziba ebya Katonda ebikwekeddwa omuntu ow'omubiri era ebiri obusirusiru gy'ali. Tusoma mu 1 Abakkolinso 2:9-13, “Ekyo eriiso lye litalabanga, n'okutu bwe kutawuliranga, n'omutima gw'omuntu bwe gutalowoozangako, Katonda kye yateekerateekera abo abamwagala. Ebintu bino Katonda yabitubikkulira olw'Omwoyo. Kubanga Omwoyo akebera byonna, n'obuziba bwa Katonda bwennyini. Kubanga ani amanyi ebirowoozo by'omuntu okuggyako omwoyo gw'omuntu oyo oguli mu ye? Bwe kityo tewali amanyi birowoozo bya Katonda okuggyako Omwoyo wa Katonda. Kaakati twafuna, si mwoyo gwa nsi, wabula Omwoyo ava eri Katonda, tulyoke tutegeere ebintu Katonda bye yatuwa obuwa. Era tubyogera, si mu bigambo ebiyigirizibwa amagezi g'abantu, wabula ebiyigirizibwa Omwoyo, nga tuvvuunula amazima ag'omwoyo eri abo ab'omwoyo.” Ekitundu kino kyogera okusookera ku Batume, naye tetuyinza kukugira mulimu guno ogw'Omwoyo ku bo bokka.

Omwoyo abikkulira buli mukkiriza ebintu eby'obuziba ebya Katonda, ebintu eriiso ery'omuntu bye litalabangako, n'okutu bye kutawuliranga, era ebitayingiranga mu mutima gw'omuntu; bino bye bintu Katonda by'ateekerateekera abo abamwagala. Kirabika bulungi okuva mu bwogeddwako nti kino tekyogera ku ggulu kwokka oba ebintu ebigenda okujja mu bulamu obw'oluvannyuma. Omwoyo Omutukuvu addira ebintu eby'obuziba ebya Katonda, Katonda bye yatuteekerateekera, ne mu bulamu buno obw'okaakati, n'abitubikkulira.

IV. Omwoyo Omutukuvu avvuunula okubikkulirwa kwe. Awa amaanyi ag'okwawula, okumanya, n'okusiima ekyo ky'ayigirizza. Mu lunyiriri oluddirira olwo lwe twakayogera tusoma nti, “Omuntu ow'omubiri tafuna bintu bya Mwoyo wa Katonda, kubanga busirusiru gy'ali, era tasobola kubitegeera kubanga bitegeerwa mu mwoyo” (1 Abakkolinso 2:14). Omwoyo Omutukuvu si Mukozi w'okubikkulirwa kwokka, ye Kigambo kya Katonda ekyawandiikibwa: era ye Muvvuunuzi w'ekyo ky'abikkudde. Buli kitabo eky'obuziba kiba kya nsanyu era kya mugaso okusingirira ddala bwe tuba n'omuwandiisi w'ekitabo okumpi okukituvvuunulira, era bulijjo kya nkizo gye tuli okuba n'omuwandiisi wa Bayibuli okumpi bwe tugisoma.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye Mukozi wa Bayibuli, era ali mwetegefu okuvvuunula amakulu gaayo eri buli mukkiriza buli lw'aggula Ekitabo. Okutegeera Ekitabo, tuteekwa okumutunuulira, olwo n'ebifo ebisinga ekizikiza ne bitangaala. Emirundi mingi twetaaga okusaba awamu n'Omuzabbuli ow'edda nti, “Ozibule amaaso gange, ndyoke ndabe eby'ekitalo ebiva mu mateeka go” (Zabbuli 119:18). Tekimala nti tulina okubikkulirwa kwa Katonda mu maaso gaffe mu Kigambo ekyawandiikibwa okusoma, tuteekwa era okuba n'omusana ogw'omunda ogw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutusobozesa okukutegeera bwe tukusoma.

Kye kiremba ekya bulijjo, naye ekiremba ekyeyoleka ennyo, kwe kugezaako okutegeera okubikkulirwa okw'omwoyo n'okutegeera okw'omubiri. Okugezaako okusirusiru kuno kwe kwakulukusa bangi mu ttosi ery'ekiyitibwa “Higher Criticism.” Okutegeera obuyiiya, omuntu ateekwa okuba n'okuwulira okulungi awamu n'okumanya langi n'erangi, era omuntu okutegeera okubikkulirwa okw'omwoyo ateekwa okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo. Okumanya kwokka ennimi Bayibuli mwe yawandiikirwa tekumala. Omuntu atalina magezi malungi ayinza okusuubira okusiima ekifaananyi kya Sistine Madonna olw'okuba tazibe langi mu maaso, nga bwe kiri obwongo eri omuntu atajjudde Mwoyo okusuubira okutegeera Bayibuli olw'obwereere nti amanyi ebigambo n'amateeka g'ennimi Bayibuli mwe yawandiikirwa.

Kyandibadde nga tetulina njawulo bwe tulowooza okuteeka omuntu okuyigiriza obuyiiya olw'okuba ategeera by'okusiiga langi, nga bwe kiri okuteeka omuntu okuyigiriza Bayibuli olw'okuba nga ategeera bulungi Oluyonaani n'Oluceburaniya. Mu biseera byaffe twetaaga, si kukiriza bwokka nti obutuukirivu bwaffe tebumala era tebulina mugaso mu maaso ga Katonda, kwe kuyigiriza okw'essuula ezisooka ez'Ebbaluwa eri Abaruumi, wabula n'okukiriza nti amagezi gaffe tegamala era tegalina mugaso mu bintu bya Katonda, kwe kuyigiriza okw'Ebbaluwa Esooka eri Abakkolinso, naddala essuula esooka okutuuka ku ey'okusatu. (Laba, okugeza, 1 Abakkolinso 1:19-21, 26, ne 27.)

Abayudaaya ab'edda baalina okubikkulirwa okw'Omwoyo, naye ne balemwa okwesiga Omwoyo yennyini okukubavvuunulira, bwe batyo ne bawaba. Bwe kityo Abakristaayo leero balina okubikkulirwa okw'Omwoyo, era bangi balemererwa okwesiga Omwoyo Omutukuvu okukubavvuunulira, bwe batyo ne bawaba. Ekkanisa yonna ey'enjiri ekiriziganya, wadde mu kuteesa bwokka, nti obutuukirivu bw'omuntu tebumala n'akatono. Kye yeetaaga okuyigirizibwa mu kaseera kano, era kye yeetaaga okulaba, kwe kutamala kw'amagezi g'omuntu. Ekyo oboolyawo kye kuyigiriza omulembe guno ogw'amakumi abiri ogw'amalala ag'amagezi kwe gwetaaga okusinga okuyiga. Okutegeera Ekigambo kya Katonda, tuteekwa okwefululusa amagezi gaffe gonna ne tuwummulira mu kwesiga Omwoyo wa Katonda okukituvvuunulira.

Kirungi okuteeka ku mutima ebigambo bya Yesu yennyini mu Matayo 11:25, “Nkwebaza, Kitange, Mukama w'eggulu n'ensi, kubanga ebintu bino wabikweka ab'amagezi n'ab'okutegeera n'obibikkulira abaana abato.” Abayizi ba Bayibuli abamu lumu baali bakubaganya ebirowoozo ku ngeri ezisinga obulungi ez'okusoma Bayibuli, omusajja omu, eyali muyivu era ow'amasomero, n'agamba nti, “Ndowooza engeri esinga obulungi ey'okusoma Bayibuli ye ngeri y'omwana omuwere.”

Bwe tumala okuggyawo obutuukirivu bwaffe ddala, olwo era olwo lwokka, lwe tufuna obutuukirivu bwa Katonda (Abafiripi 4:7, 9; Abaruumi 10:3). Era bwe tumala okuggyawo amagezi gaffe ddala, olwo lwe tufuna amagezi ga Katonda. “Waleme kubaawo yeerimba yekka,” bw'agamba Omutume Pawulo. “Omuntu yenna mu mmwe bw'alowooza nti wa magezi mu mulembe guno, afuuke omusirusiru alyoke afuuke ow'amagezi” (1 Abakkolinso 3:18). Era okwefululusa kuteekwa okukulembera okujjuzibwa, omuntu yeeyiweeko Katonda alyoke ayiwibwe mu ye.

Tuteekwa buli lunaku okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo okutegeera Ekigambo. Tetuyinza kwesiga nsonga nti Omwoyo yatuyigiriza jjo. Buli mulundi omuggya bwe tutuukirira Ekigambo, kiteekwa kubeera mu maanyi g'Omwoyo olw'omukolo ogwo ogwennyini. Nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu yamala okumulisa ebirowoozo byaffe okukwata amazima agamu tekimala. Ateekwa okukikola buli mulundi gwe tuyolekera ekitundu ekyo. Andrew Murray yagamba bulungi nti, “Buli mulundi bw'ojja eri Ekigambo mu kusoma, mu kuwuliriza okubuulira, oba mu kusoma ekitabo eky'eddiini, waanobeerawo, ng'okwawukana bwe kuli n'engeri gy'okwatagana n'eby'ebweru, omukolo ogw'olwatu ogw'okwefiiriza, ng'owakanya amagezi go n'oweeyabulira mu kukkiriza eri Omuyigiriza ow'Obwakatonda” (“The Spirit of Christ,” olupapula 221).

V. Omwoyo Omutukuvu asobozesa omukkiriza okutuusa eri abalala mu maanyi amazima ge yayigirizibwa.

Pawulo agamba mu 1 Abakkolinso 2:1-5, “Nange, bwe najja gye muli, abooluganda, saajja kubabuulira bujulizi bwa Katonda n'ebigambo ebisukkulumu oba amagezi. Kubanga nnasalawo obutamanya kintu kyonna mu mmwe okuggyako Yesu Kristo era oyo eyakomererwa. Era nnali nammwe mu bunafu ne mu kutya ne mu kukankana okungi, okwogera kwange n'obubaka bwange tebyali mu bigambo bya magezi ebisendasenda, wabula mu kwolesebwa kw'Omwoyo n'okw'amaanyi, okukkiriza kwammwe kuleme kwesigama ku magezi g'abantu wabula ku maanyi ga Katonda.”

Mu ngeri y'emu, ng'awandiikira abakkiriza mu 1 Abasessaloniika 1:5, “Kubanga enjiri yaffe teyajja gye muli mu kigambo kyokka, wabula ne mu maanyi ne mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu ne mu bukakafu obujjuvu. Mumanyi engeri gye twali abasajja bwe tweyoleka mu mmwe ku lwammwe.” Tetwetaaga Mwoyo Omutukuvu kubikkula mazima eri abatume ne bannabbi abalonde mu kifo ekisooka kyokka, n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu kifo eky'okubiri okutuvvuunulira ffe nga bantu ssekinnoomu amazima ge yabikkudde bw'atyo, wabula mu kifo eky'okusatu, twetaaga Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutusobozesa okutuusa obulungi eri abalala amazima ye yennyini ge yatuvvuunulira. Tumwetaaga okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Ensonga enkulu emu ey'okulemererwa okw'amazima mu buweereza, ne bwe wabaawo okulabika ng'okwesiima, era si mu buweereza obwa bulijjo bwokka wabula ne mu ngeri zonna ez'obuweereza, eva mu kugezaako okuyigiriza n'“ebigambo ebisendasenda eby'amagezi g'omuntu” (kwe kugamba, n'obukugu bw'okuwakanya, okusendasenda n'obumanyirivu bw'okwogera) ebyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu bye yatuyigiriza. Ekyetaagisa maanyi ga Mwoyo Mutukuvu, “okwolesebwa kw'Omwoyo n'amaanyi.”

Waliwo ensonga ssatu ez'okulemererwa mu kubuulira leero. Ekisooka, obubaka obulala buyigirizibwa mu kifo ky'obubaka Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yabikkula mu Kigambo. (Abantu babuulira ssaayansi, obuyiiya, eby'ebiwandiiko, endowooza, eby'obwannakyewa, ebyafaayo, eby'enfuna, eby'obumanyirivu, n'ebirala, so si Kigambo kya Katonda ekyangu nga bwe kisangibwa mu Kitabo ky'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Bayibuli.) Eky'okubiri, obubaka bwa Bayibuli obuyigirizibwa Omwoyo busomebwa era bugezebwako okukwatibwa n'okutegeera okw'omubiri, kwe kugamba, awatali musana gw'Omwoyo. Nga kino kya bulijjo nnyo, ne mu bibiina omwo abantu mwe batendekerwa obuweereza, ne mu bibiina ebiyinza okuba nga bituufu ddala. Eky'okusatu, obubaka obuweebwa Omwoyo, Ekigambo, Bayibuli esomebbwa era etegeerebwa wansi w'omusana gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, buweebwa abalala n'“ebigambo ebisendasenda eby'amagezi g'omuntu,” so si mu “kwolesebwa kw'Omwoyo n'amaanyi.” Twetaaga, era twesigama ku Omwoyo, okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Ateekwa okutuyigiriza engeri y'okwogera awamu n'ekyokwogera. Ateekwa okuba amaanyi awamu n'obubaka.
fields.body_text: Mukama waffe Yesu mu kwogera kwe okwasembayo n'abayigirizwa be nga tannakomererwa, yagamba nti, “Naye Omubeezi, ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu, Kitange gw'aliweereza mu linnya lyange, oyo alibayigiriza byonna, era alibajjukiza byonna bye nnabagamba” (Yokaana 14:26). Wano tulaba omulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw'engeri bbiri, okuyigiriza n'okujjukiza ebintu Kristo bye yali amaze okuyigiriza. Tujja kubyetegereza nga tusooka ku ky'oluvannyuma. I. Omwoyo Omutukuvu ajjukiza ebigambo bya Kristo. Ekisuubizo kino kyasooka kuweebwa Batume era kye kakalu ak'obwesigwa bw'ebyo bye baawandiika ku ebyo Yesu bye yagamba; naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu akola omulimu gwe gumu mu buli mukkiriza amusuubira era amutunuulira okugukola. Omwoyo Omutukuvu atujjukiza okuyigiriza kwa Kristo n'Ekigambo mu kiseera kennyini we tubyetaaga, oba olw'ebyetaago by'obulamu bwaffe oba olw'obuweereza bwaffe. Bangi ku ffe tuyinza okwogera ku biseera bwe twali mu nnaku nnyingi ey'emmeeme oba mu kubuusabuusa okunene ku buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe oba mu kuzibuwalirwa okunene ku kye tuba twogera eri oyo gwe tuba tugezaako okukulembera eri Kristo oba okuyamba, era mu kaseera ako kennyini Ekyawandiikibwa kye twali twetaaga — ekitundu oboolyawo kye twali tetulowoozaako kumala biseera bingi era oboolyawo kye twali tetulowoozangaako mu nsonga eno — kyaleetebwa mu birowoozo byaffe. Ani eyakikola? Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye yakikola. Ali mwetegefu okukikola emirundi mingi n'okusingawo, singa tumusuubira era ne tumutunuulira okukikola. Kya nkizo gye tuli buli lwe tutuula okumpi n'omunoonya bino tumulage ekkubo ery'obulamu, okutunuulira Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne twogera nti, “Ncigambe ki omunoonya ono? Kyawandiikibwa ki kye nkozesa?” Waliwo amakulu ag'obuziba mu nsonga nti, mu lunyiriri olwo lwennyini oluddirira ekisuubizo kino eky'omuwendo, Yesu agamba nti, “Emirembe mbaleetera; emirembe gyange gye mbawa.” Olw'Omwoyo okujjukiza ebigambo bye n'okutuyigiriza amazima ga Katonda kwe tufuna era ne tubeera mu mirembe gino. Bwe tutunuulira busa Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutuleetera Ekyawandiikibwa mu kiseera kennyini we tukyetaaga, era Ekyawandiikibwa kyennyini kye twetaaga, mazima ddala tujja kubeera n'emirembe gya Kristo buli kaseera mu bulamu bwaffe. Omuntu eyali yeeteekateeka olw'omulimu gwa Bukristaayo yajja gye ndi ng'ali mu nnaku nnyingi. Yagamba nti ateekwa okuleka okwetegeka kwe, kubanga yali tasobola kukwata Byawandiikibwa mu mutwe. “Nnina emyaka amakumi asatu mu ebiri,” bwe yagamba, “era nnaakamala emyaka mingi mu bizinensi. Naaleka empisa ey'okusoma, so sisobola kukwata kintu kyonna mu mutwe.” Omusajja yali ayaayaanira okubeera mu buweereza bwa Mukama we, era amaziga gaayimirira mu maaso ge bwe yali akyogera. “Toggwaamu maanyi,” bwe namuddamu. “Kwata ekisuubizo kya Mukama wo nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu alijjukiza ebigambo bye, yiga ekitundu kimu eky'Ekyawandiikibwa, okinyweze mu birowoozo byo, n'oluvannyuma okwate ekirala, era tunuulira Omwoyo Omutukuvu akubijjukize bw'obibeetaaga.” Yeeyongera n'okwetegeka kwe. Yeesiga Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Oluvannyuma, yatandika omulimu mu kifo eky'obuzibu ennyo, ekifo obukyamu obwa buli ngeri gye bwali bujjudde. Baamukuŋŋaaniranga ku luguudo ng'enjuki, n'akwatanga Bayibuli ye n'eesiga Omwoyo Omutukuvu okumujjukiza ebitundu by'Ekyawandiikibwa bye yali yeetaaga, era yakikola. Abalabe be baajjuzibwa okutabukatabuka, kubanga yabasisinkananga ku buli nsonga n'Ekigambo kya Katonda ekituufu, era bangi ku abo abaali abakakanyavu ennyo bawambibwa eri Kristo. II. Omwoyo Omutukuvu alituyigiriza byonna. Waliwo ekisuubizo ekyeyongera okuba eky'olwatu ku nsonga eno mu ssuula bbiri ez'oluvannyuma mu Yokaana 16:12-14. Wano Yesu agamba nti, “Nkyalina bingi eby'okubagamba, naye kaakati temuyinza kubigumira. Omwoyo ow'amazima bw'alijja, alibaluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna, kubanga taalyogere ku bwe yekka, naye byonna by'aliwulira by'aliyogera, era alibategeeza ebintu ebigenda okujja. Oyo alingulumiza, kubanga aliddira ebyange n'abibategeeza.” Ekisuubizo kino kyasooka kuweebwa Batume, naye Batume bo bennyini baakikozesa eri abakkiriza bonna (1 Yokaana 2:20-27). Kya nkizo eri buli mukkiriza mu Yesu Kristo, ne wabula asingayo obwetoowaze, okuba “ayigirizibwa Katonda.” Nga tesigamye ku bayigiriza abantu, “Temwetaaga muntu yenna kubayigiriza” (1 Yokaana 2:27). Kino, mazima, tekitegeeza nti tetuyinza kuyiga bingi okuva mu balala abayigirizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Singa Yokaana yali alowooza bw'atyo teyandiwandiise bbaluwa eno okuyigiriza abalala. Omuntu ayigirizibwa Katonda ennyo y'oyo asinga okuba omwetegefu okuwuliriza ebyo Katonda by'ayigirizza abalala. N'okusingawo tekitegeeza nti bwe tuyigirizibwa Omwoyo, tetwetaaga Kigambo kya Katonda ekyawandiikibwa; kubanga Ekigambo kye kifo Omwoyo, ye Mukozi w'Ekigambo, gy'atwala abayizi be era kye kikozesebwa mw'abayigiririza (Abaefeso 6:17; Yokaana 6:33; Abaefeso 5:18-19; Abakkolosaayi 3:16). Naye newaakubadde nga tuyinza okuyiga bingi okuva mu bantu, tetwesigama ku bo. Tulina Omuyigiriza ow'Obwakatonda, Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Tetugenda kumanya mazima mu butuufu okutuusa lwe tuyigirizibwa butereevu Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Tewali kuyigiriza kw'obuntu, ne wabula ng'abayigiriza baffe be baani, okuliddayo okutuwa okutegeera amazima okutuufu, okwennyini, era okujjuvu. Ne bwe wandibaddewo okusoma Ekigambo n'obunyiikivu, oba mu Lungereza oba mu nnimi ensookerwako, tekwandituwadde kutegeera kwa mazima okwennyini. Tuteekwa okuyigirizibwa butereevu Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era tuyinza okuyigirizibwa bwe tutyo, buli omu ku ffe. Oyo ayigirizibwa alitegeera amazima ga Katonda obulungi, ne bw'aba tamanyi kigambo na kimu eky'Oluyonaani oba Oluceburaniya, okusinga oyo amanyi Oluyonaani n'Oluceburaniya mu bujjuvu n'ennimi zonna ezigatte, naye nga tayigirizibwa Mwoyo. Omwoyo alimuluŋŋamya oyo gw'ayigiriza bw'atyo “mu mazima.” Ekitundu kyonna eky'amazima ga Katonda kya buli omu ku ffe, naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu talituluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna mu lunaku lumu, wadde mu wiiki, wadde mu mwaka, wabula omutendera ku mutendera. Waliwo enkola bbiri enjawulo ez'okuyigiriza kw'Omwoyo eziyogeddwako: (1) “Alibategeeza ebintu ebigenda okujja.” Bangi bagamba nti tetuyinza kumanya kintu kyonna ku bigenda okujja, nti ebirowoozo byaffe byonna ku nsonga eyo kya kubwatuka busa. Mazima, tetuyinza kumanya buli kintu ku biseera eby'omu maaso. Waliwo ebintu ebimu Katonda by'asiimye okwekuumira yekka, ebintu eby'ekyama ebibye (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 29:29). Okugeza, tetuyinza “kumanya biro oba ebiseera” eby'okukomawo kwa Mukama waffe (Ebikolwa 1:7), naye waliwo ebintu bingi ku biseera eby'omu maaso Omwoyo Omutukuvu by'alitubikkulira. (2) “Oyo alingulumiza, kubanga aliddira ebyange n'abibategeeza.” Guno gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw'enjawulo ogw'okuyigiriza n'omukkiriza, era n'atakkiriza, Yesu Kristo. Gwe mulimu gwe ogusinga byonna okubikkula Yesu Kristo n'okumugulumiza. Okuyigiriza kwe kwonna kwessimba ku Kristo. Ng'ava eno oba eri, bulijjo atuleeta eri Yesu Kristo. Abamu batya okussa essira ku mazima agakwata ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu, nga beeraliikirira nti Kristo yennyini ayinza okuduulirwa n'atebwa ennyuma, naye tewali n'omu agulumiza Kristo nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'akola. Tetugenda kutegeera Kristo, wadde okulaba ekitiibwa kye, okutuusa Omwoyo Omutukuvu lw'atuvvuunulira. Ne bwe twandiwulirizza okubuulira n'okuyigiriza, ne kuba nga kwa magezi katya, wadde okusoma Ekigambo kwokka, tekwandituwadde kulaba “ebintu bya Kristo”; Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye ateekwa okutulaga, era ayagala okukikola, era asobola okukikola. Ayaayaanira okukikola. Okwegomba kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okusinga amaanyi kwe kubikkula Yesu Kristo eri abantu. Ku lunaku lwa Pentekooti, Peetero n'abalala abaali naye bwe baali “bajjuzibbwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu,” tebaayogera nnyo ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu; baayogera ku Kristo. Wetegereze okubuulira kwa Peetero ku lunaku olwo; Yesu Kristo ye yali omutwe gwe ogumu, era Yesu Kristo y'aliba omutwe gwaffe ogumu, bwe tuyigirizibwa Omwoyo; Yesu Kristo alijjula ekifo kyonna eky'okulaba kwaffe. Tuliba ne Kristo omuggya, Kristo ow'ekitiibwa. Kristo aliba wa kitiibwa gye tuli nnyo ne tuyaayaanira okugenda okubuulira buli omu ku Oyo ow'ekitiibwa gwe tuzudde. Yesu Kristo aba wa njawulo nnyo Omwoyo bw'amugulumiza ng'addira ebibye n'abitulaga. III. Omwoyo Omutukuvu atubikkulira ebintu eby'obuziba ebya Katonda ebikwekeddwa omuntu ow'omubiri era ebiri obusirusiru gy'ali. Tusoma mu 1 Abakkolinso 2:9-13, “Ekyo eriiso lye litalabanga, n'okutu bwe kutawuliranga, n'omutima gw'omuntu bwe gutalowoozangako, Katonda kye yateekerateekera abo abamwagala. Ebintu bino Katonda yabitubikkulira olw'Omwoyo. Kubanga Omwoyo akebera byonna, n'obuziba bwa Katonda bwennyini. Kubanga ani amanyi ebirowoozo by'omuntu okuggyako omwoyo gw'omuntu oyo oguli mu ye? Bwe kityo tewali amanyi birowoozo bya Katonda okuggyako Omwoyo wa Katonda. Kaakati twafuna, si mwoyo gwa nsi, wabula Omwoyo ava eri Katonda, tulyoke tutegeere ebintu Katonda bye yatuwa obuwa. Era tubyogera, si mu bigambo ebiyigirizibwa amagezi g'abantu, wabula ebiyigirizibwa Omwoyo, nga tuvvuunula amazima ag'omwoyo eri abo ab'omwoyo.” Ekitundu kino kyogera okusookera ku Batume, naye tetuyinza kukugira mulimu guno ogw'Omwoyo ku bo bokka. Omwoyo abikkulira buli mukkiriza ebintu eby'obuziba ebya Katonda, ebintu eriiso ery'omuntu bye litalabangako, n'okutu bye kutawuliranga, era ebitayingiranga mu mutima gw'omuntu; bino bye bintu Katonda by'ateekerateekera abo abamwagala. Kirabika bulungi okuva mu bwogeddwako nti kino tekyogera ku ggulu kwokka oba ebintu ebigenda okujja mu bulamu obw'oluvannyuma. Omwoyo Omutukuvu addira ebintu eby'obuziba ebya Katonda, Katonda bye yatuteekerateekera, ne mu bulamu buno obw'okaakati, n'abitubikkulira. IV. Omwoyo Omutukuvu avvuunula okubikkulirwa kwe. Awa amaanyi ag'okwawula, okumanya, n'okusiima ekyo ky'ayigirizza. Mu lunyiriri oluddirira olwo lwe twakayogera tusoma nti, “Omuntu ow'omubiri tafuna bintu bya Mwoyo wa Katonda, kubanga busirusiru gy'ali, era tasobola kubitegeera kubanga bitegeerwa mu mwoyo” (1 Abakkolinso 2:14). Omwoyo Omutukuvu si Mukozi w'okubikkulirwa kwokka, ye Kigambo kya Katonda ekyawandiikibwa: era ye Muvvuunuzi w'ekyo ky'abikkudde. Buli kitabo eky'obuziba kiba kya nsanyu era kya mugaso okusingirira ddala bwe tuba n'omuwandiisi w'ekitabo okumpi okukituvvuunulira, era bulijjo kya nkizo gye tuli okuba n'omuwandiisi wa Bayibuli okumpi bwe tugisoma. Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye Mukozi wa Bayibuli, era ali mwetegefu okuvvuunula amakulu gaayo eri buli mukkiriza buli lw'aggula Ekitabo. Okutegeera Ekitabo, tuteekwa okumutunuulira, olwo n'ebifo ebisinga ekizikiza ne bitangaala. Emirundi mingi twetaaga okusaba awamu n'Omuzabbuli ow'edda nti, “Ozibule amaaso gange, ndyoke ndabe eby'ekitalo ebiva mu mateeka go” (Zabbuli 119:18). Tekimala nti tulina okubikkulirwa kwa Katonda mu maaso gaffe mu Kigambo ekyawandiikibwa okusoma, tuteekwa era okuba n'omusana ogw'omunda ogw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutusobozesa okukutegeera bwe tukusoma. Kye kiremba ekya bulijjo, naye ekiremba ekyeyoleka ennyo, kwe kugezaako okutegeera okubikkulirwa okw'omwoyo n'okutegeera okw'omubiri. Okugezaako okusirusiru kuno kwe kwakulukusa bangi mu ttosi ery'ekiyitibwa “Higher Criticism.” Okutegeera obuyiiya, omuntu ateekwa okuba n'okuwulira okulungi awamu n'okumanya langi n'erangi, era omuntu okutegeera okubikkulirwa okw'omwoyo ateekwa okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo. Okumanya kwokka ennimi Bayibuli mwe yawandiikirwa tekumala. Omuntu atalina magezi malungi ayinza okusuubira okusiima ekifaananyi kya Sistine Madonna olw'okuba tazibe langi mu maaso, nga bwe kiri obwongo eri omuntu atajjudde Mwoyo okusuubira okutegeera Bayibuli olw'obwereere nti amanyi ebigambo n'amateeka g'ennimi Bayibuli mwe yawandiikirwa. Kyandibadde nga tetulina njawulo bwe tulowooza okuteeka omuntu okuyigiriza obuyiiya olw'okuba ategeera by'okusiiga langi, nga bwe kiri okuteeka omuntu okuyigiriza Bayibuli olw'okuba nga ategeera bulungi Oluyonaani n'Oluceburaniya. Mu biseera byaffe twetaaga, si kukiriza bwokka nti obutuukirivu bwaffe tebumala era tebulina mugaso mu maaso ga Katonda, kwe kuyigiriza okw'essuula ezisooka ez'Ebbaluwa eri Abaruumi, wabula n'okukiriza nti amagezi gaffe tegamala era tegalina mugaso mu bintu bya Katonda, kwe kuyigiriza okw'Ebbaluwa Esooka eri Abakkolinso, naddala essuula esooka okutuuka ku ey'okusatu. (Laba, okugeza, 1 Abakkolinso 1:19-21, 26, ne 27.) Abayudaaya ab'edda baalina okubikkulirwa okw'Omwoyo, naye ne balemwa okwesiga Omwoyo yennyini okukubavvuunulira, bwe batyo ne bawaba. Bwe kityo Abakristaayo leero balina okubikkulirwa okw'Omwoyo, era bangi balemererwa okwesiga Omwoyo Omutukuvu okukubavvuunulira, bwe batyo ne bawaba. Ekkanisa yonna ey'enjiri ekiriziganya, wadde mu kuteesa bwokka, nti obutuukirivu bw'omuntu tebumala n'akatono. Kye yeetaaga okuyigirizibwa mu kaseera kano, era kye yeetaaga okulaba, kwe kutamala kw'amagezi g'omuntu. Ekyo oboolyawo kye kuyigiriza omulembe guno ogw'amakumi abiri ogw'amalala ag'amagezi kwe gwetaaga okusinga okuyiga. Okutegeera Ekigambo kya Katonda, tuteekwa okwefululusa amagezi gaffe gonna ne tuwummulira mu kwesiga Omwoyo wa Katonda okukituvvuunulira. Kirungi okuteeka ku mutima ebigambo bya Yesu yennyini mu Matayo 11:25, “Nkwebaza, Kitange, Mukama w'eggulu n'ensi, kubanga ebintu bino wabikweka ab'amagezi n'ab'okutegeera n'obibikkulira abaana abato.” Abayizi ba Bayibuli abamu lumu baali bakubaganya ebirowoozo ku ngeri ezisinga obulungi ez'okusoma Bayibuli, omusajja omu, eyali muyivu era ow'amasomero, n'agamba nti, “Ndowooza engeri esinga obulungi ey'okusoma Bayibuli ye ngeri y'omwana omuwere.” Bwe tumala okuggyawo obutuukirivu bwaffe ddala, olwo era olwo lwokka, lwe tufuna obutuukirivu bwa Katonda (Abafiripi 4:7, 9; Abaruumi 10:3). Era bwe tumala okuggyawo amagezi gaffe ddala, olwo lwe tufuna amagezi ga Katonda. “Waleme kubaawo yeerimba yekka,” bw'agamba Omutume Pawulo. “Omuntu yenna mu mmwe bw'alowooza nti wa magezi mu mulembe guno, afuuke omusirusiru alyoke afuuke ow'amagezi” (1 Abakkolinso 3:18). Era okwefululusa kuteekwa okukulembera okujjuzibwa, omuntu yeeyiweeko Katonda alyoke ayiwibwe mu ye. Tuteekwa buli lunaku okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo okutegeera Ekigambo. Tetuyinza kwesiga nsonga nti Omwoyo yatuyigiriza jjo. Buli mulundi omuggya bwe tutuukirira Ekigambo, kiteekwa kubeera mu maanyi g'Omwoyo olw'omukolo ogwo ogwennyini. Nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu yamala okumulisa ebirowoozo byaffe okukwata amazima agamu tekimala. Ateekwa okukikola buli mulundi gwe tuyolekera ekitundu ekyo. Andrew Murray yagamba bulungi nti, “Buli mulundi bw'ojja eri Ekigambo mu kusoma, mu kuwuliriza okubuulira, oba mu kusoma ekitabo eky'eddiini, waanobeerawo, ng'okwawukana bwe kuli n'engeri gy'okwatagana n'eby'ebweru, omukolo ogw'olwatu ogw'okwefiiriza, ng'owakanya amagezi go n'oweeyabulira mu kukkiriza eri Omuyigiriza ow'Obwakatonda” (“The Spirit of Christ,” olupapula 221). V. Omwoyo Omutukuvu asobozesa omukkiriza okutuusa eri abalala mu maanyi amazima ge yayigirizibwa. Pawulo agamba mu 1 Abakkolinso 2:1-5, “Nange, bwe najja gye muli, abooluganda, saajja kubabuulira bujulizi bwa Katonda n'ebigambo ebisukkulumu oba amagezi. Kubanga nnasalawo obutamanya kintu kyonna mu mmwe okuggyako Yesu Kristo era oyo eyakomererwa. Era nnali nammwe mu bunafu ne mu kutya ne mu kukankana okungi, okwogera kwange n'obubaka bwange tebyali mu bigambo bya magezi ebisendasenda, wabula mu kwolesebwa kw'Omwoyo n'okw'amaanyi, okukkiriza kwammwe kuleme kwesigama ku magezi g'abantu wabula ku maanyi ga Katonda.” Mu ngeri y'emu, ng'awandiikira abakkiriza mu 1 Abasessaloniika 1:5, “Kubanga enjiri yaffe teyajja gye muli mu kigambo kyokka, wabula ne mu maanyi ne mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu ne mu bukakafu obujjuvu. Mumanyi engeri gye twali abasajja bwe tweyoleka mu mmwe ku lwammwe.” Tetwetaaga Mwoyo Omutukuvu kubikkula mazima eri abatume ne bannabbi abalonde mu kifo ekisooka kyokka, n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu kifo eky'okubiri okutuvvuunulira ffe nga bantu ssekinnoomu amazima ge yabikkudde bw'atyo, wabula mu kifo eky'okusatu, twetaaga Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutusobozesa okutuusa obulungi eri abalala amazima ye yennyini ge yatuvvuunulira. Tumwetaaga okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Ensonga enkulu emu ey'okulemererwa okw'amazima mu buweereza, ne bwe wabaawo okulabika ng'okwesiima, era si mu buweereza obwa bulijjo bwokka wabula ne mu ngeri zonna ez'obuweereza, eva mu kugezaako okuyigiriza n'“ebigambo ebisendasenda eby'amagezi g'omuntu” (kwe kugamba, n'obukugu bw'okuwakanya, okusendasenda n'obumanyirivu bw'okwogera) ebyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu bye yatuyigiriza. Ekyetaagisa maanyi ga Mwoyo Mutukuvu, “okwolesebwa kw'Omwoyo n'amaanyi.” Waliwo ensonga ssatu ez'okulemererwa mu kubuulira leero. Ekisooka, obubaka obulala buyigirizibwa mu kifo ky'obubaka Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yabikkula mu Kigambo. (Abantu babuulira ssaayansi, obuyiiya, eby'ebiwandiiko, endowooza, eby'obwannakyewa, ebyafaayo, eby'enfuna, eby'obumanyirivu, n'ebirala, so si Kigambo kya Katonda ekyangu nga bwe kisangibwa mu Kitabo ky'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Bayibuli.) Eky'okubiri, obubaka bwa Bayibuli obuyigirizibwa Omwoyo busomebwa era bugezebwako okukwatibwa n'okutegeera okw'omubiri, kwe kugamba, awatali musana gw'Omwoyo. Nga kino kya bulijjo nnyo, ne mu bibiina omwo abantu mwe batendekerwa obuweereza, ne mu bibiina ebiyinza okuba nga bituufu ddala. Eky'okusatu, obubaka obuweebwa Omwoyo, Ekigambo, Bayibuli esomebbwa era etegeerebwa wansi w'omusana gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, buweebwa abalala n'“ebigambo ebisendasenda eby'amagezi g'omuntu,” so si mu “kwolesebwa kw'Omwoyo n'amaanyi.” Twetaaga, era twesigama ku Omwoyo, okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Ateekwa okutuyigiriza engeri y'okwogera awamu n'ekyokwogera. Ateekwa okuba amaanyi awamu n'obubaka.

fields.title: Okusaba, Okwebaza, n'Okusinza mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu
fields.body_html:
Ebitundu bibiri eby'omugaso omunene ennyo mu Bayibuli ku nsonga y'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'ensonga y'okusaba bisangibwa mu Yuda 20 ne Abaefeso 6:18. Mu Yuda 20 tusoma nti, “Naye mmwe, abaagalwa, nga mwezimba mu kukkiriza kwammwe okutukuvu ennyo era nga musaba mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu,” ne mu Abaefeso 6:18, “Nga musaba bulijjo mu Mwoyo, n'okusaba kwonna n'okwegayirira. Ku ekyo, mubeere beegendereza n'okugumiikiriza kwonna, nga mwegayiririra abatukuvu bonna.” Ebitundu bino bituyigiriza mu bwannamawulire nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu aluŋŋamya omukkiriza mu kusaba. Abayigirizwa tebaamanya ngeri gye baali basaanidde okusaba, kyebaava bajja eri Yesu ne bagamba nti, “Mukama waffe, tuyigirize okusaba” (Lukka 11:1).

Ne leero tetumanyi ngeri gye tusaanidde okusaba, tetumanyi kye tusaanidde okusaba, wadde engeri gye tukisabira, naye waliwo Omu ali bulijjo okumpi okuyamba (Yokaana 14:16-17), era amanyi kye tusaanidde okusaba. Ayamba obunafu bwaffe mu nsonga eno ey'okusaba, nga bw'akola mu nsonga endala (Abaruumi 8:26). Atuyigiriza okusaba.

Okusaba okw'amazima kwe kusaba mu Mwoyo (kwe kugamba, okusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu kw'aleeta era kw'aluŋŋamya). Okusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw'atuluŋŋamya kwe kusaba “okusinziira ku kwagala kwa Katonda” (Abaruumi 8:27). Bwe tusaba ekintu kyonna okusinziira ku kwagala kwa Katonda, tumanyi nti atuwulira era tumanyi nti atuwadde ebintu bye tusaba (1 Yokaana 5:14-15). Tuyinza okukimanya nti kyaffe mu kaseera kennyini we tusaba, nga bwe tukimanya n'obwesige oluvannyuma nga tukirina mu ngalo zaffe. Naye tuyinza tutya okumanya okwagala kwa Katonda nga tusaba? Mu ngeri bbiri: Ekisooka, olw'ebyo ebiwandiikiddwa mu Kigambo kye; ebisuubizo byonna ebiri mu Bayibuli bya bwesigwa era Katonda bw'asuubiza ekintu kyonna mu Bayibuli, tuyinza okukakasa nti kwe kwagala kwe okutuwa ekintu ekyo; naye waliwo ebintu bingi bye twetaaga ebitasuubizibbwa mu bujjuvu mu Kigambo, era ne mu mbeera eyo kya nkizo gye tuli okumanya okwagala kwa Katonda, kubanga gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutuyigiriza okwagala kwa Katonda n'okutuluŋŋamya mu kusaba ng'okulaga okwagala kwa Katonda.

Abamu bawakanya enjigiriza y'Ekikristaayo ey'okusaba, egamba nti tuyinza okugenda eri Katonda mu butamanya bwaffe ne tukyusa okwagala kwe ne tugonza amagezi ge agatakoma eri obusirusiru bwaffe. Naye eyo si nnjigiriza y'Ekikristaayo ey'okusaba; enjigiriza y'Ekikristaayo ey'okusaba eri nti kya nkizo eri omukkiriza okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda yennyini okumanya okwagala kwa Katonda kye kiri, so si kusaba bintu obusirusiru bwaffe bwe bwanditukubirizza okusaba wabula okusaba ebintu Omwoyo wa Katonda atajeema bw'atukubiriza okusaba.

Okusaba okw'amazima kwe kusaba “mu Mwoyo,” kwe kugamba, okusaba Omwoyo kw'aleeta era kw'aluŋŋamya. Bwe tujja mu maaso ga Katonda, tusaanidde okukiraba obulwadde bwaffe, obutamanya bwaffe eky'ekisinga obulungi gye tuli, kye tusaanidde okusaba, engeri gye tusaanidde okukisaba, era nga tumanyi obutasobola kwaffe okusaba obulungi, tutunuulire Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutuyigiriza okusaba, era tweyabulire ffe ffennyini eri ye aluŋŋamye okusaba kwaffe n'aleete okwegomba kwaffe n'aluŋŋamye okukwogera. Tewali kifo we twetaagira okumanya obutamanya bwaffe okusinga bwe tukikola mu kusaba. Okudduka mu maaso ga Katonda awatali kwegendereza ne tusaba ekintu ekisooka ekituuka mu birowoozo byaffe, oba omulala atalowooza ky'atusaba okusabira, si kusaba “mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu” era si kusaba kwa mazima. Tuteekwa okulindirira Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne tweyabulira eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Okusaba Katonda, Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kw'aleeta kwe kusaba Katonda, Kitaffe, kw'addamu.

Okwegomba Omwoyo Omutukuvu kw'atondawo mu mitima gyaffe emirundi mingi kwa buziba nnyo okuyinza okwogerwa, kwa buziba nnyo okulabika eri okutegeera okw'omukkiriza yennyini Omwoyo mw'akolera “Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n'okusinda okw'obuziba obutayogerekeka” (Abaruumi 8:26).

Katonda yennyini “ateekwa okukebera omutima” okumanya “ekirowoozo ky'Omwoyo” kye kiri mu kwegomba kuno okutayogerwa era okutayogerekeka. Naye Katonda amanyi ekirowoozo ky'Omwoyo kye kiri; amanyi okwegomba kuno okuva eri Omwoyo, kwe tutasobola kussa mu bigambo, kye kitegeeza, ne bwe tutakimanyi, era okwegomba kuno kwa “okusinziira ku kwagala kwa Katonda,” era Katonda akuwa. Mu ngeri eno kwe kiva kituukirira nti Katonda asobola okukola ebisukkiridde ennyo okusinga byonna bye tusaba oba bye tulowooza, ng'okusinziira ku maanyi agakolera mu ffe (Abaefeso 3:20). Waliwo ebiseera ebirala okuluŋŋamya kw'Omwoyo lwe kuba kutegeerekeka nnyo ne tusaba n'Omwoyo era n'okutegeera (1 Abakkolinso 14:15). Tutegeera bulungi ekyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'atuluŋŋamya okusaba.

II. Omwoyo Omutukuvu aleetera omukkiriza era amuluŋŋamya mu kwebaza nga bw'akola mu kusaba. Tusoma mu Abaefeso 5:18-20, “Temutamiira nvinnyo, kubanga eyo bwonoonyi, wabula mujjuzibwe Omwoyo, nga mwogeraganya mu zabbuli n'ennyimba n'ennyimba ez'omwoyo, nga muyimba era nga muyimbira Mukama mu mutima gwammwe, nga mwebaza bulijjo era ku buli kintu Katonda Kitaffe mu linnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.” Omwoyo Omutukuvu tatuyigiriza kusaba kwokka, wabula era atuyigiriza okwebaza.

Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okweyoleka mu bulamu obujjuzibbwa Omwoyo kwe kwebaza. Ku lunaku lwa Pentekooti, abayigirizwa bwe baajjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ne boogera nga Omwoyo bwe yabawa okwogera, tubawulira nga babuulira ebikolwa bya Katonda eby'ekitalo (Ebikolwa 2:4,11), era leero omukkiriza yenna bw'ajjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, bulijjo ajjula okwebaza n'okutendereza. Okwebaza okw'amazima kwe “eri Katonda, ye Kitaffe,” okuyita mu, oba “mu linnya lya” Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.

III. Omwoyo Omutukuvu aleeta okusinza ku ludda lw'omukkiriza. Tusoma mu Abafiripi 3:3, “Kubanga ffe kwe kukomola, abasinza Katonda mu Mwoyo, era abeenyumiririza mu Kristo Yesu, so tetwesiga mubiri.” Okusaba si kusinza; okwebaza si kusinza. Okusinza mukolo gwennyini ogw'ekitonde eri Katonda. Okusinza kwe kuvuunama mu maaso ga Katonda mu kumwaana n'okumulowoozaako ye yennyini n'obutuukirivu obw'obwomu bwe. Omuntu yagamba nti, “Mu kusaba kwaffe, tuba twekutte ku byetaago byaffe; mu kwebaza kwaffe, tuba twekutte ku mikisa gyaffe; mu kusinza kwaffe, tuba twekutte ku ye.” Tewali kusinza kwa mazima era okukkirizibwa okuggyako okwo Omwoyo Omutukuvu kw'akubiriza era kw'aluŋŋamya. “Naye ekiseera kijja, era kaakati kituuse, abasinza ab'amazima lwe balisinza Kitaffe mu mwoyo ne mu mazima, kubanga Kitaffe anoonya abantu ng'abo okumusinza. Katonda Mwoyo, era abamusinza kibagwanira okusinza mu mwoyo ne mu mazima.” (Yokaana 4:23-24). Omubiri gunoonya okuyingirira buli kitundu ky'obulamu. Omubiri gulina okusinza kwagwo n'okwegomba kwagwo. Okusinza omubiri kw'aleeta kya muzizo eri Katonda. Mu kino, tulaba obusirusiru bw'okugezaako kwonna okw'olukuŋŋaana lw'eddiini nga ababaka b'eddiini ez'enjawulo ennyo bagezaako okusinza wamu.

Si kusinza kwonna okunyiikivu era okw'amazima kuba kusinza mu Mwoyo. Omuntu ayinza okuba ow'amazima nnyo era omunyiikivu nnyo mu kusinza kwe naye nga tannaweeyabulira eri okuluŋŋamya kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu nsonga eyo, bwe kityo okusinza kwe kuba mu mubiri. Emirundi mingi, ne bwe wabaawo obwesigwa obungi eri ennukuta y'Ekigambo, okusinza kuyinza obutaba “mu Mwoyo,” kwe kugamba, okuleetebwa era okuluŋŋamizibwa ye. Okusinza obulungi, nga Pawulo bw'akyogera, tetuteekwa kwesiga mubiri, kwe kugamba, tuteekwa okukiraba obutasobola kwonna kwa mubiri (obuntu bwaffe obwa buzaaliranwa nga bugeraageranyizibwa n'Omwoyo ow'Obwakatonda abeera mu era asaanidde okubumba buli kimu mu mukkiriza) okusinza mu ngeri ekkirizibwa. Era tuteekwa okukiraba akabi nti omubiri guyingirira okusinza kwaffe. Mu kutakwesiga ffe ffennyini n'akatono, tuteekwa okwewaayo eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuluŋŋamye obulungi mu kusinza kwaffe. Nga bwe tuteekwa okwegaana omuwendo gwonna mu ffe ffennyini ne tweyabulira eri Kristo n'omulimu gwe yatukolera ku musaalaba olw'okuweebwa obutuukirivu, bwe tutyo tuteekwa okwegaana obusobozi bwonna obwerowoozebwa obw'okukola obulungi mu ffe ffennyini ne tweyabulira ddala eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'omulimu gwe mu ffe, mu kubeera obutukuvu, okumanya, okusaba, okwebaza n'okusinza ne buli kirala kye tusaanidde okukola.

fields.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'Aweereza Abantu mu Mirimu Egyategekebwa
fields.body_html:
Tusoma mu Ebikolwa 13:2-4, “Bwe baali basinza Mukama era nga basiiba, Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'agamba nti, ‘Munjawulize Balunabba ne Sawulo olw'omulimu gwe mbayisizza.’ Awo bwe baamala okusiiba n'okusaba, ne babassaako emikono ne babasindika. Balunabba ne Sawulo mu Kupulo. Bwe batyo, bwe baaweerezebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ne baserengeta e Serukiya, era okuva eyo ne baseeyeeya okutuuka e Kupulo.” Kirabika bulungi okuva mu kitundu kino nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayita abantu mu mirimu egyategekebwa era abaweereza mu mulimu. Tayita bantu mu ngeri eya bulijjo mu mulimu gw'Ekikristaayo kwokka, wabula alonda omulimu gwennyini era agulaga.

Bangi leero babuuza, era abalala bangi basaanidde okubuuza nti, “Ŋŋende e Cayina, e Afirika, oba e Buyindi?”

Waliwo Omuntu omu yekka asobola okusalawo obulungi ekibuuzo ekyo ku lulwo, era Omuntu oyo ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu.

Toyinza kwesalirawo kibuuzo kino ggwe wekka, n'okusingawo tewali muntu mulala ayinza kukisalawo bulungi ku lulwo. Si buli Mukristaayo ayitibwa kugenda e Cayina, e Afirika, oba mu nsi ez'ebweru n'akatono. Katonda yekka amanyi oba akwagaliza mu bifo bino, naye ayagala okukulaga. Mu biseera nga bino bye tubeeramu, nga waliwo obwetaavu obungi obw'abasajja n'abakazi abasaanidde mu nsi ez'ebweru, buli Mukristaayo omuvubuka, alamu, era ow'amagezi amalirivu, omusajja n'omukazi, asaanidde okwewaayo eri Katonda olw'ensi ez'ebweru n'amubuuza oba ayagala bagende. Naye tebasaanidde kugenda okutuusa ye, olw'Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, lw'akifuula olwatu.

Obwetaavu obunene mu mirimu gyonna egy'Ekikristaayo leero be basajja n'abakazi Omwoyo Omutukuvu b'ayita era b'aweereza. Tulina abasajja n'abakazi bangi abantu be baayita ne babaweereza. Tulina abasajja n'abakazi bangi abeeyita bo bennyini, kubanga waliwo bangi leero abawakanya n'amaanyi okuweerezebwa abantu, oba ekibiina kya ngeri yonna, naye be balubirira okusingawo ennyo, abeeweereza bo bennyini so si Katonda.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayita atya? Ekitundu kye tulaba tekitubuulira Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yayogera n'ekibinja kya bannabbi n'abayigiriza mu Anteyokiya, ng'abagamba okwawula Balunabba ne Sawulo olw'omulimu gwe yali abayisizza. Kisirika mu bugenderevu ku nsonga eno. Oboolyawo kisirika ku nsonga eno tuleme okulowooza nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu ateekwa okuyita bulijjo mu ngeri y'emu ddala. Tewali kintu na kimu ekiraga nti yayogera n'eddoboozi eriwulikika, n'okusingawo tewali kintu ekiraga nti yamanyisa okwagala kwe mu ngeri yonna ey'ekyewuunyo abamu mu nnaku zino gye boogera nti bakiraba nga baluŋŋamizibwa, ng'okukankana kw'omubiri, okunyogoga, okuggula Bayibuli awatali kuteekateeka n'okuteeka olunwe ku kitundu ekiyinza okuvvuunulwa mu makulu ga njawulo ddala okuva ku ago omuwandiisi eyaluŋŋamizibwa ge yali agenderera. Ensonga enkulu eri nti, yamanyisa okwagala kwe, era ayagala okumanyisa okwagala kwe gye tuli leero. Oluusi akimanyisa mu ngeri emu era oluusi mu ndala, naye alikimanyisa.

Naye tunaafuna tutya okuyitibwa kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu? Ekisooka, olw'okukwegomba; eky'okubiri, olw'okukunoonya n'obunyiikivu; eky'okusatu, olw'okulindirira Mukama okukufuna; eky'okuna, olw'okukusuubira. Ebiwandiike bigamba nti, “Bwe baali baweereza Mukama era nga basiiba.” Baali balindirira Mukama abaluŋŋamye. Mu kaseera ako, baali bakubye amabega ddala ku by'ensi ebibeeraliikiriza n'ebibasanyusa, ne ku bintu ebyo ebyali bituufu ddala mu kifo kyabyo. Bangi leero bagamba, nga beeweera olw'okusigala eka nga tebagenda mu nsi ez'ebweru, nti, “Sirabangako kuyitibwa.” Naye okimanyi otya ekyo? Obadde owuliriza okuyitibwa?

Katonda bulijjo ayogera n'eddoboozi eddene ery'obuteefu, era kutu okuwuliriza kwokka kwe kusobola okulikwata.

Wali weewaayo ddala eri Katonda akuweereze gy'ayagala? Newaakubadde nga tewali musajja oba mukazi asaanidde okugenda e Cayina oba e Afirika oba mu nsi endala ez'ebweru okuggyako nga bayitiddwa, buli omu asaanidde okwewaayo eri Katonda olw'omulimu guno era abeere mwetegefu olw'okuyitibwa era awulirize bulungi alyoke awulire okuyitibwa bwe kunajja. Kiterekebwe bulungi mu birowoozo nti omuntu tayeetaaga kuyitibwa kwa njawulo okugenda e Afirika okusinga okugenda e Boston, oba e New York, oba e London, oba mu kifo kirala kyonna eky'omu nsi ye eky'okwegombebwa.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu tayita bantu na kubaweereza mu mirimu egimu kwokka, wabula era aluŋŋamya mu buli kamu ak'obulamu obwa bulijjo n'obuweereza, ku kifo gy'ogenda ne gy'otogenda, ekikolebwa n'ekitakolebwa.

Tusoma mu Ebikolwa 8:27-29, “N'agolokoka n'agenda. Kale, waaliwo Omwesiyopya, omulaawe, omukungu wa Kandake kabaka omukazi w'Abesiyopya, eyakuumanga eby'obugagga bwe byonna. Yali azze e Yerusaalemi okusinza era yali addayo, ng'atudde mu ggaali lye, ng'asoma nnabbi Isaaya. Omwoyo n'agamba Firipo nti, ‘Sembera ogattibwe ku ggaali lino.’” Wano tulaba Omwoyo ng'aluŋŋamya Firipo mu buli kamu ak'obuweereza mwe yali amuyisizza. Mu ngeri y'emu, tusoma mu Ebikolwa 16:6-7, “Ne bayita mu kitundu kya Fulugiya ne Galatiya, nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu abagaanye okwogera ekigambo mu Asiya. Bwe baatuuka okumpi ne Musiya, ne bagezaako okuyingira mu Bisuniya, naye Omwoyo wa Yesu n'atabakkiriza.” Wano tulaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'alagira Pawulo gy'atasaanidde kugenda.

Tuyinza okufuna okuluŋŋamya okutuukiridde okw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku buli kkubo ery'obulamu. Twogere ku mulimu gwaffe, ng'ekyokulabirako. Kirabika bulungi nti si kigendererwa kya Katonda nti twogere na buli muntu gwe tusisinkana. Okugezaako okukola bwe kityo kwandibadde kugezaako ekitasoboka, era twandidiibudde ebiseera bingi mu kugezaako okwogera n'abantu awatali kubaganyula, ebiseera ebyo ebyandikozeseddwa mu kwogera n'abantu we tuyinza okutuukiriza ekintu. Waliwo abamu be kyandibadde amagezi okwogera nabo. Waliwo abalala be kyandibadde obusirusiru okwogera nabo. Ebiseera ebyakozesebwa ku bo byandiggyibbwa ku mulimu ogwandireeteredde Katonda ekitiibwa ekisingawo. Awatali kubuusabuusa, Firipo bwe yali atambula ng'agenda e Gaza, yasisinkana bangi nga tannasisinkana oyo Omwoyo gwe yagamba nti, ‘Sembera, weegatte ku ggaali lino.’

Omwoyo mwetegefu okutuluŋŋamya nga bwe yali mwetegefu okuluŋŋamya Firipo. Emyaka egiyise, omukozi w'Ekikristaayo mu Toronto yalina okuwulira nti asaanidde okugenda mu ddwaliro n'ayogera n'omuntu. Ne yeebuuza nti, “Ani gwe mmanyi ali mu ddwaliro mu kiseera kino?” Ne yajjukira omu gwe yamanya nga ali mu ddwaliro, n'ayanguwa okugenda mu ddwaliro, naye bwe yatuula okumpi naye okwogera naye, n'ategeera nti si lwa musajja ono kye yatumibwa. N'agolokoka okuggulawo eddirisa. Kino kyonna kyali kitegeeza ki? Omusajja omulala yali agalamidde ng'asomooka ekkubo okuva ku musajja gwe yamanya, ne kimujjira nti guno gwe musajja gwe yandyogeddeko. N'akyuka n'ayogera n'omusajja ono era n'afuna omukisa okumukulembera eri Kristo. Tewaali kintu kizibu mu mbeera y'omusajja. Yali afunye obuvune ku vviivi lye, era tewaali ndowooza ya nsonga nzibu, naye omusajja oyo yafa n'ayingira obulamu obutaggwaawo ekiro ekyo.

Ebyokulabirako bingi eby'engeri y'emu byandiwandiikiddwa era byandikakasizza okuva mu bumanyirivu nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu mwetegefu okuluŋŋamya abo abanoonya okuluŋŋamya kwe leero nga bwe yali mwetegefu okuluŋŋamya abayigirizwa ab'edda. Naye mwetegefu okutuluŋŋamya, si mu ngeri zaffe ez'obuweereza obw'Ekikristaayo obusingako obulungi kwokka wabula mu bintu byonna eby'obulamu, eby'obusuubuzi, n'eby'okusoma, buli kintu kye tusaanidde okukola. Tewali kisuubizo mu Bayibuli ekyeyolefu obulungi okusinga Yakobo 1:5-7, “Omuntu yenna mu mmwe bw'abulwa amagezi, asabe Katonda, agabira bonna atakwatirwa, era anaagaweebwa. Naye asabe mu kukkiriza, awatali kubuusabuusa, kubanga oyo abuusabuusa ali ng'ejjengo ery'ennyanja erifuumuulibwa era eritwalibwa empewo. Kubanga omuntu oyo aleme kulowooza nti alifuna ekintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama.” Ekitundu kino tekisuubiza magezi ga Katonda kwokka wabula kitutegeeza mu bujjuvu kye tusaanidde okukola okugafuna. Waliwo emitendera etaano egyogeddwa oba egyategeezebwa mu kitundu: 1. Nti tuba “tubuliddwa amagezi.” Tuteekwa okukiraba era okukkiriza mu bujjuvu obutasobola bwaffe okusalawo n'amagezi.

Wano we tulemererwa okufuna amagezi ga Katonda. Tulowooza nti tuyinza okwesalirawo ffe bennyini, oba waakiri tetuli beetegefu okukkiriza obutasobola bwaffe okusalawo n'akatono. Waateekwa okubaawo okugaana ddala amagezi g'omubiri.

2. Tuteekwa okwegomba okumanya ekkubo lya Katonda era okuba abeetegefu ku muwendo gwonna okukola okwagala kwa Katonda. Kino kitegeezebwa mu kigambo “okusaba.” Okusaba kuteekwa okuba okw'amazima, era bwe tutaba beetegefu kukola kwagala kwa Katonda, ne kubeera kutya, ku muwendo gwonna, okusaba tekuba kwa mazima. Eno nsonga nkulu nnyo. Tewali kintu kiyamba nnyo okutangaaza ebirowoozo byaffe mu kutegeera okwagala kwa Katonda, nga bwe kubikkulibwa Omwoyo we, okusinga okwagala okuweereddwayo. Wano we tusanga ensonga lwaki abantu emirundi mingi tebamanya kwagala kwa Katonda so tebalina kuluŋŋamya kw'Omwoyo. Tebeetegefu kukola Omwoyo kw'aluŋŋamya kwonna ku muwendo gwonna.

Oyo “ayagala okukola okwagala kwe” y'alimanya, si njigiriza yokka, wabula alimanya n'obuvunaanyizibwa bwe obwa buli lunaku.

Abantu emirundi mingi bajja gye ndi ne bagamba nti, “Sisobola kuvumbula kwagala kwa Katonda,” naye bwe mbabuuza ekibuuzo nti, “Oli mwetegefu okukola okwagala kwa Katonda ku muwendo gwonna?” bakkiriza nti tebeetegefu. Ekkubo eritali lya lwatu n'akatono bwe tweekuuma okuva ku kwewaayo ddala eri Katonda lifuuka lya lwatu ng'emisana bwe tukola okwewaayo okwo.

3. Tuteekwa “okusaba” ddala okuluŋŋamizibwa. Tekimala kwegomba oba kuba beetegefu kugondera; tuteekwa okusaba Katonda atulage ekkubo.

4. Tuteekwa okusuubira okuluŋŋamizibwa n'obwesige. “Asabe mu kukkiriza, awatali kubuusabuusa.” Bangi tebasobola kuvumbula kkubo, wadde nga basaba Katonda okulibalaga, olw'obwereere nti tebalina kusuubira okutaliimu kubuusabuusa nti Katonda alibalaga ekkubo. Katonda asuubiza okulyoleka bwe tulisuubira n'obwesige. Bw'ojja eri Katonda mu kusaba akulage ky'osaanidde okukola, manya n'obwesigwa nti alikulaga. Mu ngeri ki gy'alikulaga, takubuulira, naye asuubiza nti alikulaga, era ekyo kimala.

5. Tuteekwa okugoberera omutendera ku mutendera nga okuluŋŋamya bwe kujja. Nga bwe kyayogerwa emabega, engeri gye kulijjira, tewali asobola kugamba, naye kulijja. Emirundi mingi, omutendera gumu gwokka gwe gulitangaazibwa mu kiseera; ekyo kye twetaaga okumanya kyokka, omutendera oguddako. Bangi bali mu kizikiza kubanga tebamanyi era tebasobola kuvumbula Katonda ky'ayagala bakole wiiki ejja, oba mwezi ogujja oba mwaka ogujja. Omusajja ow'oku yunivasite lumu yajja gye ndi n'antegeeza nti yali mu kizikiza kinene ku kuluŋŋamya kwa Katonda, nti yali anoonya okuvumbula okwagala kwa Katonda n'okumanya omulimu gwe ogw'obulamu bwe gwe gwandibadde, naye nga tasobola kuguvumbula. Ne mmubuuza nga bw'atuuse wa mu misomo gye egya yunivasite. N'agamba nti mu mwaka gwe ogw'okubiri. Ne mmubuuza nti, “Kiki ky'oyagala okumanya?” “Nnaakola ki bwe ndimala yunivasite?” “Omanyi nti osaanidde okuyita mu yunivasite?” “Yee.” Omusajja ono teyamanya kye yali asaanidde okukola omwaka ogujja kwokka, wabula n'omwaka oguddirira, naye ng'akyali mu kutabukatabuka kunene kubanga teyamanya kye yali asaanidde okukola emyaka gino ebiri bwe gyandiggwaako.

Katonda asanyukira okukulembera abaana be omutendera ku mutendera. Atukulembera nga bwe yakulembera abaana ba Isirayeri.

“Awo ekire bwe kyaggyibwanga ku Weema, oluvannyuma lw'ekyo abaana ba Isirayeri ne batambula: era mu kifo ekire we kyabeeranga, awo abaana ba Isirayeri we baasimbanga eweema zaabwe. Ku kiragiro kya Mukama abaana ba Isirayeri ne batambula, era ku kiragiro kya Mukama ne basimba: ekire gye kyabeereranga ku Weema, ne bawummuliranga mu weema zaabwe. Era ekire bwe kyalwangako ku Weema ennaku nnyingi, abaana ba Isirayeri ne bakuumanga ekiragiro kya Mukama ne batatambula. Era bwe kityo, ekire bwe kyabeeranga ku Weema ennaku ntono; ku kiragiro kya Mukama ne batambula. Era bwe kityo, ekire bwe kyabeeranga okuva akawungeezi okutuusa enkya, era ekire ne kiggyibwa enkya, awo ne batambula: oba bwe kaali kakya oba ekiro, ekire bwe kyaggyibwanga, ne batambula. Oba nga ennaku bbiri, oba omwezi, oba omwaka, ekire kye kyalwangako ku Weema nga kibeera ku yo, abaana ba Isirayeri ne babeeranga mu weema zaabwe ne batatambula: naye bwe kyaggyibwanga, ne batambula. Ku kiragiro kya Mukama ne bawummuliranga mu weema, era ku kiragiro kya Mukama ne batambula: ne bakuumanga ekiragiro kya Mukama, ku kiragiro kya Mukama okuyita mu mukono gwa Musa” (Okubala 9:17-23).

Bangi abeewaddeyo eri okuluŋŋamya kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu bayingira mu kifo eky'obuddu obunene era babonaabona kubanga balina okuluŋŋamya kwe batya nti kuyinza okuva eri Katonda naye nga tebakikakasa. Bwe batagondera kuluŋŋamya kuno, batya nti bajeemedde Katonda era oluusi balowooza nti banakuwazizza Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kubanga tebaagoberera kuluŋŋamya kwe. Kino kyonna tekyetaagisa. Ka tukinyweze mu birowoozo byaffe nti okuluŋŋamya kwa Katonda kwa lwatu. “Katonda musana, so mu ye temuli kizikiza n'akatono” (1 Yokaana 1:5). Era okuluŋŋamya kwonna okutali kwa lwatu tekuva eri ye. Kwe kugamba, singa okwagala kwaffe kuweereddwayo eri ye. Mazima, obutassaayo mwoyo buyinza okuva ku kwagala okutaweereddwayo. Naye singa okwagala kwaffe kuweereddwayo eri Katonda, tulina obuyinza nga baana ba Katonda okukakasa nti okuluŋŋamya kwonna kuva eri ye nga tetunnakugondera.

Tulina obuyinza okugenda eri Kitaffe ne tugamba nti, “Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, nze nzuuno. Njagala okusinga ebintu byonna okukola okwagala kwo. Kaakati kintangaaze, nze omwana wo. Ekintu kino kye nnina okuluŋŋamizibwa okukola bwe kiba kwagala kwo, nnaakikola, naye kintangaaze ng'emisana bwe kiba nga ddala kwe kwagala kwo.” Bwe kiba kwe kwagala kwe, Kitaffe ali mu ggulu alikitangaaza ng'emisana. Era toyeetaaga, era tosaanidde kukola kintu ekyo okutuusa lw'akitangaaza, era toyeetaaga era tosaanidde kwenenya olw'obutakikola. Katonda tayagala baana be kubeera mu mbeera ya kusalirwa musango mu maaso ge. Ayagala tubeere ba ddembe okuva mu kweraliikirira kwonna, obuyinike, okutya, n'okwesalira omusango.

Omuzadde yenna ow'oku nsi yanditangaazizza ekkubo eri omwana we asaba okulimanya, n'okusingawo Kitaffe ali mu ggulu alikitutangaaza, era okutuusa lw'akitangaaza, tetwetaaga kutya nti olw'obutakikola, tuba tujeemedde Katonda. Tetulina buyinza kulagira Katonda ngeri gy'anaawa okuluŋŋamya kwe, ng'okugeza, olw'okumusaba okuggalawo buli kkubo, oba olw'okumusaba okuwa akabonero, oba olw'okutuluŋŋamya mu kuteeka olunwe lwaffe ku kyawandiikibwa, oba mu ngeri endala yonna. Kyaffe okunoonya n'okusuubira amagezi, naye si kyaffe kulagira ngeri gye ganaaweebwa. Omwoyo Omutukuvu agabira “buli muntu kinnoomu nga bw'ayagala” (1 Abakkolinso 12:11).

Ebintu bibiri byeyoleka okuva ku ebyo ebyogeddwa ku mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Ekisooka, engeri gye twesigamiramu ddala ku mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku buli kkubo ery'obulamu n'obuweereza obw'Ekikristaayo. Eky'okubiri, obuteekateeka Katonda bwe yateekawo olw'obulamu n'obuweereza nga bwe butuukiridde? Obujjuvu obw'enkizo obuggulirwa omukkiriza asinga obwetoowaze okuyita mu mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu nga bwa kyewuunyo. Si nnyo kye tuli mu buzaaliranwa, oba mu magezi, oba mu mpisa, oba mu mubiri, oba ne mu mwoyo, ekikulu. Ensonga enkulu kye kyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'asobola okutukolera n'ekyo kye tunaamukkiriza okukola. Emirundi mingi, Omwoyo Omutukuvu atwala oyo alabika ng'aleeta essuubi ery'obuzaaliranwa erisinga obutono n'amukozesa okusukka ennyo abo abaleeta essuubi ery'obuzaaliranwa erisinga obunene. Obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo tebusaanidde kubeeramu mu nsi y'empisa ez'obuzaaliranwa, era omulimu gw'Ekikristaayo tegusaanidde kukolebwa mu maanyi g'ekirabo eky'obuzaaliranwa, wabula obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo busaanidde okubeeramu mu nsi y'Omwoyo, era omulimu gw'Ekikristaayo gusaanidde okukolebwa mu maanyi g'Omwoyo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu mwetegefu era ayaayaanira okukolera buli omu ku ffe omulimu gwe gwonna, era alikola mu buli omu ku ffe byonna bye tunaamukkiriza okukola.
fields.body_text: Tusoma mu Ebikolwa 13:2-4, “Bwe baali basinza Mukama era nga basiiba, Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'agamba nti, ‘Munjawulize Balunabba ne Sawulo olw'omulimu gwe mbayisizza.’ Awo bwe baamala okusiiba n'okusaba, ne babassaako emikono ne babasindika. Balunabba ne Sawulo mu Kupulo. Bwe batyo, bwe baaweerezebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ne baserengeta e Serukiya, era okuva eyo ne baseeyeeya okutuuka e Kupulo.” Kirabika bulungi okuva mu kitundu kino nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayita abantu mu mirimu egyategekebwa era abaweereza mu mulimu. Tayita bantu mu ngeri eya bulijjo mu mulimu gw'Ekikristaayo kwokka, wabula alonda omulimu gwennyini era agulaga. Bangi leero babuuza, era abalala bangi basaanidde okubuuza nti, “Ŋŋende e Cayina, e Afirika, oba e Buyindi?” Waliwo Omuntu omu yekka asobola okusalawo obulungi ekibuuzo ekyo ku lulwo, era Omuntu oyo ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Toyinza kwesalirawo kibuuzo kino ggwe wekka, n'okusingawo tewali muntu mulala ayinza kukisalawo bulungi ku lulwo. Si buli Mukristaayo ayitibwa kugenda e Cayina, e Afirika, oba mu nsi ez'ebweru n'akatono. Katonda yekka amanyi oba akwagaliza mu bifo bino, naye ayagala okukulaga. Mu biseera nga bino bye tubeeramu, nga waliwo obwetaavu obungi obw'abasajja n'abakazi abasaanidde mu nsi ez'ebweru, buli Mukristaayo omuvubuka, alamu, era ow'amagezi amalirivu, omusajja n'omukazi, asaanidde okwewaayo eri Katonda olw'ensi ez'ebweru n'amubuuza oba ayagala bagende. Naye tebasaanidde kugenda okutuusa ye, olw'Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, lw'akifuula olwatu. Obwetaavu obunene mu mirimu gyonna egy'Ekikristaayo leero be basajja n'abakazi Omwoyo Omutukuvu b'ayita era b'aweereza. Tulina abasajja n'abakazi bangi abantu be baayita ne babaweereza. Tulina abasajja n'abakazi bangi abeeyita bo bennyini, kubanga waliwo bangi leero abawakanya n'amaanyi okuweerezebwa abantu, oba ekibiina kya ngeri yonna, naye be balubirira okusingawo ennyo, abeeweereza bo bennyini so si Katonda. Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayita atya? Ekitundu kye tulaba tekitubuulira Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yayogera n'ekibinja kya bannabbi n'abayigiriza mu Anteyokiya, ng'abagamba okwawula Balunabba ne Sawulo olw'omulimu gwe yali abayisizza. Kisirika mu bugenderevu ku nsonga eno. Oboolyawo kisirika ku nsonga eno tuleme okulowooza nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu ateekwa okuyita bulijjo mu ngeri y'emu ddala. Tewali kintu na kimu ekiraga nti yayogera n'eddoboozi eriwulikika, n'okusingawo tewali kintu ekiraga nti yamanyisa okwagala kwe mu ngeri yonna ey'ekyewuunyo abamu mu nnaku zino gye boogera nti bakiraba nga baluŋŋamizibwa, ng'okukankana kw'omubiri, okunyogoga, okuggula Bayibuli awatali kuteekateeka n'okuteeka olunwe ku kitundu ekiyinza okuvvuunulwa mu makulu ga njawulo ddala okuva ku ago omuwandiisi eyaluŋŋamizibwa ge yali agenderera. Ensonga enkulu eri nti, yamanyisa okwagala kwe, era ayagala okumanyisa okwagala kwe gye tuli leero. Oluusi akimanyisa mu ngeri emu era oluusi mu ndala, naye alikimanyisa. Naye tunaafuna tutya okuyitibwa kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu? Ekisooka, olw'okukwegomba; eky'okubiri, olw'okukunoonya n'obunyiikivu; eky'okusatu, olw'okulindirira Mukama okukufuna; eky'okuna, olw'okukusuubira. Ebiwandiike bigamba nti, “Bwe baali baweereza Mukama era nga basiiba.” Baali balindirira Mukama abaluŋŋamye. Mu kaseera ako, baali bakubye amabega ddala ku by'ensi ebibeeraliikiriza n'ebibasanyusa, ne ku bintu ebyo ebyali bituufu ddala mu kifo kyabyo. Bangi leero bagamba, nga beeweera olw'okusigala eka nga tebagenda mu nsi ez'ebweru, nti, “Sirabangako kuyitibwa.” Naye okimanyi otya ekyo? Obadde owuliriza okuyitibwa? Katonda bulijjo ayogera n'eddoboozi eddene ery'obuteefu, era kutu okuwuliriza kwokka kwe kusobola okulikwata. Wali weewaayo ddala eri Katonda akuweereze gy'ayagala? Newaakubadde nga tewali musajja oba mukazi asaanidde okugenda e Cayina oba e Afirika oba mu nsi endala ez'ebweru okuggyako nga bayitiddwa, buli omu asaanidde okwewaayo eri Katonda olw'omulimu guno era abeere mwetegefu olw'okuyitibwa era awulirize bulungi alyoke awulire okuyitibwa bwe kunajja. Kiterekebwe bulungi mu birowoozo nti omuntu tayeetaaga kuyitibwa kwa njawulo okugenda e Afirika okusinga okugenda e Boston, oba e New York, oba e London, oba mu kifo kirala kyonna eky'omu nsi ye eky'okwegombebwa. Omwoyo Omutukuvu tayita bantu na kubaweereza mu mirimu egimu kwokka, wabula era aluŋŋamya mu buli kamu ak'obulamu obwa bulijjo n'obuweereza, ku kifo gy'ogenda ne gy'otogenda, ekikolebwa n'ekitakolebwa. Tusoma mu Ebikolwa 8:27-29, “N'agolokoka n'agenda. Kale, waaliwo Omwesiyopya, omulaawe, omukungu wa Kandake kabaka omukazi w'Abesiyopya, eyakuumanga eby'obugagga bwe byonna. Yali azze e Yerusaalemi okusinza era yali addayo, ng'atudde mu ggaali lye, ng'asoma nnabbi Isaaya. Omwoyo n'agamba Firipo nti, ‘Sembera ogattibwe ku ggaali lino.’” Wano tulaba Omwoyo ng'aluŋŋamya Firipo mu buli kamu ak'obuweereza mwe yali amuyisizza. Mu ngeri y'emu, tusoma mu Ebikolwa 16:6-7, “Ne bayita mu kitundu kya Fulugiya ne Galatiya, nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu abagaanye okwogera ekigambo mu Asiya. Bwe baatuuka okumpi ne Musiya, ne bagezaako okuyingira mu Bisuniya, naye Omwoyo wa Yesu n'atabakkiriza.” Wano tulaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'alagira Pawulo gy'atasaanidde kugenda. Tuyinza okufuna okuluŋŋamya okutuukiridde okw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku buli kkubo ery'obulamu. Twogere ku mulimu gwaffe, ng'ekyokulabirako. Kirabika bulungi nti si kigendererwa kya Katonda nti twogere na buli muntu gwe tusisinkana. Okugezaako okukola bwe kityo kwandibadde kugezaako ekitasoboka, era twandidiibudde ebiseera bingi mu kugezaako okwogera n'abantu awatali kubaganyula, ebiseera ebyo ebyandikozeseddwa mu kwogera n'abantu we tuyinza okutuukiriza ekintu. Waliwo abamu be kyandibadde amagezi okwogera nabo. Waliwo abalala be kyandibadde obusirusiru okwogera nabo. Ebiseera ebyakozesebwa ku bo byandiggyibbwa ku mulimu ogwandireeteredde Katonda ekitiibwa ekisingawo. Awatali kubuusabuusa, Firipo bwe yali atambula ng'agenda e Gaza, yasisinkana bangi nga tannasisinkana oyo Omwoyo gwe yagamba nti, ‘Sembera, weegatte ku ggaali lino.’ Omwoyo mwetegefu okutuluŋŋamya nga bwe yali mwetegefu okuluŋŋamya Firipo. Emyaka egiyise, omukozi w'Ekikristaayo mu Toronto yalina okuwulira nti asaanidde okugenda mu ddwaliro n'ayogera n'omuntu. Ne yeebuuza nti, “Ani gwe mmanyi ali mu ddwaliro mu kiseera kino?” Ne yajjukira omu gwe yamanya nga ali mu ddwaliro, n'ayanguwa okugenda mu ddwaliro, naye bwe yatuula okumpi naye okwogera naye, n'ategeera nti si lwa musajja ono kye yatumibwa. N'agolokoka okuggulawo eddirisa. Kino kyonna kyali kitegeeza ki? Omusajja omulala yali agalamidde ng'asomooka ekkubo okuva ku musajja gwe yamanya, ne kimujjira nti guno gwe musajja gwe yandyogeddeko. N'akyuka n'ayogera n'omusajja ono era n'afuna omukisa okumukulembera eri Kristo. Tewaali kintu kizibu mu mbeera y'omusajja. Yali afunye obuvune ku vviivi lye, era tewaali ndowooza ya nsonga nzibu, naye omusajja oyo yafa n'ayingira obulamu obutaggwaawo ekiro ekyo. Ebyokulabirako bingi eby'engeri y'emu byandiwandiikiddwa era byandikakasizza okuva mu bumanyirivu nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu mwetegefu okuluŋŋamya abo abanoonya okuluŋŋamya kwe leero nga bwe yali mwetegefu okuluŋŋamya abayigirizwa ab'edda. Naye mwetegefu okutuluŋŋamya, si mu ngeri zaffe ez'obuweereza obw'Ekikristaayo obusingako obulungi kwokka wabula mu bintu byonna eby'obulamu, eby'obusuubuzi, n'eby'okusoma, buli kintu kye tusaanidde okukola. Tewali kisuubizo mu Bayibuli ekyeyolefu obulungi okusinga Yakobo 1:5-7, “Omuntu yenna mu mmwe bw'abulwa amagezi, asabe Katonda, agabira bonna atakwatirwa, era anaagaweebwa. Naye asabe mu kukkiriza, awatali kubuusabuusa, kubanga oyo abuusabuusa ali ng'ejjengo ery'ennyanja erifuumuulibwa era eritwalibwa empewo. Kubanga omuntu oyo aleme kulowooza nti alifuna ekintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama.” Ekitundu kino tekisuubiza magezi ga Katonda kwokka wabula kitutegeeza mu bujjuvu kye tusaanidde okukola okugafuna. Waliwo emitendera etaano egyogeddwa oba egyategeezebwa mu kitundu: 1. Nti tuba “tubuliddwa amagezi.” Tuteekwa okukiraba era okukkiriza mu bujjuvu obutasobola bwaffe okusalawo n'amagezi. Wano we tulemererwa okufuna amagezi ga Katonda. Tulowooza nti tuyinza okwesalirawo ffe bennyini, oba waakiri tetuli beetegefu okukkiriza obutasobola bwaffe okusalawo n'akatono. Waateekwa okubaawo okugaana ddala amagezi g'omubiri. 2. Tuteekwa okwegomba okumanya ekkubo lya Katonda era okuba abeetegefu ku muwendo gwonna okukola okwagala kwa Katonda. Kino kitegeezebwa mu kigambo “okusaba.” Okusaba kuteekwa okuba okw'amazima, era bwe tutaba beetegefu kukola kwagala kwa Katonda, ne kubeera kutya, ku muwendo gwonna, okusaba tekuba kwa mazima. Eno nsonga nkulu nnyo. Tewali kintu kiyamba nnyo okutangaaza ebirowoozo byaffe mu kutegeera okwagala kwa Katonda, nga bwe kubikkulibwa Omwoyo we, okusinga okwagala okuweereddwayo. Wano we tusanga ensonga lwaki abantu emirundi mingi tebamanya kwagala kwa Katonda so tebalina kuluŋŋamya kw'Omwoyo. Tebeetegefu kukola Omwoyo kw'aluŋŋamya kwonna ku muwendo gwonna. Oyo “ayagala okukola okwagala kwe” y'alimanya, si njigiriza yokka, wabula alimanya n'obuvunaanyizibwa bwe obwa buli lunaku. Abantu emirundi mingi bajja gye ndi ne bagamba nti, “Sisobola kuvumbula kwagala kwa Katonda,” naye bwe mbabuuza ekibuuzo nti, “Oli mwetegefu okukola okwagala kwa Katonda ku muwendo gwonna?” bakkiriza nti tebeetegefu. Ekkubo eritali lya lwatu n'akatono bwe tweekuuma okuva ku kwewaayo ddala eri Katonda lifuuka lya lwatu ng'emisana bwe tukola okwewaayo okwo. 3. Tuteekwa “okusaba” ddala okuluŋŋamizibwa. Tekimala kwegomba oba kuba beetegefu kugondera; tuteekwa okusaba Katonda atulage ekkubo. 4. Tuteekwa okusuubira okuluŋŋamizibwa n'obwesige. “Asabe mu kukkiriza, awatali kubuusabuusa.” Bangi tebasobola kuvumbula kkubo, wadde nga basaba Katonda okulibalaga, olw'obwereere nti tebalina kusuubira okutaliimu kubuusabuusa nti Katonda alibalaga ekkubo. Katonda asuubiza okulyoleka bwe tulisuubira n'obwesige. Bw'ojja eri Katonda mu kusaba akulage ky'osaanidde okukola, manya n'obwesigwa nti alikulaga. Mu ngeri ki gy'alikulaga, takubuulira, naye asuubiza nti alikulaga, era ekyo kimala. 5. Tuteekwa okugoberera omutendera ku mutendera nga okuluŋŋamya bwe kujja. Nga bwe kyayogerwa emabega, engeri gye kulijjira, tewali asobola kugamba, naye kulijja. Emirundi mingi, omutendera gumu gwokka gwe gulitangaazibwa mu kiseera; ekyo kye twetaaga okumanya kyokka, omutendera oguddako. Bangi bali mu kizikiza kubanga tebamanyi era tebasobola kuvumbula Katonda ky'ayagala bakole wiiki ejja, oba mwezi ogujja oba mwaka ogujja. Omusajja ow'oku yunivasite lumu yajja gye ndi n'antegeeza nti yali mu kizikiza kinene ku kuluŋŋamya kwa Katonda, nti yali anoonya okuvumbula okwagala kwa Katonda n'okumanya omulimu gwe ogw'obulamu bwe gwe gwandibadde, naye nga tasobola kuguvumbula. Ne mmubuuza nga bw'atuuse wa mu misomo gye egya yunivasite. N'agamba nti mu mwaka gwe ogw'okubiri. Ne mmubuuza nti, “Kiki ky'oyagala okumanya?” “Nnaakola ki bwe ndimala yunivasite?” “Omanyi nti osaanidde okuyita mu yunivasite?” “Yee.” Omusajja ono teyamanya kye yali asaanidde okukola omwaka ogujja kwokka, wabula n'omwaka oguddirira, naye ng'akyali mu kutabukatabuka kunene kubanga teyamanya kye yali asaanidde okukola emyaka gino ebiri bwe gyandiggwaako. Katonda asanyukira okukulembera abaana be omutendera ku mutendera. Atukulembera nga bwe yakulembera abaana ba Isirayeri. “Awo ekire bwe kyaggyibwanga ku Weema, oluvannyuma lw'ekyo abaana ba Isirayeri ne batambula: era mu kifo ekire we kyabeeranga, awo abaana ba Isirayeri we baasimbanga eweema zaabwe. Ku kiragiro kya Mukama abaana ba Isirayeri ne batambula, era ku kiragiro kya Mukama ne basimba: ekire gye kyabeereranga ku Weema, ne bawummuliranga mu weema zaabwe. Era ekire bwe kyalwangako ku Weema ennaku nnyingi, abaana ba Isirayeri ne bakuumanga ekiragiro kya Mukama ne batatambula. Era bwe kityo, ekire bwe kyabeeranga ku Weema ennaku ntono; ku kiragiro kya Mukama ne batambula. Era bwe kityo, ekire bwe kyabeeranga okuva akawungeezi okutuusa enkya, era ekire ne kiggyibwa enkya, awo ne batambula: oba bwe kaali kakya oba ekiro, ekire bwe kyaggyibwanga, ne batambula. Oba nga ennaku bbiri, oba omwezi, oba omwaka, ekire kye kyalwangako ku Weema nga kibeera ku yo, abaana ba Isirayeri ne babeeranga mu weema zaabwe ne batatambula: naye bwe kyaggyibwanga, ne batambula. Ku kiragiro kya Mukama ne bawummuliranga mu weema, era ku kiragiro kya Mukama ne batambula: ne bakuumanga ekiragiro kya Mukama, ku kiragiro kya Mukama okuyita mu mukono gwa Musa” (Okubala 9:17-23). Bangi abeewaddeyo eri okuluŋŋamya kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu bayingira mu kifo eky'obuddu obunene era babonaabona kubanga balina okuluŋŋamya kwe batya nti kuyinza okuva eri Katonda naye nga tebakikakasa. Bwe batagondera kuluŋŋamya kuno, batya nti bajeemedde Katonda era oluusi balowooza nti banakuwazizza Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kubanga tebaagoberera kuluŋŋamya kwe. Kino kyonna tekyetaagisa. Ka tukinyweze mu birowoozo byaffe nti okuluŋŋamya kwa Katonda kwa lwatu. “Katonda musana, so mu ye temuli kizikiza n'akatono” (1 Yokaana 1:5). Era okuluŋŋamya kwonna okutali kwa lwatu tekuva eri ye. Kwe kugamba, singa okwagala kwaffe kuweereddwayo eri ye. Mazima, obutassaayo mwoyo buyinza okuva ku kwagala okutaweereddwayo. Naye singa okwagala kwaffe kuweereddwayo eri Katonda, tulina obuyinza nga baana ba Katonda okukakasa nti okuluŋŋamya kwonna kuva eri ye nga tetunnakugondera. Tulina obuyinza okugenda eri Kitaffe ne tugamba nti, “Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, nze nzuuno. Njagala okusinga ebintu byonna okukola okwagala kwo. Kaakati kintangaaze, nze omwana wo. Ekintu kino kye nnina okuluŋŋamizibwa okukola bwe kiba kwagala kwo, nnaakikola, naye kintangaaze ng'emisana bwe kiba nga ddala kwe kwagala kwo.” Bwe kiba kwe kwagala kwe, Kitaffe ali mu ggulu alikitangaaza ng'emisana. Era toyeetaaga, era tosaanidde kukola kintu ekyo okutuusa lw'akitangaaza, era toyeetaaga era tosaanidde kwenenya olw'obutakikola. Katonda tayagala baana be kubeera mu mbeera ya kusalirwa musango mu maaso ge. Ayagala tubeere ba ddembe okuva mu kweraliikirira kwonna, obuyinike, okutya, n'okwesalira omusango. Omuzadde yenna ow'oku nsi yanditangaazizza ekkubo eri omwana we asaba okulimanya, n'okusingawo Kitaffe ali mu ggulu alikitutangaaza, era okutuusa lw'akitangaaza, tetwetaaga kutya nti olw'obutakikola, tuba tujeemedde Katonda. Tetulina buyinza kulagira Katonda ngeri gy'anaawa okuluŋŋamya kwe, ng'okugeza, olw'okumusaba okuggalawo buli kkubo, oba olw'okumusaba okuwa akabonero, oba olw'okutuluŋŋamya mu kuteeka olunwe lwaffe ku kyawandiikibwa, oba mu ngeri endala yonna. Kyaffe okunoonya n'okusuubira amagezi, naye si kyaffe kulagira ngeri gye ganaaweebwa. Omwoyo Omutukuvu agabira “buli muntu kinnoomu nga bw'ayagala” (1 Abakkolinso 12:11). Ebintu bibiri byeyoleka okuva ku ebyo ebyogeddwa ku mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Ekisooka, engeri gye twesigamiramu ddala ku mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku buli kkubo ery'obulamu n'obuweereza obw'Ekikristaayo. Eky'okubiri, obuteekateeka Katonda bwe yateekawo olw'obulamu n'obuweereza nga bwe butuukiridde? Obujjuvu obw'enkizo obuggulirwa omukkiriza asinga obwetoowaze okuyita mu mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu nga bwa kyewuunyo. Si nnyo kye tuli mu buzaaliranwa, oba mu magezi, oba mu mpisa, oba mu mubiri, oba ne mu mwoyo, ekikulu. Ensonga enkulu kye kyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'asobola okutukolera n'ekyo kye tunaamukkiriza okukola. Emirundi mingi, Omwoyo Omutukuvu atwala oyo alabika ng'aleeta essuubi ery'obuzaaliranwa erisinga obutono n'amukozesa okusukka ennyo abo abaleeta essuubi ery'obuzaaliranwa erisinga obunene. Obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo tebusaanidde kubeeramu mu nsi y'empisa ez'obuzaaliranwa, era omulimu gw'Ekikristaayo tegusaanidde kukolebwa mu maanyi g'ekirabo eky'obuzaaliranwa, wabula obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo busaanidde okubeeramu mu nsi y'Omwoyo, era omulimu gw'Ekikristaayo gusaanidde okukolebwa mu maanyi g'Omwoyo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu mwetegefu era ayaayaanira okukolera buli omu ku ffe omulimu gwe gwonna, era alikola mu buli omu ku ffe byonna bye tunaamukkiriza okukola.

fields.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'Omubiri gw'Omukkiriza
fields.body_html:
Omwoyo Omutukuvu akolera emibiri gyaffe omulimu nga bw'akolera n'ebirowoozo n'emitima gyaffe. Tusoma mu Abaruumi 8:11, “Oba ng'Omwoyo w'oyo eyazuukiza Yesu mu bafu abeera mu mmwe, oyo eyazuukiza Kristo Yesu mu bafu alifuula n'emibiri gyammwe egifa mu bulamu okuyita mu Mwoyo we abeera mu mmwe.” Omwoyo Omutukuvu awa obulamu omubiri gw'omukkiriza ogufa. Kirabika bulungi nnyo okuva mu bwogeddwako nti kino kyogera ku kuzuukira kw'omubiri okw'omu maaso (ennyiriri 21-23). Okuzuukira kw'omubiri gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Omubiri ogw'ekitiibwa guva eri ye; guba “mubiri gwa mwoyo.” Kaakati, tulina bibala bya Mwoyo ebibereberye byokka era tulindirira amakungula amajjuvu, okununulibwa kw'omubiri gwaffe (olunyiriri 23).

Naye waliwo engeri Omwoyo Omutukuvu gy'awa emibiri gyaffe obulamu ne kaakati. Yesu atugamba mu Matayo 12:28 nti yagoba baddayimooni olw'Omwoyo wa Katonda. Era tusoma mu Ebikolwa 10:38, “Katonda bwe yafuka amafuta ku Yesu ow'e Nazaaleesi n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'amaanyi. Yatambulanga ng'akola obulungi era ng'awonya bonna abaanyigirizibwanga Setaani, kubanga Katonda yali naye.” Mu Yakobo 5:14, Omutume awandiika nti, “Waliwo omuntu yenna mu mmwe alwadde? Ayite abakadde b'ekkanisa, era bamusabire nga bamufukako amafuta mu linnya lya Mukama.” Amafuta mu kitundu kino ge kifaananyi ky'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era amazima ge gano nti okuwonya gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Katonda, olw'Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, awa obulamu obuggya n'amaanyi eri emibiri gino egifa mu bulamu obwa kaakati.

Okugenda mu bungi obusukkiridde nga bangi bwe bakola ne bakwata endowooza nti omukkiriza atambula mu bumu ne Kristo tasaanidde kulwala n'akatono kwe kugenda okusukka ku ekyo Bayibuli ky'etukkiriza okugendako. Okununulibwa kw'emibiri gyaffe mazima kwakakasibwa omulimu gwa Kristo ogw'okutangirira, naye okutuusa Mukama lw'alijja, tunyumirwa bibala bya kununulibwa okwo ebibereberye byokka. Tulindirira era oluusi nga tusinda olw'ekifo kyaffe ekijjuvu nga abaana abalabisibwa mu kununulibwa kw'omubiri gwaffe (Abaruumi 8:23). Naye newaakubadde nga kino kya mazima, kwe kuyigiriza okw'olwatu okw'Ekyawandiikibwa era nsonga ey'obumanyirivu obw'obuntu ku ludda lw'enkumi n'enkumi nti obulamu bw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu buyita mu mibiri gyaffe gino mu biseera eby'obunafu n'eby'obulumi n'obulwadde, nga bugiwa obulamu obuggya, nga bugiwonya obulumi era nga bugijjuza obulamu obungi ennyo.

Kya nkizo gye tuli okumanya okukwatibwako Omwoyo Omutukuvu okuwa obulamu mu mibiri gino nga bwe kiri ne mu birowoozo byaffe n'okwegomba, n'okwagala kwaffe. Kyandibadde lunaku lukulu eri Ekkanisa n'ekitiibwa kya Yesu Kristo, singa Abakristaayo bandyeganye emirembe gyonna eby'obukuusa byonna ebya Setaani ebifaananako omulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Christian Science, Okuwonya kw'Ebirowoozo, Okubeerawo kw'Obwakatonda okw'obukuusa, Hypnotism n'ebika ebirala eby'enjawulo eby'obulogo ne beesiga Katonda olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo we Omutukuvu okukolera mu mibiri gino gyaffe ekyo ye mu magezi ge amatuukiridde ky'alaba nti kye twetaaga okusinga.

fields.title: Okubatizibwa n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu
fields.body_html:
Ekimu ku bigambo eby'amakulu amangi ebikozesebwa mu Byawandiikibwa nga byogera ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu kwe kugamba nti “okubatizibwa n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.” Yokaana Omubatiza ye yasooka okukozesa ekigambo kino. Bwe yali ayogera ku ye n'oyo eyali ajja, yagamba nti, “Nze mbabatiza n'amazzi olw'okwenenya, naye ajja emabega wange w'amaanyi okunsinga, engatto ze siisaanira na kusitula. Oyo alibabatiza n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'omuliro.” (Matayo 3:11). Ekigambo “na” eky'okubiri mu kifo kino kiri mu nnukuta ez'okwewunikiriza. Tekisangibwa mu Luyonaani. Waliwo tewali kubatiza kubiri okwogerwako, okumu n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'okulala n'omuliro, wabula okubatiza kumu n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'omuliro.

Yesu oluvannyuma yakozesa ebigambo bye bimu. Mu Ebikolwa 1:5, agamba nti, “Kubanga Yokaana yabatiza n'amazzi, naye mmwe mulibatizibwa n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu nga wayiseewo ennaku si nnyingi.” Ekisuubizo kya Yokaana Omubatiza ne Mukama waffe bwe kyatuukirira mu Ebikolwa 2:3-4, tusoma nti, “Ne kubalabikira ennimi enjawulo nga ez'omuliro, ne zibuutikira buli omu ku bo. Bonna ne bajjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ne batandika okwogera ennimi endala Omwoyo nga bw'abawa okwogera.” Wano tulaba ebigambo ebirala, “okujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu,” nga bikozesebwa mu makulu ge gamu n'“okubatizibwa n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.”

Tusoma nate mu Ebikolwa 10:44-46, “Peetero bwe yali akyayogera ebigambo bino, Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'akkira ku bonna abaali bawulira ekigambo.
